Title: Lemongrass Bar & Restaurant
Content:
[vc_row][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text]
Review by The Travellist
[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="21px"][vc_column_text]Not many restaurants open and are packed every single day and night from the moment they open the doors. It’s a sign of delicious food, great service and good prices. Lemongrass Bar & Restaurant opened just over 6 months ago and if they could fit in more tables, they would fill them too. On a busy night, if you don’t have a booking, you can expect to sit at the bar and wait for a table for a short time...which is fine because the drinks list is huge and the wait for a table is more than worth it. I’m not going to pretend that this is my first visit to Lemongrass. In fact a few friends know if I’m not home, it’s a safe bet I’m at Lemongrass Bar & Restaurant. There’s not much on the menu I haven’t tried but I do have a few faves. The pizzas are all cheesy goodness on a crispy base – if you can handle heat, add a handful of freshly chopped chilli to the vegetarian pizza. The pasta Mediterranean is a light but filling combination of fresh tuna, olives, tomato and eggplant. And the Nasi Campur...a huge plate of delicious! You could order that dish and a few starters and share with it with someone...or don’t share it. And for 65,000IDR, it’s great value. A good friend of mine who also lives here swears by the Crispy Chicken, good comfort food served on mash potato or chips. Lemongrass also offers a home delivery service. So for those nights when you just don’t want to leave the villa, order in and enjoy great food in the comfort of your villa or by the pool. A great solution when the kids are tired from a day of snorkelling and swimming or when last night’s cocktails means you need a quiet night at home. However Lemongrass isn’t just a restaurant. It has great live music and the drink selection is so big it has a menu all of its own. Try one of their namesake fresh juices (Lemongrass Detox is my fave) or be naughty and have a cocktail and listen to local island or Bali bands. I admit when I first went to Lemongrass Bar & Restaurant was because when a new restaurant opens it’s exciting to go check it out. But I kept coming back. Partly for the food and partly for how the place makes you feel. With the big couches and chairs you could curl up in, it’s like having your good friends over for dinner...where someone else is cooking amazing food and making sure your glass is never empty. But for this Lemongrass fan and foodie, it’s the staff and the owners who make me want to come back all the time. Pak Wayan and Ibu Wayan care about their business and their staff and it shows. They greet you as you come up the steps and if you go there as often as I do, you get a hug from everyone! Put Lemongrass Bar & Restaurant at the top of your list of places to eat and drink when visiting our beautiful island. Oh and say hi from me and The Lembongan Traveller! Title: Villa Tranquilla
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=""]

Villa Tranquilla in Nusa Lembongan

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text]
Review by Fran Doll from @throughrosecolouredglasses
[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="21px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Lembongan is my favourite place in the entire world. I was so happy to be heading back there this trip. I always feel a sense of relief when I get on the fast boat from Sanur across to the island. Leaving behind the busy hustle and bustle of Bali en route to paradise.

We arrived to the crystal clear aqua waters and were taken promptly to our villa which was located right in Sandy Bay on the cliff top there. The view from this spot is nothing short of amazing. I come to Lembongan every year but Villa Tranquilla is definitely the best one I have ever stayed in on the island. The location is outstanding!

The villa is huge and has incredible ocean views pretty much everywhere in the house. I loved waking up to the ocean crashing against the cliffs right in front of me, to my right the view of the stunning blue pool complete with day bed and lounges. I must tell you though my absolute favourite thing hands down was the bathtub. To literally sit in the tub overlooking such a spectacular view of the sea was so mind-blowing.

The staff at Villa Tranquilla were so lovely and courteous every morning they would make us breakfast and clean our rooms. I wish I knew how to make a bed so perfectly!

Sunset views at this place are just so crazy beautiful. I found it hard to leave and was so sad saying goodbye to this villa! I am that excited to come back for my next trip. Would definitely stay here again in a heartbeat. We had such an amazing time exploring the island, snorkelling and adventuring.

So happy to have found it through The Lembongan Traveller. Thanks for an amazing stay.

Title: Villa Sayang
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Villa Sayang in Nusa Lembongan

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

LEMBONGAN LUXE

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="21px"][vc_column_text css=""]If you are looking for a luxury villa to accommodate a large group (sleeps up to 14 people plus two extra beds) whilst still maintaining a sense of peacefulness and comfort, look no further than the wonderful Villa Sayang.  This villa is the whole package, incorporating privacy, gorgeous views and water access.  Available as a full complex of 7 bedrooms, 7 bathrooms and two infinity pools or can be enjoyed as a four and three bedroom villa if you have smaller groups. [gallery columns="4" size="medium" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/IMG_1520.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/IMG_1531.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/IMG_1516.jpg|"] Located beach front in Tamarind Bay, you can sit back and watch the action at Playgrounds, whilst the incredibly attentive and friendly staff look after your every need. The relaxed open feel of this luxury villa is truly beautiful and gives you a true appreciation of space.  The 4 bedroom villa incorporates 2 bales overlooking the water at each end of the wet edge pool, you can sit back and watch the world go by, or doze off listening to the palms and bougainvillea rustle on the soft ocean breeze.  Materials used throughout the building are all natural stone and timber creating a stylish, earthy and traditional Balinese feel. [gallery columns="4" size="medium" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/across-the-pool.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/TRI_0534_HDR.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/TRI_1304_HDR.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/TRI_0614_HDR.jpg|"] The use of space has not been compromised and extra large bedrooms and bathrooms, simply and elegantly decorated with gorgeous cotton linens create the sense you are in a large family home.  I loved the small glass free window in my bathroom that was enveloped with bougainvillea, through which I could catch glimpses of the aqua blue ocean. [gallery size="medium" columns="4" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/TRI_0199_HDR.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/TRI_0174_HDR.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/TRI_1251_HDR.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/TRI_0189_HDR.jpg|"] There was also something decadent and serene about sitting on my upper bedroom balcony overlooking a canopy of trees and the turquoise bay sipping tea. Hungry?  Villa Sayang staff will whip you up something fresh, delicious and healthy inspired by  local, seasonal produce. We were treated to the most amazing Asian inspired prawn salad for lunch. Like activities?  Take a snorkelling trip on one of the two Villa Sayang boats that come complete with skipper and deck hand at your beck and call and float amongst the underwater paradise with amazing coral reefs and abundant fish life so close by. A paddle out to Playgrounds surf break is another option, or onto Lacerations for those who like a barrel! Stressed?  An in house massage in the purpose built massage room should take care of things. Wander down the front path and sit on the waterfront private deck that belongs to Villa Sayang and tip your toes in the water.  If the tide is low you will discover your very own private beach. [gallery ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/TRI_0584_HDR.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/FullSizeRender-42-copy.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/FullSizeRender-44-copy.jpg|"] Now what more can one dream of when planning an island getaway?

Title: Cliff Hanging Villa Tanjung
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Cliff Hanging Villa Tanjung

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

Tamarind Beach

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="21px"][vc_column_text]

Review by The Nomadic Shopper

PERCHED ON THE ROCKY OUTCROP BETWEEN MUSHROOM BAY AND TAMARIND BAY STANDS VILLA TANJUNG NUSA LEMBONGAN, AN IMPRESSIVE BALE STYLE BUILDING THAT STAKES HER CLAIM ON THE BLUFF HERE. VILLA TANJUNG RESTS PROUDLY ON THE POINT, COMMANDING ATTENTION AS YOU HUG THE COASTLINE UPON YOUR APPROACH INTO NUSA LEMBONGAN VIA BOAT.

“Tanjung” translates from Indonesian to mean headland and Villa Tanjung really does occupy the headland here with astounding views from every corner.  Cleverly designed to ensure every element of that breathtaking view can be appreciated, the property boasts a 270 degree panoramic vista with the ocean on three sides.  Every single room in this sprawling property offers you views of the water, including every bedroom, each bathroom and even the powder room, so not one guest misses out! Incorporating traditional Indonesian design, Villa Tanjung spreads itself across a massive main pavilion  with open air living and dining with a gorgeous alang alang (grass thatched) roof.  Three separate smaller pod style buildings make up the five bedroom suites and games room.  Natural materials including bamboo, thatched grass, stone and timber furnishings add to the natural island feel.  Designed by famous Bali based architects Grounds Kent of Four Seasons Bali fame, the thought in the design concept of Villa Tanjung translates to every piece of this property. A 17 metre pool lays between the open living bale and the cliff so when poolside you are at the edge of the cliff with nothing in front of you but vast blue seas and views of Mount Agung and Bali mainland. Take the front gate to the side of the pool (on the Mushroom Bay side) and it leads you down to to the bottom of the cliff where a wide flat rocky platform juts out over the sea. Here you will find a private ladder clinging to the rock wall that you can descend and immerse yourself in the beautiful clear waters of Nusa Lembongan. There is something incredibly inspiring about this private hidden nook and entering the sea this way is so wonderful. Do take care, however, as there can be strong currents and swell here.
All your island needs are taken care of with a group of smiling staff at hand. Enjoy your complimentary daily breakfast freshly prepared from the in house menu with fresh juices, fruit platters, indonesian or western fare.  You can even arrange the villa chef to cook you lunch or dinner but arrange this early so you you allow staff time to source ingredients.  There is also a choice of wine, champagne, beer and soft drink at an extra charge. In villa massages can also be arranged to ensure you slip into Nusa Lembongan mode. Nightly turn down service add the final touch at the end of hard day enjoying the Villa Tanjung vista.
Villa Tanjung is sprawling and the sense of space is delightful. Beautiful and extensive landscaping feature at every turn creating peaceful outdoor spaces that add to the sense of peace and serenity here at Villa Tanjung. The gardens, designed by Bali’s leading landscape designer, Made Wijaya, really are lush and beautiful. Villa Tanjung’s open design embraces the gifts Mother Nature has to offer welcoming the fresh outdoor air, the sea breezes, and the sounds of nature that travel on the breeze. This villa truly creates an island feel and a luxury escape that will have you unwound and ready to play your own Robinson Crusoe, albeit a very luxurious one in the Villa Tanjung story! Title: Nusa Lembongan Villas : Villa Coral
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_bottom="15" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Beach Front Beauty

Review by The Seminyak Snob[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=""]It’s no secret that our go to getaway when we need to escape the silly that sometimes Seminyak is known for is Nusa Lembongan. We are pretty fussy about where we stay returning to our favourites again and again. But this time we thought – lets mix it up and try somewhere completely different. I must admit I was pretty excited to try some new digs on the island, a change is as good as a holiday, and that’s what we are on Lembongan for.  As the Rocky van made its way through the bumpy roads and overgrown foliage we were pretty eager to get to this new villa we had heard so much about - Villa Coral. Pulling up on a narrow road right next to Tamarind Beach – I knew I was staying somewhere absolutely beach front when the waves were lapping at my feet as I was wheeling my luggage thru the white sand to get to Villa Coral’s entrance. We were not disappointed by what greeted us. Very large and lovely, modern but in an elegant island style way this villa is cleverly designed so every inch of the bay is captured from every point of this double story Nusa Lembongan villa. This beach front beauty is tucked away in a private and very quiet part of the island, it’s truly beautiful, with every amenity that you will need during your stay provided for you. With four staff to take care of everything – all you need to do is sit back and do nothing – something I’m very good at. This Nusa Lembongan villa has 4 enormous air-conditioned bedrooms, each with king size beds and very generous ensuite bathrooms – all bedrooms have views of the beach and bay that stretch out as far as the eye can see. We spent our days by or I should say laying in the infinity pool taking in the impressive outlook – the star of the show being Mt Agung – which, when he makes an appearance he is seen perfectly from every location in this villa. The poolside bar got a good work out– that impressive stainless steel refrigerator kept our champagne chilled to perfection. The staff were always on hand with menus from local warungs and happily ordered delicious meals for us, collected them and lay out our dishes for us in the beautiful open-air dining area overlooking the pool and the beach. Breakfast at Villa Coral is a great way to start your day – the staff cook up a some tasty treats that will keep you full right thru to lunch – so good in fact – we requested 2nd servings. This Nusa Lembongan villa is literally on the beach! When the tide comes in – you open the front gate – and the waves almost reach the beautiful stone boundary. A walk along the beach you will find local fisherman untangling their nets whilst their young children play in the waves. At night take in the sunset from the poolside bar – or the view is just as good if not better from the upstairs lounge area. With an air- conditioned entertainment room that also doubles as a massage room, this Nusa Lembongan villa has everything to ensure your holiday is perfect in every way. There is lots to do on this island paradise; snorkel, explore, etc., but we have been to Lembongan many times before, so we decided just to chillax and enjoy everything that Villa Coral had to offer – that being the peaceful and secluded position – leaving us with the feeling that we had this whole stretch of beach to ourselves. Villa Coral is most certainly a beachfront beauty, a picture perfect position which will ensure your island getaway is as every bit as wonderful as the view it looks out to. Villa Sayang Luxury Villa Nusa Lembongan

Blog by The Seminyak Snob It was that time again, the time when a little weekend escape was needed and given that the Seminyak silly season was all set to start I thought it was the perfect time to head to Lembongan to relax, refresh and recharge my slightly worn down battery. That was the easy decision; the hard decision (as always) was which fabulously new and amazing villa should we stay at, my list of must haves is always long and I can (sometimes) be very, very picky – the only peeps that know my list of needs is the team at The Lembongan Traveller, the Lembongan experts. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]Villa Sayang was strongly suggested, and I have to say I was hesitant at first, as it wasn’t in the exact area where I really really love to stay and it wasn’t a brand new modern slash contemporary style villa. But…. then it was explained to me, it had its own boat (hello), its own private beach (oooh now that sounds nice) a full time team to look after everything  (ummm even better) and its own private chef that cooks better than Jamie Oliver (okay im in). Arriving on Lembongan we were greeted by the team from Villa Sayang… where they loaded our bags, and us onto their very own boat, we were whisked off to Tamarind Beach – which is where Villa Sayang sits regally, high above overlooking the crystal clear surrounding waters. The gorgeous staff proudly showed us around, and I was overwhelmed not only by its majestic old style Bali beauty but how immense this property is – it literally went on and on forever. Secluded and beachfront, Villa Sayang is nothing short of exquisite, spread over 2 tiers, this property is truly lush tropical oasis, featuring not 1 but 2 infinity edge swimming pools, 100m of ocean frontage, its own private beach, gorgeous green manicured gardens, 7 beautiful air conditioned bedrooms all with private ensuites, these are just a few of the 5 star features that this villa has to offer. The bottom tier is a sanctuary in itself featuring 3 stunning bedrooms overlooking Tamarind Beach all facing onto the infinity pool, and a family / dining area sitting under a huge open living bale as big as a ballroom. Just when I thought it couldn’t get any better, I made my way up the winding white lava stone staircase and reached the upper level where the main villa sits …. It’s then you realize how large this property is – a double story pavilion housing 4 more super sized bedrooms all with their own private tropical style ensuite, each have massive balconies overlooking the bluer than blue bay. There’s another infinity edge pool with more sparkling views, a dining / relaxing outdoor bale and a huge family / tv area.  I was blown away with how gorgeous this villa is and it had me appreciating all over again the beautiful old style Balinese architecture – with thatched roofs, open style living so you can acutally take in all the beauty that surrounds you. Relaxing here is made pretty easy, you literally feel like you are in your own private retreat, peaceful and so very very pretty, its easy to do nothing here except chill and forget all the crazy that may be happening back home. There is a dedicated massage room where a talented masseuse can roll out all the tension that may be laying in your limbs. Or perhaps your are up for a surf? A stand up paddle ? A snorkel ? Villa Sayang has all the equipment right there ready for you to use.  Their private beach ( exposed on low tide) is pristine, the perfect place to take a bottle of wine, a towel and a book and hide on the white sand for the afternoon. The Sayang staff are nothing short of amazing, smiling, funny and so polite, they really are fabulous – all getting their jobs done with out ever “getting in your way”, nothing was ever a problem, preparing the boat for snorkeling, making us a G&T, picking up a take away hot chocolate from The Deck. And of course the Chef… well she most certainly knocked our socks off. Nasi Goreng, Stir Fried Noodles, Chicken Salad, Thai Green Curry …. No wonder I went home 3 kilos heavier. This lady could cook up anything within a minutes notice and I cannot even begin to tell you how delicious her dishes were. We had planned on heading out for dinner in fact we had plans to hire a scooter and do all the usual things we love to do when on Lembongan, but why bother, when you have the perfect paradise with everything you need right at your fingertips. I was really impressed with the attention to detail that Villa Sayang paid to the little things, hair dryers, kimono’s, beautiful, white linen, cable tv, flowers, magazines, the list goes on.  The bedrooms are large and the beds so comfy. It’s a perfect family holiday villa – with so much space you can send the kids up to the lower level area and not even hear them, an ideal place to celebrate that special occasion, 40th, engagement, whatever your celebration may be – these guys have the space and the staff to ensure that they can accommodate anything. We absolutely adored our stay at Villa Sayang – everything was perfect. Thank you to the Lembongan Traveller for introducing us to this magnificent villa and thank you to Villa Sayang for having us – it is most certainly the closest thing on earth to paradise. This villa may not be the newest on the island but it is most certainly the grandest.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_gallery type="image_grid" images="26764,26765,26766,26767,26768,26769,26770" img_size="full" column_number="0" grayscale="no" space_between_images="yes"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_gallery type="image_grid" images="26776,26775,26774,26773,26772,26771" img_size="full" column_number="2" grayscale="no" space_between_images="yes"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_bottom="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Title: Villa Rumah Putih, Lembongan Luxe
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_bottom="15" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Villa Rumah Putih, Lembongan Luxe

Review by The Seminyak Snob[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text]I’ve never been great at keeping secrets, and when I find something amazing – I love to shout it to the world, my boyfriend even says to me sshhhhh don’t tell everyone. Well Lembongan lovers I have got a secret for you, thanks to the Lembongan Traveller, I just discovered the most AMAZING, STUNNING, GORGEOUS villa on the island – Rumah Putih. Perched high on the hill overlooking coconuts beach Villa Rumah Putih  (translation= White House) oozes island luxe. White on white modern interiors, with 50 shades of blue views, this stunning property is a little bit Hamptons, a tad bit Maldives and a lot of Mykonos. The moment I walked through the white wooden panelled door, I fell completely in love with everything in this place, its all and more that I adore about island holidays. Rumah Putih is split level meaning every single inch of this villa takes full advantages of the stunning sparkling views of Lembongan bay. The ground level showcases a whiter than white kitchen, a gorgeous open air living and dining area, a large air-conditioned cinema room (yep you read right, a cinema room), a deep blue beautiful infinity pool surrounded by sun loungers and 2 perfectly placed bale’s where you can lay, read and snooze. And of course there are 2 deluxe and dreamy bedrooms both overlooking the water and both with enormous ensuites, featuring large bathtubs, double vanity, ample drawers and closet space to hang your Camilla kaftans. The upper levels feature 2 additional beautiful bedrooms, ensuites, outside showers and separating the two is a generously sized plunge pool!  The sunset sundeck overlooks everything and is the perfect place to take in the breathtaking views surrounding this gorgeous villa. Rumah Putih literally has all you would expect in a luxury villa, and I mean it has it all, from waffle weave bath gowns, beautiful bath products, hairdryers, a wine fridge, an icemaker but best of all four-gorgeous helpful staff to assist with everything. I need to tell you another secret….. they make the tastiest nasi gorgeng and can mix a lychee martini better than the bartenders at kudeta. I can honestly say I found my perfect match when it comes to somewhere to stay on Lembongan – Rumah Putih is the ultimate island villa. Title: Nyepi Day

[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

NYEPI DAY 2025: A GUIDE TO BALI'S DAY OF SILENCE

On 29th  March 2025, Bali will come to a complete standstill for Nyepi, the Balinese Day of Silence. Marking the start of the Hindu New Year, this sacred day is a time for self-reflection, cleansing, and renewal. While the island embraces total silence and stillness, understanding the traditions, preparations, and guidelines will help you appreciate the significance of this unique cultural event. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

THE MEANING OF NYEPI

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="68073" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]Nyepi is rooted in the Balinese Saka calendar and is deeply spiritual for the Hindu community. It is a day dedicated to introspection, allowing individuals to meditate on the past year and set intentions for the year ahead. Unlike typical New Year celebrations, Nyepi is observed with complete silence, darkness, and stillness to cleanse the world of negative energies and restore harmony.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

BALINESE TRADITIONS LEADING UP TO NYEPI

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="68074" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]Melasti Ceremony A few days before Nyepi, Balinese Hindus gather for the Melasti Ceremony, a purification ritual held on the beaches. Dressed in traditional attire, families carry sacred objects from temples to the ocean, symbolising the cleansing of both the body and the earth from impurities. This vibrant and spiritual procession is a must-see for those in Bali during this time.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="68075" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]Ogoh-Ogoh Parade On the eve of Nyepi, villages across Bali and Nusa Lembongan come alive with the Ogoh-Ogoh Parade. Gigantic, intricately designed paper-mâché effigies representing demons and evil spirits are carried through the streets in a lively procession. The night culminates in the burning of these statues, symbolising the purification of negative elements and a fresh start for the New Year. This parade is a highlight of Nyepi celebrations and a captivating experience for visitors.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

NYEPI DAY RESTRICTIONS

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="68076" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]From 6 AM on 29th March until 6 AM on 30th March, Bali and Nusa Lembongan observe complete silence. During this 24-hour period, the following restrictions are enforced:
  • No lights or electricity – homes and accommodations keep lighting minimal or off.
  • No work – businesses close, and daily activities pause.
  • No entertainment or noise – including music, television, and outdoor activities.
  • No travel – roads are empty as locals and tourists stay within their accommodations.
  • No cooking or eating (for some) – devout Hindus observe fasting.
While these practices are rooted in Hindu traditions, all residents and tourists are expected to follow them. On Nusa Lembongan, the observance of Nyepi is even stricter than in Bali, with most accommodations operating with minimal or no staff and without power for the entire day. Visitors should prepare accordingly and respect the local customs.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

HOW TO PREPARE FOR NYEPI DAY

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="68077" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]To ensure a smooth and respectful Nyepi experience, consider the following preparations:
  • Stock up on food and essentials in advance – supermarkets and restaurants will be closed.
  • Charge your devices – power may be limited or unavailable in some accommodations.
  • Plan for a quiet, restful day – bring books, journals, or meditation guides.
  • Respect the silence – keep noise levels minimal and remain indoors.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

BOAT SCHEDULE CHANGES

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]For those travelling to or from Nusa Lembongan, please note:
  • No boats will operate on 29th March 2025.
  • A revised schedule will apply on 28th March.
  • Normal boat services will resume on 30th March.
For further details or bookings, please WhatsApp +61 478 928 925.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]Nyepi is a profound and beautiful tradition that showcases Bali’s deep spiritual roots. Whether you’re a resident or a visitor, embracing this day of stillness offers a rare opportunity to pause, reflect, and connect with the serene energy of the island. We trust all guests will honour and respect this sacred occasion, making it a memorable part of their Balinese experience.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Title: The Tamarind Resort Nusa Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

The Tamarind Resort Nusa Lembongan  - The new kid on the block

The Tamarind Resort, is Nusa Lembongan's newest resort and is delivering fantastic accommodation and facilities, giving Lembongan visitors another choice when it comes to  affordable villas and luxury suites. Within hours of arriving we felt very much “at home”, the staff are delightful and offer an in-room check in service so you are immediately in the air-conditioned comfort of your suite or villa. Resort Overview: 3 villas, 12 suites, 2 infinity pools, kids pool, restaurant, gym, day spa, suitable for families & couples [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]Located on the hill in Jungut Batu, a short 2 minute walk to the beach front and lots of restaurants, The Tamarind Resort Nusa Lembongan is perfectly situated, especially for those who prefer not to use scooters as everything is in walking distance. Named after a 300+ year old Tamarind tree which canopies the reception, the tree has dutifully been protected and also thoughtfully incorporated into elements of the guest experience to give significance of its importance. The Tamarind Resort has all the facilities and services of a large resort yet offers the intimacy of a boutique hotel.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="31091" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=""]Room options vary depending on the view, with luxury spacious suites Candrika, Atapa and Pavana  ( from AU$220 / night)  all having the same features, including super comfortable beds, Satellite TV, desk, sofa bed ( which can be used as an extra bed) and private balconies.  The Villas are available as 2 or 3 bedroom options, and all open out onto the top level guest infinity pool with views of turquoise waters, surf breaks and beyond to Bali and Mt Agung. The two infinity pools (and a kids pool) give you plenty of options to lounge poolside, and when you are ready to take the holiday mode to the next level the Amlika Day Spa provides divine massages and other exquisite treatments. For the active ones in the family, the resort gym is the answer and is one of the best fitted out gym’s we have ever been to, it has got EVERTHING you need, so there is no excuses not to burn off a few cocktail calories![/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="30563" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]All in all we are huge fans of The Tamarind Resort, here is what we really LOVED:
  • The generous ala carte breakfast menu ( Smashed avo was our favourite)
  • Gorgeous bed linen & "tiffany" blue pool towels
  • Environmental responsible approach thru out the resort
  • Feeling of space and privacy
  • Tuna Tartar (and everything on the menu!) at Indica Restaurant
  • WIFI was reliable and fast ( a must when you have to work on holidays)
  [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="31090" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Title: Lembongan's Best Beaches
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_bottom="32" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Let us take you on a tour of Lembongan's best beaches.

Nusa Lembongan and neighbouring island Ceningan have beautiful beaches, making it a water lover's paradise for holiday makers.  There are beaches suitable for families with young children, snorkelling, surfing, catching some sun-rays, beachcombing & beachside bintangs! The waters surrounding Nusa Lembongan are crystal clear with incredible visibility found in few places around the world. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="32" padding_bottom="32" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Jungutbatu Beach

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="69086" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]This is the main bay in Nusa Lembongan, where the majority of boats from Bali arrive. It is home to Lembongan’s 3 surf breaks (Playgrounds, Lacerations & Shipwrecks) and is also great for SUP boarding. The northern stretch is ideal for "beach-time" with its white sand and turquoise waters, the inner lagoon is generally calm & protected by the outer reef. There are plenty of beachfront restaurants where you can dine with your feet in the sand and enjoy a Bintang or cocktail or two! The perfect place to also watch Lembongan's beautiful sunsets. Jungutbatu has the largest range of accommodation in regards to budget and style options including private villas, some of Lembongan's most popular resorts & great value beachfront bungalows.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="32" padding_bottom="32" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Coconut Beach

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="69087" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Considered by many as Lembongan's BEST beach, Coconut Beach is nestled between Jungutbatu and Tamarind Bay. It is a favourite with everyone, ideal for families with kids who want to swim and play on the beach (there is also shade under the trees), perfect for snorkelling, and the place for surfers to paddle out to Playgrounds or onto Lacerations surf breaks. We have a range of villas, resorts & bungalows all in close walking distance or it can be accessed from Tamarind Bay via a track around the headland. If you are staying in Jungutbatu on "the hill" this will be your local beach.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="32" padding_bottom="32" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Tamarind Bay

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="69088" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Located between Coconut Beach and Mushroom Bay, the beach is best suited for swimming and snorkelling on mid to high tide. The far northern end has a beautiful mini lagoon which is accessible on all tides, making it a stunning spot for beach lovers staying in Tamarind Bay.  It is a great bay for SUP boarding, and on a larger swell a fun left hand wave can form from the headland across the middle of the bay.  We have a range of Villas & Bungalow style accommodation in Tamarind Bay which are all in walking distance to the beach. Many of TLT's private villas are primely located on the beachfront of Tamarind Bay.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="32" padding_bottom="32" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Mushroom Bay

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="69089" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Renowned by many as the most protected beach and most suitable for children, great for swimming , SUP boarding & snorkelling.  The northern end has an all-day dedicated swimming area as there are commercial boats bringing visitors into the bay. There are some great beach front restaurants to enjoy, offering bean bags and relaxed feet in the sand style hospitality. Mushroom Bay also has a great range of accommodation including, private Villas, Resorts and Bungalows.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="32" padding_bottom="32" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Sandy Bay

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="69090" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Sandy Bay is home to Sandy Bay Beach Club and some of Lembongan's favourite private villas.  Sandy Bay is not a swimming beach, with large swells and strong currents. However, on mid-low tide it is the perfect for kids playing in the sand and rock pools.  Sandy Bay Beach Club also offers an all day beach club and is renowned for it's spectacular sunsets.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="32" padding_bottom="32" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Dream Beach

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="35450" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Dream Beach is a stunning beach for relaxing, swimming is only advised for the experienced, as there can be rips, large swell and tides. It is a favourite stop off point for day trip visitors, so if you are looking for some solitude it is best to visit early mornings and late afternoons.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="32" padding_bottom="32" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Secret Beach at Mahana Point

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="69091" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Located at the southern end of Nusa Ceningan. Secret Beach is a stunning cove of sandy white beach, a crystal clear waters that fill the rock pools and lagoons. If you have a scooter, this should be on your list, especially if you have a partner who is an experienced surfer as it overlooks Mahana Point surf break. We list a range of villas and bungalows on Nusa Ceningan.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]Please take care at all times as the waters surrounding Nusa Lembongan are renowned for extreme tidal movements and strong currents. We love our beaches and hope you will enjoy some Lembongan's best beaches on your next holiday to Bali.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

Title: Jipsi Beach House - Villa Life
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Jipsi Beach House

Jipsi Beach House is one of Nusa Lembongan’s most popular private villas since being renovated and transformed into “your quintessential” beach house.  Set on an incredible 2000 square metre beachfront block with expanses of manicured lawns and lush tropical gardens, it is the ultimate island oasis for families and friends to enjoy holiday time.  [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]Jipsi Beach House, is nestled in the northern corner of Tamarind Bay with direct access to white sandy shores and turquoise waters on your door step where a snorkel, SUP or surf will become part of your daily ritual.  If the ocean doesn’t call you in, the 10m infinity pool definitely will, and know doubt you will spend hours on the poolside lounges reading whilst soaking up the endless summer sunshine under the palms trees.  Guests are spoilt for choices to fill their RnR routine at Jipsi House Beach, and are forgiven for never wanting to leave the premise as it truly feels like your own private resort. Starting each day with majestic Mt Agung in full view  (pending clouds!) and the soothing energy of Nusa Lembongan’s natural beauty is guaranteed to have you quickly feeling relaxed and recharged. The Jipsi Beach House team of staff will ensure your holiday will be stress free and loaded with subtle luxuries that make Jipsi Beach House the ultimate private villa experience. [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="39265" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]The main residence has 3 bedrooms with spacious ensuites, kitchen and living area, all opening out onto the timber deck that surrounds the villa & is shaded by the canopy of magnificent follage  & beautiful flowers of the established orchid trees. The 4th bedroom, is a stand alone bungalow, with private ensuite and balcony stepping down to the lawns that extend beyond to the pool deck.  The stunning interiors of white timber, crisp linen, cottons, indoor plants, teak furniture & special personal touches combine to make you feel that this is YOUR home away from home.  Once you have soaked up the Jipsi Beach House life of relax, enjoy, repeat you may consider exploring Nusa Lembongan and surrounding islands of Nusa Ceningan & Nusa Penida!! There is so much to see & do that it deserves another whole new blog !!! ( see the PLAY section on our website ).  https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/play/ [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="39267" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=""]You will probably need to plan another visit as you will be amazed by how much you fall in love with this beautiful island paradise . The combination of Nusa Lembongan’s laid back village vibe, incredibly friendly & hospitable locals and the vast options of accommodation available make it a favourite for couples, solo travellers and families travelling with kids.      TLT Tip – as we have limited accommodation and NOT the over supply of beds as Bali does, it's important to book early, with some places booking up 12 months in advance.  Contact our team of Lembongan experts to help you plan your next island escape.  For more information Phone / Whats App: +61 478 928 925 Email: holiday@thelembongantraveller.com[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="39266" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Stepping it up at White Horse Retreat

Welcome to White Horse Retreat, Nusa Lembongan’s latest luxury accommodation which has set the standards to new levels and will be a challenge to beat.  This incredible property mixes colonial Caribbean opulence with modern chic interiors. Combining to give guests a true sense of a worldly experience that you often only dream about. It is very clear this has been a project of passion as the attention to detail, added extras and simple touches are quick to capture your interest. 

We personally completely adore the exquisite interiors. Who doesn’t love marble bench tops, decks, white timber panelling, shutters, soft cottons, wicker and Asian influenced furnishings?  The mix of textures & materials creatively unify the internal spaces, all of which are oversized and have been designed to complement the impeccable style of White Horse Retreat.

Title: Andaya House - This is HEAVEN
Content: [vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]Grand entrances are the BEST!!  When you walk through the oversized teak pivot door to enter Andaya House you are immediately struck by the line of sight that takes you down the 15m infinity pool and into the turquoise waters beyond.  Andaya House has been designed with precision to take advantage of its incredible location, with front row seats to Playgrounds surf break (and beyond to Lacerations and Shipwrecks), views of Mt Agung and the northern stretch of Jungut Batu Beach. If you think the outdoor features of Andaya House are breath-taking then you will be further awe-struck by the stunning interiors which have a subtle elegance that combine raw materials and luxury finishings.  On the lower level, limestone rock walls and natural stone paving surrounding the pool areas.  From here you step into 4 master bedrooms with iron wood floors, adjoining ensuites and open air showers. Teak furniture, timber artefacts, rattan baskets, sea grass matts and crisp linen meld together to create the soul of Andaya House.  This stunning private villa successfully delivers the ultimate guest experience of holidaying in a home away home. The upper level is where you will dine, relax in the lounge area or perhaps take time out after a day of island activities in the airconditioned media room. Andaya House is perfect for couples or families, sleeping up to 10 people.  A definite highlight for many will be: mum sitting in the infinity pool watching hubby and the kids getting waves.  Or if the kids aren’t surfers, you have gorgeous Coconut beach on your doorstep and home to; Lago Beach Cafe, white sands, shady trees and the perfect place to swim, snorkel or SUP (stand up paddle board). Andaya House definitely sets itself on a pedestal as one of Nusa Lembongan’s most beautiful private villas, we highly recommend you sample this slice of heaven for yourself. Title: Food for Lembongan Families
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

FOOD FOR LEMBONGAN FAMILIES

As the owners of The Lembongan Traveller we feel compelled to rally our community of loyal supporters to help assist with raising funds to buy food for Lembongan families. With tourism and the local economy being brought to a stand still due to COVID-19, the locals have been severely impacted with wide spread loss of jobs & income.  The campaign is aimed to reach as many families as possible by supplying rice and oil which makes up an integral part of their daily staples. GIVE NOW We understand that COVID-19 has touched everyone and we are all facing extremely difficult times, but if you can give any small amount from your family it will go a long way to helping a Lembongan family.  All donations are greatly appreciated. We have partnered with Bali Children Foundation, who we successfully worked with to administer the money we raised after the Yellow Bridge collapse to the affected families and into the community via their environmental and educational programs. Our team of staff based on the ground in Lembongan have helped us formulate this program, will administer the purchasing of supplies and oversee the distribution process. We thank you all in advance, on behalf of the people of Nusa Lembongan & Ceningan for support the Food for Lembongan Families fundraiser... they can not wait to welcome you back to their island home once travel can resume. Donations can be made via PayPal or Credit Credit card via the campaign link below, or  please email us on holiday@thelembongantraveller.com for either IDR or AUD bank account details and your donation will be added to the campaign as an offline contribution. This FOOD FOR LEMBONGAN FAMILIES campaign is aimed to reach as many families as possible by supplying rice, noodles and oil which makes up an integral part of their daily staples.  We will keep the fundraiser open so people can continue to make donations. DONATE NOW Below are updates regarding the campaign, also posted on the fundraiser platform. From our family to yours we say THANK YOU xx [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]UPDATE - 12 MAY 2020 We are on our way to getting your generous support to the Lembongan locals. We have ordered 1000 cloth masks ( made in Bali) and are co-ordinating the logistics to arrange 600+ food packages for families, consisting of 10kg bag of rice, noodles, eggs and oil. The plan is to have things in place for an end of May / early June distribution. Thank you again for opening your hearts and digging deep for the Lembongan community. Together we are making a difference.  Take care and Happy Mothers Day to all our Island loving mummas. Tania & TLT Team xx DONATE NOW[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="43496" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]UPDATE - 01 MAY 2020 Hi All, WOW a lot happens in a couple days!! Thanks to your generosity we have surpassed our latest target of $10,000 and are currently on $11,500 (hence the reset of the target to $15,000). This is truly incredible and well beyond any of our expectations. With the current tally we will be able to reach over 550 families with food packages. Please know we are in daily contact with our team and friends in Lembongan and they are so grateful for the out-pouring of support. As there are plans from another fundraiser to do handouts in the week ahead, it has been decided that we wait to do distribution later in May / June, this has been a decision made as a group with consultation with locals and Bali Children Foundation. The road ahead without tourism on Lembongan is going to be hard for them all, we feel it is best to manage the support we can give so it is spread out, rather then given immediately. Thanks again from our family to yours, take care and stay well. These are difficult times for everyone, but you have all shown so much support and spirit with your generosity towards the Lembongan community - we are truly humbled and blessed. We have just tipped our second target of $7500 and on our way now to $10,000. We understand you have trusted us with your donations and for the money to be spent well. We can confirm: - 100% of the money raised will go to buying food supplies, no admin fees from us or Bali Children Foundation - we will be buying food supplies locally on Lembongan across a range of outlets on the island - we will be including residents from other islands who live permanently on Lembongan as part of the distribution - distributions will be include both Nusa Lembongan & Ceningan residents - funds raised are held with Bali Children Foundation and they will be administering payments of supplies on receipt of invoices via bank transfers Thank you again from us at TLT and local Lembongan community. Title: The Gift of Giving - Together we made a difference
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]In mid April this year it was becoming more and more apparent that it was not COVID-19 the virus, but the economic impact that is the greatest threat to the people of Bali & Lembongan. We felt compelled to rally our community of loyal Lembongan lovers and action the gift of giving, to help assist families on Nusa Lembongan and Nusa Ceningan. With tourism and the local economy being brought to a stand still due to COVID-19, the locals have been severely impacted with wide spread loss of jobs & income.  The Lembongan Traveller partnered with Island Protect & Bali Children Foundation to launch the Food For Lembongan Families fundraiser campaign aimed to help as many families as possible. [gallery columns="5" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/AKA_6105.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/AKA_6131.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/AKA_6103.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/AKA_6229.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/AKA_6101.jpg|"] It has been incredibly humbling to see the generosity of people, considering that no-one has been untouched by COVID-19, people have been digging deep during these difficult to support the Lembongan community. The Lembongan Traveller's team of staff on the ground in Lembongan have co-ordinated the logistics and distribution, meeting with both Kepala Desa in Lembongan and Jungut Batu villages to ensure we reach the people who are in most need. [gallery columns="5" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/WhatsApp-Image-2020-06-02-at-16.00.58.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/AKA_6226.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/WhatsApp-Image-2020-06-02-at-14.17.11.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/AKA_6208.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/WhatsApp-Image-2020-06-02-at-16.01.06.jpeg|"] T H A N K  Y O U  to everyone who donated & supported our Food For Lembongan Families fundraiser.  Thanks to your generosity we toppled our initial target of $5000 and with $15,000+ funds raised and were able to reach 600 families with Stage 1 of food packages and completed Stage 2 with delivery of fresh vegetables, tempeh & tofu (made locally in Lembongan) to 200 elderly and families with young children. These packages have been gratefully received and your support has reached so many in the Lembongan community with 800 families receiving packages from Stage 1 & 2 distributions. [gallery columns="5" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/AKA_6194.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/WhatsApp-Image-2020-06-02-at-16.02.55-2.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/AKA_6188.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/WhatsApp-Image-2020-06-02-at-14.08.45.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/AKA_6184.jpg|"] The Stage 1 food packages included  – 10kg bag rice, noodles, eggs, oil & cloth masks.  The masks were made by woman in Bali and the supplies were purchased from over 20 different warungs on Lembongan.  Packages were delivered this week to families across 10 Banjars on Nusa Lembongan & Ceningan and included migrant/ non-local workers who do not have the support of family networks. The locals have sent so many messages of  gratitude.  Together we made a difference and these photos are a true reminder of the gift of giving.  From our Lembongan family to yours THANK YOU again.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_bottom="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Title: Food for Lembongan Families - Stage 2
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Food for Lembongan Families

Thanks to your donations we have completed Stage 2 with delivery of fresh vegetables, tempeh & tofu (made locally in Lembongan) to 200 elderly and families with young children. These packages have been gratefully received and your generosity has reached so many in the Lembongan community with 800 families receiving packages from stage 1 & 2 distributions.  
A massive thanks must go to The Lembongan Traveller, Tenang Villas, Beach Tonic & Villa Lagarto staff for their incredible dedication & effort in co-ordinating all aspects of distribution for the fundraiser - we are family .   We are privileged to have partnered with Bali Children Foundation & Island Protect who have provided guidance & support throughout the fundraising campaign.
