Title: LOVE for Lembongan - Wrapping Up 2021
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]As 2021 comes to an end, we reflect on the challenges that have been faced by so many people here on Lembongan and incredible impact Love for Lembongan has had on so many..  Our “village of Lembongan lovers“ (you)  have rallied, opening your hearts to support those most in need.  Thanks to your donations the “Love for Lembongan” campaigns by The Lembongan Traveller, Lembongan Island Beach Villas and Tigerlilly’s have raised over $100,000.  An overwhelming result and show of support considering you have all been touched in some way by COVID-19. We have so many positives to share with you, all a direct result of your tremendous generosity.  We have been able to implement a number of instrumental initiatives all guided and supported by our inspiring charity partner, Bali Children Foundation (BCF).  Special mentioned must go to their founder, Margaret Barry for her tiresome dedication to helping the Lembongan community.

[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down='']

[/vc_column_text][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

EDUCATION - Remedial Literacy & Numeracy – Calistung Program (CLT)

The idea of a CLT program was first discussed at the beginning of 2021 when we recognised the impact of school closures during COVID-19 was having on the literacy of children in grades 1, 2 & 3.  Schools have only recently re-opened resulting in nearly 18 months of school “online”, which is done via Whats App. BCF developed CLT,  in line with the National Indonesian curriculum, to focus on remedial literacy, numeracy and writing.  It was a seed planted in Lembongan which has now been implemented in 15 primary schools across Bali.  By January 2022 we will have launched CLT in all 5 primary schools on Lembongan and Ceningan. Prior to launching the program in schools, BCF conducted testing for 2nd and 3rd graders on each of the remedial subjects to gauge the need on a grade and school basis. We learned that the grade 3 students were the furthest behind due to the increased expectation in knowledge from grade 2, which they missed. It also discovered areas of weakness among children in all three subjects that varied between schools. CLT uses interactive and engaging material with a student centric model which allows BCF teachers to provide an ideal learning environment.   In addition to developing the CLT program, BCF have also began upgrading school libraries to provide a better learning space for the children participating in the CLT course. This process involves cleaning the old library, repainting the walls with child friendly images, providing multimedia equipment (projectors or tv), adding in a sitting space of carpet and colourful cushions, refreshing the library with new books which are labelled, inputted into a library record system and organised categorically on the shelves. We are proud to have seen this program grow from infancy to fruition.  Your donations have given the next generation the opportunity for an education they deserve to ensure they prosper later in life.[/vc_column_text][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

ENVIRONMENT – Lembongan Community Garden

The Lembongan Community Garden was established to demonstrate new sustainable agriculture opportunities for the people of Lembongan. The aim is to expand the range of foods grown on the island and to offer a way for families to develop their own gardens.   The Community Garden will be used as a way for children and families on the island who would like to try permaculture. The experimental stage will last 6 months, after which a timeline will be developed for permaculture education for children and their families and the opportunity to participate in their own gardens. Compost developed at the Lembongan Recycling Centre is vital to ensure the long-term establishment of permaculture on the island.  A hammer-mill was installed and a small number of local stakeholders are involved in the early stage of providing green, dried and food waste for the composting program.   We see this as a key initiative to offering sustainable practices for the community, especially as tourism returns.  Thanks to the generosity of many, this initiative was also funded by the LOVE for LEMBONGAN campaigns.   [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

HEALTH - Home visits, health checks & care packages

In November we teamed up with island angel Ibu Nyoman ( affectionately known as Bunda), who has been a nurse and midwife at the Jungut Batu Hospital for 35 years, plus operates her own private clinic.  Her intimate knowledge of Lembongan community health is crucial in us reaching those most in need. Over four weeks of Sundays ( Bunda’s day off from the hospital)  we reached more than 200 people which included:
  • Home visits to the elderly and disabled who cannot otherwise reach medical treatment. These visits included health checks, medication and care packages.
  • Health packages for pregnant mothers to be and breasting mums, providing them with vitamins, juices and formula.
Some of the most prevalent conditions that we saw include:
  • Hypertension
  • Diabetes resulting in blindness and in some cases amputation
  • Physical disabilities resulting from trauma & unknown causes
From these visits we have identified a list of priority patients in urgent need of new mobility aids, braces and ideally therapy. BCF have contacted Annika Linden Centre (specialists in providing disability support) on our behalf and are currently in talks with them to arrange a visit to Lembongan to assess the “priority patients”. We have also reported an extremely high number of elderly on Lembongan and Ceningan who are at home, bed-ridden requiring full time care and unable to access basic medical support.  As a result BCF will be instigating talks with the Health Department to see how this can be mitigated going forward and hopefully steps  can be established for support of the elderly from a government level.   [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

FOOD RELIEF – for Lembongan 

The initial key objective for the “LOVE for Lembongan” fundraising campaign was to provide immediate food relief to families on Nusa Lembongan.  Having no tourism on the island since March 2020, it is understandable how the lives of so many have been hugely affected. Life savings have been drained, assets liquidated for very little in return to try and meet the challenge of covering basic living expenses. Putting food on the table is a daily struggle for so many families. We first reached out to our network of “Lembongan Lovers” (you) back in April 2020, immediately you reached deep and donated to support the Lembongan community.  We were overwhelmed with the response from day one and together over 18 months you have continued to give generously. Thanks to your donations LOVE for Lembongan campaigns via The Lembongan Traveller, Tigerlillys and Lembongan Island Beach Villas have provided consistent food relief for the 8000 population of Nusa Lembongan and Ceningan. There have been over 5000 Sembako packages gifted to families, these packages included basic food staples; rice, noodles, oil, onions and sugar. We work alongside local stakeholders, business owners, village heads and community groups to ensure packages are received by those most in need.  Databases have been kept to log recipients with their local ID numbers.  We also reached the migrant workers who live here from Sumba, Sulawesi and other islands who have not be able to return home to the support of their extended families and are not registered under the Lembongan village system. Acknowledging that the financial impact of COVID is also preventing many people from being to afford gas to cook with, the team at Tigerlilly’s opened up their kitchen and prepared over 1000 Nasi Jinggo ( pre-prepared meals). These were distributed by scooter across both islands, given to those most in need of a freshly cooked meal. The logistics of packing and delivery up to 700 packages across Nusa Lembongan and Ceningan in a day has been an incredible team effort from our volunteers on the ground. With over 50 kind hearted locals from The Lembongan Traveller, Tigerlillys, Lembongan Island Beach Villas, Tenang Villas, Bali Children Foundation and the wonderful Lembongan Surf Team members all lending a hand to help their community.   [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

COMMUNITY – Health checks, education & yoga for pregnant mums

To celebrate Indonesian Mother’s Day ( 22 December ) we partnered with our island angel Bunda and Tonic Body & Soul Day Spa to create a special workshop for pregnant mums on Lembongan. The workshop provided mums with health checks, an educational talk followed by a gentle yoga practice and healing sound journey, giving the mums space to recharge and connect within. It was an incredibly beautiful morning, the LOVE for LEMBONGAN team honoured the pregnant mums with a stunning flower mandala and gifted them with care packages that included food staples, supplements and vitamins to help them through their pregnancy. Gratitude to Bunda, Tonic Body & Soul Day Spa and our LOVE for LEMBONGAN team for creating a special Mother’s Day celebrations for our island mums-to-be. The LOVE for LEMBONGAN fundraising campaign will remain open and an ongoing entity where we will direct support to the areas in the community most needed at the time.

Lagoon LUXE on Ceningan

Villa Lagoon on Ceningan instantly takes your breath away, awakening your senses to the beauty of nature, simplicity and elegance. [gallery columns="4" size="medium" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.47.08.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.45.34-1.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.44.57-1.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.44.54-1.jpeg|"] This brand new 3 bedroom, 3 bathroom property overlooks the channel and beyond to Nusa Lembongan. Designed with sophistication, it embraces comfort, seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor chill out zones. [gallery columns="4" size="medium" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.49.26.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.49.12.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.44.58-1.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.44.52-1.jpeg|"] With a soft muted palette on a white canvas, the introduction of matt black accents creates a style that blends perfectly with the natural beauty of the villa’s waterfront location.  Divine soft furnishings combine with ornamental details to create a sense of home and subtle luxury unique to Villa Lagoon on Ceningan. [gallery size="medium" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.49.22.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.45.36-2.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.48.58-1.jpeg|"] Each of the 3 bedroom suites look out over the living area, to the terrazzo free formed pool and everchanging landscape of the channel.  On high tide the water sparkles a sea of turquoise, inviting you to cool off via the steps that lead directly from the villa. Cool ocean breezes flow through out the villa as you move outside to the Mediterranean inspired pool deck. This area is dedicated to island mode, holiday vibes and centred around a stunning shaded sunken lounge that adjoins the pool. [gallery size="medium" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.48.59-2.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.49.19-1.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.49.07-1.jpeg|"] During our stay, as the sun settled, low tide approached, changing the landscape from blue waters to a green of seaweed farms.  This tidal movement marks the start of the working day for the seaweed farmers, providing a back drop of island life in full process. It is humbling to watch the locals, mostly elderly, tending to their farms, nurturing crops and collecting harvests to then dry and on-sell. [gallery size="medium" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.49.24.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.49.06-1.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/WhatsApp-Image-2022-02-22-at-09.49.10-2.jpeg|"] Perfect for families and couples, Villa Lagoon Ceningan is close to some of our favourite restaurants including: Sea Breeze and Next Level Café. And a short scooter to the famed Blue Lagoon and nearby Mahana Point surf break. [gallery columns="4" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/IMG_6001-copy.jpg|Seabreeze,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/IMG_8395.jpg|Next Level,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/DSC04789-scaled-e1581649196459.jpg|Mahana Point,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/WhatsApp-Image-2021-01-30-at-14.54.04-2.jpeg|Blue Lagoon Ceningan"] Villa Lagoon Ceningan oozes simple elegance whilst also embodying the true essence of island life, a dichotomy rare to find and a privilege to experience. Title: Priority Patients Program
Content:

PRIORITY PATIENTS PROGRAM

As tourism returns, our work with “Love for Lembongan” and support of the community continues. Whilst food relief was initially our focus we are now moving into providing more sustainable support via our Priority Patience Program. At the end of 2021 we partnered with island angel BUNDA to provide health care and medical checks to the elderly and disabled.  During these visits we identified priority patients who were in need of further assistance. Thanks to your donations, over the last few months LOVE for LEMBONGAN has been able to provide the following: [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_single_image image="50617" img_size="medium" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_bottom="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_single_image image="50618" img_size="medium" alignment="center" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text]

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_single_image image="50627" img_size="medium" alignment="center" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text]

Lembongan’s Favourite Resort is BACK

Bali is back and so is Lembongan Island Beach Villas.  As one of the original resorts on Nusa Lembongan it is has built a strong reputation amongst visitors as an island favourite. [gallery columns="6" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/bedroom-206-scaled.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/dining-area-206-scaled.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/balcony-area-scaled.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/Plunge-pool-view-scaled.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/twin-room-206-scaled.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/TGX09447-scaled.jpg|"] [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text]With it’s relaxed charm and friendly staff, Lembongan Island Beach Villas exudes the essence of Nusa Lembongan. Title: Why we LOVE Sandy Bay
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Why we LOVE Sandy Bay

Sandy Bay is one of Lembongan’s most iconic destinations.  It is home to white sands, rolling waves ( not the surfing kind), famous sunsets, the iconic Sandy Bay Beach Club and private villas to suit all budgets. Take a stroll and swim in the beautiful azure waters at Dream Beach located next to the famed Devils Tear.  Here you will be able to spot turtles and rainbows in the mist of the blow holes, always take caution with respect for the power of the ocean. Mushroom Bay is a short scooter ride from Sandy Bay where you can swim, snorkel and relax in the beachfront restaurants.  One of our favourites is Hai Bar and Grill who also offer a handy complimentary pick up and drop off service.

Title: Love for Lembongan Update August 2022
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

The power of community

We feel it is time to reach out and once again thank all of our incredibly generous donors to the Love for Lembongan fundraiser.  Your support through out COVID was nothing short of amazing and gave the local Lembongan so much; in the form of food relief, remedial literacy and numeracy programs, community health checks, providing medication to the disadvantaged and environmental initiatives which included the development of a community garden. [gallery columns="4" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/WhatsApp-Image-2021-11-02-at-1.13.37-PM-1.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/WhatsApp-Image-2021-10-31-at-12.13.14-PM.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/WhatsApp-Image-2021-10-31-at-12.15.05-PM-Copy.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/WhatsApp-Image-2021-10-31-at-12.10.46-PM-1.jpeg|"] [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]More importantly you gave HOPE.  It was this sense of family and support that helped sustain them during a time of immense challenges, the locals knew they had people from afar caring about them. Love for Lembongan, with the guidance from Bali Children Foundation, was the vehicle behind implementing programs that touched the entire community, giving ongoing support to the 8000 people living on Nusa Lembongan and Ceningan. This included distributing over 30 tonnes of rice and other essential dry goods, all bought locally and creating an important injection of funds back into the community in the process. As we move forward into the next phase, Love for Lembongan is focused on supporting community initiatives that are sustainable and beneficial for the longer-term.  We will also continue to support those most in need. [gallery columns="4" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/WhatsApp-Image-2021-08-16-at-10.48.38-AM-e1640571295685.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/IMG_3105-scaled.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/IMG_3131-scaled.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/WhatsApp-Image-2021-10-31-at-12.09.28-PM.jpeg|"] [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]Sadly, last week a local family lost their two bedroom house and kitchen in a fire, destroying everything they owned.  The family of four  ( two children aged 5 & 8 years) have had support from family and friends, however, as you can imagine they are without many standard house hold items.  Our team met with the family this week and have gathered a better understanding of how we can assist them.  Donations are welcome and can made via the link below or if you are on Lembongan, touch base with our team at The Lembongan Traveller office in Jungut Batu. Let us take you on a Lembongan food journey. Jungut Batu is the main tourist area on Lembongan with endless accommodation  and restaurants located on the waterfront, offering live music, kids activities, menus designed for the health conscious PLUS  great drinks for those who love a cold bintang and delicious cocktails.
Mushroom, Sandy Bay and Lembongan Village also have a great range of restaurants we love too and can also highly recommend.
Grab a scooter and cross the Yellow Bridge for a day of adventures on Nusa Ceningan discovering Mahana Point and Blue Lagoon.  Be sure to stop in for a feed and refreshments at one of our favourite Ceningan restaurants.

Title: FAQ Nusa Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Frequently Asked Questions

Planning a holiday takes time and energy. The Lembongan Traveller team are  here to help to make it as stress free as possible.  Below we answer some of your FAQ about travelling to Nusa Lembongan.[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Can I have early check in / late check out?

Early check in and late check out can be arranged if there is no one checking out or checking in on your dates.  For late check out, most properties will be more than happy to hold your bags so you can spend the day on Lembongan, standard check out time is 10am. Unless pre-arranged, check-in time is 2pm, we recommend catching the 2 or 5pm boat from Sanur so staff have time to prepare your room/villa.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="50439" img_size="medium" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=""]

Getting to and from Restaurants

Many restaurants on Lembongan offer a FREE pick up and drop off service.  This is very handy for families and also those wanting to have a couple of cocktails. Our Restaurant Guide has menus, locations and contact details for all our favourite restaurants on Nusa Lembongan & Nusa Ceningan.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="52610" img_size="medium" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=""]

What is your cancellation policy?

All payments are non-refundable as per terms and conditions detailed HERE.  Should you have a change of plans, illness, flight delays or cancellations these should be claimed via your travel insurer.  We recommend taking out travel insurance at the time of making your booking to ensure you are covered for any unforeseen circumstances.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="52702" img_size="medium" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Money Exchange, credit cards and ATMS on Nusa Lembongan?

There are a number of places you can exchange money on the island, including one on the main road in front of the Indiana gang in Jungut Batu.  Most resorts and restaurants accept credit cards, however cash is required for scooter hire, snorkelling and other day trips. There are a number of ATMs on Nusa Lembongan, but please note they have a limit on the amount you can withdraw and do sometimes run out of money. So best to bring some CASH from Bali![/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="42336" img_size="medium" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Will I get a refund for accommodation if my flight is delayed?

In these circumstances you need to make a claim with the airline or your travel insurer. We are more than happy to assist with documentation you require for this process.

What if I get COVID and can not travel?

Should you test positive to COVID and can not travel, you will need to claim with your travel insurer as you would with any other illness or medical condition.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="52701" img_size="medium" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

What time is the last boat from Bali to Lembongan?

The last boat leaves Sanur at 5pm, if you are arriving into Denpasar the same day we recommend ensuring your flight lands before 3pm to give you time to make it to the harbour in Sanur prior to 5pm. See link below for boat times. BOAT TRANSFERS[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="51758" img_size="medium" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

How do we get from the harbour in Lembongan to our accommodation?

The boat companies provide transport from the harbour to your accommodation.  Same on your return, the boat company will pick you up from your accommodation on the day of your departure.  Please ask the staff at your accommodation to confirm the pick up time with the boat company.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="52703" img_size="medium" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Is there a doctor on the island?

If you require medical attention whilst on Lembongan we recommend East Medical Clinic in Mushroom Bay, it is a private practice open 24 hours, 7 days a week.  Whats App +62 813 3955 5515.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="52780" img_size="medium" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Visa on Arrival

Visa On Arrival needs to be purchased at Denpasar airport prior to going through immigration. Ensure your passport has 6 months validity other wise you will not be able to travel to Indonesia.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="46012" img_size="medium" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Title: Diving in Nusa Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

PARADISE IS A PLACE UNDERWATER

The best way to observe fish is to become a fish. Nusa Lembongan diving provides underwater adventures that are jaw-dropping and hard to replicate. Thousands of different marine species roam the reefs and deliver spectacles that will be imprinted in your memories for a long time to come. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

THE 2 SEASONS

This turquoise utopia experiences two distinct seasons; the dry and wet seasons. Luckily, they are equally as good as each other. During the dry season (March – October) we experience cooler diving days. The water temperatures can drop below 20°C. On the flip side, during the wet season (November – February) the average temperatures are a toasty 25°C – 29°C.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="48537" img_size="medium" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

I'M COVINCED, SIGN ME UP

If you are Scuba certified, great. If not, no problem. Nusa Lembongan is home to many multilingual dive centres that are ready to welcome you. Offering fun dives, Scuba diving courses, and Discover Scuba diving experiences for those who are looking for a quick taste. That's right, you don’t need a Scuba certification to dive on Nusa Lembongan, simply the gusto to give it a try.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="50037" img_size="medium" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

IT'S ALL ABOUT THE JOURNEY

Nusa Lembongan is located in the heart of the surrounding marine sanctuary, providing easy access to numerous dive sites. All within a short boat ride away, you will be back in the early afternoon in time for a cold coconut on the beach. The coast is lined with tall palm trees and picturesque limestone cliffs. Safe to say, the commute could be worse. Paradise is a place underwater when diving in Nusa Lembongan.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="51163" img_size="medium" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

OH, THE PLACES YOU WILL GO

Manta Point, being the furthest, but the most breathtaking journey is where the famous reef Mantas spend their days. They dance in slow motion and put on performances, unlike anything you have ever seen. Snorkellers can get a piece of the action, too. Simply throw on your mask, snorkel, and fins, and watch the show from above. A must-do while visiting Nusa Lembongan. Vibrant, colourful, and abundant are the words most used to describe Crystal Bay. It is home to a variety of fish, sea turtles, and the elusive Mola-Mola. Be sure to bring a camera, you don’t want to miss the photo opportunities that lie around every corner. Heading further north is where we find the majority of our drift diving sites. The coast is filled with majestic sloping reefs, countless marine creatures, and the ride of a life time. Dropping below the surface is where it all begins. Mild to moderate currents usher us along the reef as we take in a live-action natural masterpiece.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="53247" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

ADVENTURE AWAITS

In our unique underwater world, there is something for everyone. Whether it is big, small, fat, or thin, whatever it is that you are looking for, we guarantee that you will find it while diving Nusa Lembongan. No matter your level, beginner or divemaster, you will be beaming once you get back to the surface. NOW is the time to contact a Dive Centre for more information about diving in Nusa Lembongan.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="25621" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Title: Nusa Lembongan Surf Guide
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]If you are looking for waves, look no further, surfing in Nusa Lembongan offers something for everyone. No matter your level, there are countless “best session of my life” kinds of days waiting for you. Nusa Lembongan has a few different surf breaks spread along our picturesque white sandy shores.  Let us take you on a virtual tour of the best surf breaks in Lembongan and when to surf them. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

CONDITIONS ARE EVERYTHING

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="69675" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text css=""]The surrounding surf spots are incredibly tidal and condition dependant. At one moment, the ocean can resemble a lake, and the next it will look like something out of your favourite surfing magazine. Strong currents are common around the higher tides, and extremely low tides will make most spots un-surfable. Be sure to take these factors into account before paddling out. If you are patient and choose the right window, you will score.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

HOW DO I GET TO THE WAVES?

The surf is accessible by paddling, or alternatively catch a ride with a surf taxi or go with a surf school.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="53366" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text css=""]

RESPECT THE LOCALS

The local surf crew on Lembongan are super experienced and know these waves like the back of their hands. They are friendly, they rip, and they will welcome you with open arms. No matter where we surf, the golden rule always applies; respect the locals. This is their home after all.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

FROTHING! SO, WHERE SHOULD I SURF TODAY?

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="69679" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text css=""]

SHIPWRECKS

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]In the 70s a boat wrecked on the reef and gave the surf spot its name, Shipwrecks. A right-hander that breaks in deeper water that provides barrels and long drawn-out walls on its day. Shippies is geared towards the more experienced surfer and is primarily a shortboard wave. On smaller days, beginner surfers will find some fun, too. We recommend surfing at mid-tide on either side of the swing. If you are feeling unsure, check in with the local boys, they will provide you with friendly, solid advice.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_empty_space][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

RAZORS

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]Just left of Shippies is Razors. A left-hander that is perfect for beginner surfers looking to up-skill or take a lesson. Razors can be surfed on either side of the tide swing but is best avoided when it gets too low. Long, sectioney walls are on repeat, so there will be enough fun for everyone. Remember to keep an eye out for the current that tends to creep in at a moment's notice.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_empty_space][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

LACERATIONS

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]A natural wave pool, Lacerations will throw some of the most perfect right-hand barrels you have ever seen. Hollow, steep, long, and just plain epic! When the swell kicks up, Lacerations is best left for the more advanced surfers. Nestled above a sharp reef, the take-off at Lassos can be gnarly, but if you make it, you are in for the ride of a life time. Best surfed at mid-tide on either side of the swing If spitting barrels is what you are looking for, then the lower it gets, the hollower it becomes. A reef kiss from Lacerations is not uncommon for the dare-devils out there.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_empty_space][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

LESS GNARLY LACERATIONS

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]On the flip side, when conditions are friendlier and more manageable, Lacerations is perfect for a lesson or a fun free surf. The local surf schools will be happy to take you and provide a memorable surfing experience. Lacerations peels down the line and ensures long right hand rides, and perhaps even the odd left. The name is intimidating, but worry not, everyone is welcome at Lacerations. Match the conditions of the day with your surf level, and you will find some fun waves.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_empty_space][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

PLAYGROUNDS

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]A dreamy A-Frame located a short paddle away from Coconut Beach, Playgrounds is a surfer's paradise. Split the peak with your mates and enjoy the breathtaking views of the limestone cliffs. On smaller days, Playgrounds can be enjoyed by any level of surfer. Having said that, when the swell turns up, Playgrounds is best enjoyed by those with more experience. Higher tides bring about strong currents, so surfing Playgrounds at mid-tide is your best bet. Make sure to take your last wave before the reef starts to show. This is, after all, one of the sharpest and most lively reefs on the island. Don't let the name fool you.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_empty_space][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

MAHANA POINT

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]Just over the Yellow Bridge, Mahana Point is found on Nusa Ceningan Island. A left-hand point break that delivers long, faster walls. Due to its location, Mahana Point picks up a lot more swell, and can therefore be bigger and more tricky. The wave breaks beach-break style without a channel on either side. If Lembongan is flat, take your scooter over the bridge and you are likely to find a wave at Mahana Point.  It’s also a great spot for non-surfers, with a Warung and great viewing area to watch surf. We hope this has inspired you to follow our mantra of eat, sleep, surf, repeat.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Title: Family Fun on Nusa Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

FAMILY FUN ON NUSA LEMBONGAN

Having a family fun on Nusa Lembongan is nothing short of a great idea. When it comes to filling your days with loads of family fun under the Indonesian sun; look no further, we've got you covered. Grab your hat, sunnies, and sunscreen. Let's go. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text]

MINI GOLF

Located across from the beach lies an island-style mini golf course that will bring hours of entertainment to the whole family. If you fancy an excellent feed followed by a game of 18 holes, head down to The Coconut Hut for the afternoon. Good vibes, good fun, and of course, some good old-fashioned family rivalry is what holidays are all about.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text]

SNORKELLING

Who doesn't love cruising the coastline on a boat with the family? Nusa Lembongan is not only famous for its world-class diving but also for its abundant, beautiful snorkelling sites. We will help you organize a private boat where you will visit a few different spots, including Manta Point. Keep your eyes peeled for dolphins, turtles, loads of colourful reef fish and Nemo too.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text]

DISCOVER SCUBA DIVING

No PADI, no problem. Seeing as you've travelled all this way, it would be rude not to visit the resident Manta Rays. Bring the family on an underwater adventure of a lifetime by joining in on Discover Scuba Dive. Offered by many dive shops on the island, anyone is welcome, aged 10 and up. A short pool session to learn the basics followed by two ocean dives will have you back in time for an afternoon nap on the beach.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="53830" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="51110" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="51170" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text]

BUGGY HIRE

Tour the island, family style in one of Nusa Lembongan's colourful gasoline cars. See the sites, stop for food, and take lots of pictures. Enjoy the breeze as you cruise down the narrow streets. Our buggies can access the best of what the island has to offer and will allow for the whole crew to stick together.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text]

SURF LESSONS

Nusa Lembongan is home to a variety of epic waves. It would be a shame not to go out and give it a shot. Book a family surf lesson with a local surf school, and enjoy the countless rides that are waitng for you. We guarantee hours of stoke and awesome memories that will last a lifetime. Suitable for the groms of the family as well as the older chargers.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text]

BEACH CLUBS

If you are looking for a fun-filled day at the pool, look no further than one of Nusa Lembongan’s oceanfront beach clubs. Let your hair down and splash around with the kids. Alternatively, make the most of the slow life whilst relaxing on a sun bed, sipping a coconut and snacking on scrumptious island goodness. Ohanas boasts a beautiful playground that will provide hours of fun and laughter for the kiddos. Keep in mind that most restaurants have wonderful children's menus, too.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="52084" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="52875" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="34191" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text]

SPA DAY

There is no better feeling than a spa day after spending hours out in the surf and sun. Treat yourself and your mini-me to a treatment at one of Lembongan’s day spas. Pedi’s and mani’s are always a favourite for some special mother and daughter time.  Not only will you walk out feeling pampered and fresh, but also ready for more island fun.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text]

FISHING TRIPS

If you fancy some fresh fish then you have come to the right island. Eat what you catch with one of Lembongan's  fishing charters that will take you to a few prime locations. Cast a line with the family (or make it a boys trip) and enjoy the thrill of reeling in your dinner. Nothing beats grilled fish cooked by your skipper and served at your villa.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=""]

WATER ADVENTURES

Wakeboarding on a lake is fun, but wakeboarding in the ocean is better. Spend a few hours practicing your skills and see who has the best moves. Enjoy a variety of other water activities including the banana boating, aquanuats and parasailing.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="51731" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="53797" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="51240" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text]

THE SWEET TOOTH

Nothing beats an ice cream or some cold gelato on a hot day. Especially when that hot day is on Nusa Lembongan. If your sweet tooth is getting the better of you, head on over to the Ohanas ice cream stand where you will find a wide variety of mouth-watering flavours that will tantalise your taste buds. Easily found on the main road in Jungut Batu, it would be hard to pass by and not pop in.

A short hop over to the other side of the island lies Sandy Bay, a beautiful slice of paradise. They too have a dedicated ice cream stand that will surely satisfy your and the kids cravings. Get comfy at their beachfront restaurant and watch the waves whilst enjoying your favourite flavours.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text]

Koa Donuts

A locally owned and family run treat shop serves up some of the most delicious donuts and assortment of cakes that you will find on this side of the equator. Triana, the mastermind behind KOA Donuts has dedicated herself to providing only the best and ensures that each bite will be as yummy as the last. If you or your children are having a birthday, or any other cause for celebration then be sure to get your customised cake from KOA Donuts. Choose your theme and consider it baked.

Triana also caters to the Vegan market and can work around other dietary restrictions, too.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text]

MOVIE UNDER THE STARS

Family fun on Nusa Lembongan doesn't have to end when the sun drops below the horizon. Join Hai Tide for a movie under the stars and take in the island skies, all whilst indulging on fantastic food. Enjoy a selection of old and new family-friendly movies before hitting the hay.

After an action-packed day, it is safe to say that Nusa Lembongan is the perfect place for endless family fun.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="53798" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="53799" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="53945" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=""]

PADEL

There’s something new for active families on the island with the arrival of Jungle Padel Lembongan. This vibrant padel club offers a fun and social way for parents, teens, and older kids to get moving together. Whether you’re trying padel for the first time or already a fan of the sport, it’s a great option for an energetic afternoon off the beach.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_column_text css=""]

SWIMMING LESSON

For families spending plenty of time in the water, Little Ripper’s Swim School provides swimming lessons for all ages and abilities. From young children learning the basics to adults wanting to improve confidence and technique, lessons can be arranged during your stay — a thoughtful way to combine holiday fun with essential water safety skills.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="74939" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][vc_single_image image="74940" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Title: Best Vegan Food on Nusa Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]In recent years, Bali has become a major hotspot for its progressive vegan food scene, and rightly so. Nusa Lembongan has followed suit and  has a few of its very own treasures. We have created a guide for the best vegan food on Nusa Lembongan, so your holiday will not only be sun-soaked but also loaded with yummy and memorable eats. So, sit back, relax, and enjoy the words that will eventually become a feast on your table.[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

THE PLAYFUL TABLE

Nusa Lembongan Island has a new kid on the block and they have certainly entered the vegan scene with a BANG. The Playful Table offers a small, yet delicious menu that will leave you craving more. Located in-between Tamarind Bay and Coconut Beach, they boast exquisite ocean views and are surrounded by lush greenery. The perfect place for a morning coffee, brunch with friends, or dinner under the stars. When visiting The Playful Table, we recommend ordering the "Surprise Me". This gives Chef Made the opportunity to create a one-of-a-kind, personalised dish, especially for you. Trust us, you will not regret it. The owner, Oria, has been visiting Nusa Lembongan since she was a little girl and thus has a deep connection with the island. She has built a team of passionate people who care deeply about providing the full dining experience. Chef Made brings tangible joy and positive energy into her kitchen. She uses fresh, locally sourced ingredients and produces from their own permaculture garden. Homemade is the religion, everything that makes its way onto your plate has been hand-crafted by her. The flavours are endless. Whats App - +62 811 3800 8432 MENU[/vc_column_text][vc_single_image image="54537" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

Ombak Zero Waste Cafe

Nothing beats feasting on scrumptious vegan goodness with your toes in the sand and eyes on the waves. Located on Jungut Batu beach, Ombak opened in 2018 and quickly became everyone's favourite oceanfront cafe. Nagi, the wonderful owner from Bali, started Ombak with the vision of maintaining a zero-waste policy as much as possible, to protect and conserve our beautiful island. Walking into Ombak is like stepping into your own sunny, salty living room. The team exudes happiness and welcomes guests with open hearts and bright smiles. Consistency is an Ombak trademark. The food is always outstanding! Nagi sources fresh ingredients that will send your tastebuds into a flavour-filled paradise. Not only is the final creation a hit, but most of their sauces, toppings, and desserts are 100% homemade, too. When ordering a coffee, get it with Ombak’s signature homemade coconut milk. It's made fresh, daily, without preservatives. Choosing a meal can be hard, luckily we have 3 meals in a day. A few crowd favourites include their vitamin-packed smoothie bowls, the marinated Tempeh Satay, or Vegan Nasi Campur. Did someone say dessert? We insist on trying the homemade Vegan Salted Caramel Tart. Don't ask why, just do it! You may even order a second one. Whats App +6281399099784

MENU

[/vc_column_text][vc_single_image image="54476" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

Bali Eco Deli

Located on the main drag of Jungut Batu, Bali Eco Deli was one of the first Western style cafes to open on the Island. A wonderful, shaded space with loads of foliage will give you the feeling of peace whilst enjoying a coffee, juice, or some tasty Vegan food. Valentin, originally from France has dedicated himself to serving organic, fresh food and avoids using MSG or any other high-preservative sauces and condiments. Eco-friendly by nature, the restaurant features a small on-site wastewater and solar-powered garden. The menu is vast and everything is inviting. We love the crunchy veggie Stir Fry served with pineapple, air-fried tempeh, and tofu. A true plate of goodness. If you are looking to put your sweet tooth at bay, grab one of their energy balls. They are the perfect treat after a feed and go well with a cup of coffee, too. Making good food is easy, but making great food is an art form.

MENU

[/vc_column_text][vc_single_image image="54047" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

Lago Beach Cafe

Tucked away under a tree, the Lago Beach Cafe is situated on beautiful Coconut Beach. Offering front-row seats to the ocean and more specifically, Playgrounds surf break. Open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, it would be foolish not to visit at least once during the day. Grab a smoothie, a Quinoa Veggie Bowl and enjoy the sound of the waves crashing on the shore. Top it off with a Vegan Dreamwave donut and that's what we call a win. If you are lucky enough to be on Nusa Lembongan over the weekend, be sure to relish in Indian under the Tree, an incredibly authentic menu created by Indian born Chef, Rohan. Dive into some delectable Aloo Pakoras, and crunchy Masala Poppadums to start before indulging in a divine Veggie Korma curry. It is here where India meets paradise, and for this, Lago Beach Cafe is a real gem. Whats App  +62 811-3970-300

Ginger & Jamu

Strolls down the beach become even better when charming cafes like Ginger & Jamu are ready to welcome you into their tropical oasis. The most common misconception of the vegan diet is that one would survive purely on a few carrot sticks and other raw ingredients that only a rabbit would eat. This could not be more wrong. Jamie, from New Zealand, created Ginger & Jamu from a love of yoga, healthy eating, island living, and good vibes. The menu is almost 100% plant-based and guarantees healthy ingredients, premium cooking oil, and no MSG. They strive to source local produce as well as other foodstuffs that will nourish your body and bring a smile to your face. Everything is fresh, handmade, and prepared with love. No matter the time of day, you are sure to find yummy vegan delights that will suit any mood. Vegan pancakes, Tempeh tacos, or a falafel bowl. Surely this is what food heaven looks like. Title: Best Things To Do on Nusa Ceningan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

NUSA CENINGAN ISLAND IN A (COCO)NUT SHELL

Nusa Ceningan might be small, but it’s full of big views, chill vibes, and hidden experiences that make it a perfect half-day or full-day escape from Nusa Lembongan. Connected by the iconic yellow bridge, this little island packs dramatic cliffs, secret beaches, buzzing beach clubs and a laid-back rhythm that keeps visitors coming back. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Cross the Iconic Yellow Bridge

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="74817" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_column_text css=""]

The bright yellow bridge is more than just a connection — it’s the entrance to Ceningan’s magic. Built for scooters and pedestrians only (no cars), it’s your first island-moment: great for photos and a real sense you’ve stepped into something unique.

Tip: Ride a scooter over for the full experience, or walk across for photos and views of the channel below.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Explore Ceningan’s Natural Highlights

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="74818" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Mahana Point – Surf, Bintang & Cliff Jumping

One of Ceningan’s most famous spots, Mahana Point is equal parts Bintang stop and adrenaline hub. Cliff jumping here is classic or pull up a seat at Mahana’s clifftop viewpoint with a drink and watch the surfers dance the waves.

Blue Lagoon – Turquoise Cliffs & Epic Views

Just a short scooter ride from Mahana Point, Blue Lagoon is one of the island’s most Instagrammable vistas — turquoise water crashing under towering limestone cliffs. While swimming isn’t always recommended due to currents, the views and photos here are unforgettable.

Secret Beach – Hidden Coastal Calm

As the name suggests, this tucked-away slice of coast is perfect for a slower pace: sunbathing, a quick dip (when the tides allow), and peace away from the busier spots.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Try Adventure Activities

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="74819" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Zipline Ceningan

Feel the wind and views on a zipline that flies over the sea — a fun, photo-worthy thrill for anyone visiting the island.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Best Spots for Food, Drinks & Views

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="74822" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Ceningan’s restaurant and beach club scene is compact but vibrant — ideal for lazy lunches, sunset drinks and ocean views. Here are some crowd-pleasers:

Arna Ocean Lounge & Suites – A beachside lounge with sunset cocktails and relaxed vibes.

Suku Beach Club – Great drinks with epic ocean views.

SeaBreeze Cafe – Chill beach café vibes perfect for lunch by the water.

Next Level Cafe – A laid-back morning stop with great coffee and smoothies.

Amore Ceningan – Italian-inspired food and seaside views.

The Palms Ceningan – A relaxed stop with panoramic ocean scenery.

Bonus: A handful of smaller cafés and warungs line the coast near the bridge — perfect for refreshing beach-side snacks.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Whether you’re crossing the Yellow Bridge for a quick day trip or slowing things down for a few nights, Nusa Ceningan has a way of pulling you into its rhythm. From cliffside adventures and hidden beaches to sunset drinks overlooking the ocean, this small island delivers big moments without the crowds. If you’re planning to stay longer, there are great accommodation options in Nusa Ceningan. Wherever you choose to stay, Ceningan is best enjoyed unhurried — scooter rides, salty air, and nowhere else you need to be.

[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

VILLA KASIH 

  HOME AWAY FROM HOME Stepping through the doors of Villa Kasih will provide a breath of fresh air and serenity as the noise of the outside world disappears. Designed with sophistication and elegance, this 3 bedroom tropical oasis is homey yet luxurious. Each and every inch of the property has been architected to perfection with practicality and comfort in mind. The incredibly spacious, semi-open-air living, dining, and cooking area was built with high ceilings that allow for ample airflow and natural lighting throughout the villa. Beautifully constructed with lightly coloured limestone, the living space comprises a large fully equipped kitchen, a dining table, and a comfortable lounge area. The furniture is classy and locally inspired delivering a traditional and tropical feel. Minimalistic pantone colours decorate Villa Kasih and offer feelings of relaxation and peace.   SLEEP, THE REMEDY OF LIFE A restful night is ensured at Villa Kasih. The surroundings are quiet and the sounds of nature will rock you to sleep. The ensuite master is completely separate from the main living area and stands alone in a Javanese Joglo. Tastefully decorated, and boasting an oversized bed, you will struggle to leave in the morning. Situated directly above the central house, two charming double bedrooms are available with a large shared bathroom downstairs. Not only are these rooms private, but the space also contains a smaller living room that overlooks the garden below.   FRIENDLY FACES It is a well-known fact that the Balinese are some of the friendliest people on earth and at Villa Kasih, this is no different. The staff is ready to welcome you and provide everything that you may need and more. Breakfast is included daily and will cater to any and all dietary requirements. The food is delicious and is presented as if the Royals were staying the night. Smiles make the world go around at Villa Kasih, and you are sure to enter and leave with a smile on your dial. PLAYTIME Villa Kasih has a private pool and garden making for the perfect place to play in the grass and wash the hot Indonesian sun off your shoulders. Location is everything, and Villa Kasih sure does deliver. Nestled down a quiet gangway, you are mere footsteps away from the main beach and the best restaurants on the Island. If you are looking to surf, dive, and play, then you couldn't be more central. Several Scuba and Free diving schools are a stone's throw away from the villa and the best waves are straight out front. No matter your holiday plans, they will be fulfilled with ease.
