Title: Getting to Nusa Lembongan with Rocky Fast Cruise
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

ROCKY FAST CRUISES

Getting to Nusa Lembongan with Rocky – we make it easy and stressfree The captain announces that the plane will be landing soon at Denpasar Airport; you've got your headphones on playing your favourite song, your sunnies sit atop your head, and the excitement reaches an all-time high as the wheels hit the tarmac. Welcome to the Island of the Gods! Let us give you a step-by-step about arriving in Bali and, more importantly, how to get to Nusa Lembongan with Rocky. P.s. don't miss 15% off for boat transfers when you book your accommodation with us! [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

IMMIGRATION

Upon reaching the arrival hall at Denpasar airport, proceed directly to the Visa On Arrival (VOA) counter and purchase a 30-day visa on arrival. The VOA will cost USD$35 (approx AUD$50) and is valid for 30 days, extendable for an extra 30 days. [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

AIRPORT PICK UP

Customs cleared! One step closer to throwing your towel down and soaking up the sun. Make your way to the airport terminal exit, where you will see people lined up with signs, a Rocky Representative will be waiting and holding a placard with your name on it. Once you have found each other and are good to go, they will help you with your luggage and escort you to the vehicle. [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

AIRPORT → SANUR

The journey from the airport to the Sanur port is straightforward. It will take approximately 45 minutes to reach the ferry terminal, depending on traffic conditions and the time of day. The driver will make a quick stop at the Rocky office to collect tickets and then drop you directly in front of the new terminal, where you will wait for your boat to Nusa Lembongan. No matter how many bags you bring, they are all included in the ticket price, and yes, surfboards are included, too! [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

HOTEL PICK UP

If you are already in Bali, the process is similar.  Rocky Fast Cruises will arrange to collect you directly from your hotel and drop you off at the ferry terminal. A representative will make contact one day before your travel date to confirm the pick-up time and location. They offer pick-up services from all areas on mainland Bali and include pick-up in the price of the ticket for most locations. If you are staying in a more remote area, an additional fee will apply. [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

SANUR FAST FERRY TERMINAL

Rocky Fast Cruises has 4 boat transfers from Sanur to Nusa Lembongan per day. We will do our best to help you coordinate a transfer time with your flight arrival and estimated travel time between the airport and the ferry terminal. Most of the accommodations on the island have a check-in time of 2:00 pm, so an afternoon boat would be best.   The new terminal is a large, air-conditioned, and very comfortable space. Overhead screens display the arrival and departure times so that you can keep track of the Rocky Fast Cruises schedule. Free WiFi is available throughout the property, and you will find a variety of food and beverage stalls just outside the terminal entrance. [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

SANUR → LEMBONGAN

Boarding time, let's go! A boarding announcement will be made and direct you to the specific boarding location. Once you have reached the gate, an attendant will check and scan your ticket. The walk toward the boat is short, and the boarding process is effortless. Grab a seat towards the back of the boat if you can. The journey across the ocean will be less bumpy, closer to the stern. Once the lines are loose, and the boat is set free, the final leg of your trip will begin. [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

TOUCH DOWN ON NUSA LEMBONGAN

The captain will dock the boat on the island's eastern side at the Rocky Beach Club jetty. That's right; Rocky Fast Cruises is a jetty-to-jetty transfer. Once you have arrived, a driver will drop you off at your new home away from home. All land transportation on Nusa Lembongan is included in your ticket price. Now, go on! Kick your feet up and enjoy being on island time! [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

DEPARTING PARADISE

Heading back to the mainland is just as easy as when you left. Check-out from your accommodation is usually at around 10 am,  Rocky provides two morning transfers back to Sanur. A Rocky representative will be in touch 1 day before departure to confirm the pick-up location and time. [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

LEMBONGAN → SANUR

Time to leave paradise! A driver from Rocky Fast Cruises will collect you from your hotel or villa and provide transport to the Rocky Beach Club. Once the boat is loaded, the engines will start, and you will have one last opportunity to capture a picture of the beautiful island behind you. The journey back to Sanur is roughly 30 minutes, providing enough time to scroll through your camera roll and reminisce on your wonderful holiday. Upon arrival in Sanur, the staff will take your luggage to a car that will drop you at the airport for your flight home or to your Bali accommodation ready for the next part of your holiday. Once again, all land transportation is included in your original ticket price. Thank you for trusting us with your travel plans. The Lembongan Traveller team is dedicated to ensuring your holiday is stress free, so that you leave feeling pampered, surfed out, sunkissed and relaxed!   Claim your 20% boat transfer discount  HERE[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Title: Lembongan Island Beach Villas
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Lembongan Island Beach Villas

Paradise is a place of joy and Nusa Lembongan is indeed a tropical paradise on earth. Lembongan Island Beach Villas are a short 30-minute boat ride from Bali is all that separates you from the hustle and bustle of daily life and azure blue waters with white beaches. Let us introduce you to Lembongan's best resort which combines amazing facilities, great value and beautiful private villas, all in one place [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

HOME AWAY FROM HOME

Lembongan Island Beach Villas is your island home away from home. Perfect for first timers and top of the list for repeat guests. These bright, clean, open-aired villas feed the soul with immediate delight. Centrally located in the crux of Jungutbatu, Lembongan Island Beach Villas is as beachfront as it gets. Ten self-contained villas ascend the hill, bestowing dramatic, uninterrupted views of Mount Agung and the stunning aquamarine ocean. Each villa has recently received a makeover inspired by traditional Balinese interiors and completed with the soul of authentic island living. Exquisitely furnished, the interior comprises of either 1, 2, or 3 ensuite bedrooms with oversized, ultra-comfy beds, a spacious dining area, a large living space with a Smart TV,  fully equipped kitchen, and large private balcony ( some with plunge pool). Take the common stairs that run through the centre of the property down to the onsite restaurant and bar where cheerful faces are eager to make your day. Hop in the infinity pool, sip a cocktail and marvel at the beauty that unfolds in the distance.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="55351" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

EAT

Ideally placed at the doorway of the renowned Nusa Lembongan boardwalk, Lembongan Island Beach Villas holds pole position. Footsteps will land you at the most sought-after eateries on the island, with worldwide cuisines at your fingertips. Alternatively, dine with your toes in the sand at one of the many Jungutbatu beach cafés, all reachable by scooter, push bike, or buggy hire.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="55347" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

EXPLORE

Jalan Raya Jungutbatu, the main road, is just around the corner. Stalls selling fresh produce, snacks, drinks, and souvenirs are dotted down the street, waiting for you to pay them a visit. Stop by one of Nusa Lembongan's Hindu Temples, please dress appropriately (sarong wrapped around your lower half) or ask the locals for help if you have any doubts; they will be more than happy to help you respect the traditions of their religion and culture[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="55448" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

SURF & SUN

Coconut Beach, a ocean-lovers utopia, is a stone's throw away from the front door of your villa. Calm waters  make for excellent swimming and beach day chilling. A short paddle gives effortless access to Playgrounds and Lacerations surf breaks. Water taxis are ready for those looking to slay the beast at Shipwrecks and will provide return transport for a small fee. Both surf and SUP board hire is available from vendors on the beach, plus this is home to Lago Beach Café, serving great coffee and all-day dining delights.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="55353" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

DIVE

The crystal waters and lively reefs are what make the underwater world of Nusa Lembongan spectacular. Snorkelling and scuba diving outfits are close by and will usher you on an unforgettable aquatic journey. Visit the Manta Rays at any time of the year. Play nice, and they will oblige to a sneaky selfie.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="51164" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

LUXURIATE

A 3-minute stroll will lead you to the latest and greatest wellness oasis on Nusa Lembongan, Spring Day Spa & Sanctuary. Treat yourself to a day of luxury and relaxation in one of their ensuite, private therapy villas. Spring Day Spa offers an extensive selection of highly professional treatments that will leave you floating on cloud 9.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="51731" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

LIBV TRIBE

Lembongan Island Beach Villas is the perfect place for newcomers. It’s centralized location will make getting around the island easy. Nothing will ever feel too far away. The staff are always ready to help with your daily plans; organising restaurant reservations, snorkelling, diving, transportation, and anything else you may need. So, whether this is your first or 21st time on the island, the team at Lembongan Island Beach Villas will welcome you with a warm and wonderful smile.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="55344" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]Arrive as a guest, but leave as a member of the tribe. For more info and BEST rates please contact our team via Whats App +61 419 947 594 or Email holiday@thelembongantraveller.com. CHECK AVAILABILITY HERE[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Title: Best Private Villas on Nusa Ceningan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

LUXE OUT ON CENINGAN

Nusa Ceningan is a sliver of tropical paradise that sits snugly between Nusa Lembongan and Nusa Penida. Although small, Nusa Ceningan has plenty to offer visitors and is the perfect destination for those seeking a more laid-back holiday experience. Accommodation choices can either make or break your vacation, so we have chosen two of our favourite luxurious private villas on Ceningan to help with your decision. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][vc_single_image image="46008" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

VILLA LAGOON

Draped in black and white, Villa Lagoon is where chic design meets desirable island living. A narrow cobblestone pathway leads to a dreamy three-bedroom oasis overlooking the icy-blue ocean and neighbouring Nusa Lembongan Island. Outfitted with class, each bedroom has been elegantly designed and includes a ensuite with luxurious finishings.   Developed with an open plan, Villa Lagoon allows for natural lighting and cool sea breezes to flow throughout the property. The spacious interior comprises a variety of large sofas, designer chairs, contemporary beanbags, and comfortable day beds that all shout sun-soaked relaxation. A modern, fully equipped kitchen and an eight-seater table, makes Villa Lagoon ideal for those wanting to dine from the comfort of home.   Set at the edge of the ocean is the stunning private pool deck, boasting tropical scenery that will boost your mood and encourage lazy days with a good book. A sunken terrace provides shade with cozy seating for the sun-kissed, as well as a staircase leading directly into the ocean. Kayaks and snorkelling gear are available for those looking to go on a nearby adventure. Alternatively, the best things to do in Nusa Ceningan are right on your doorstep and are accessible by foot, scooter, or island taxi. Villa Lagoon ticks all the boxes as one of the BEST private villas on Nusa Ceningan.   Sleeps 6, From AU$660 / night CHECK AVAILABILITY[/vc_column_text][vc_single_image image="49679" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][vc_gallery type="image_grid" images="49681,49668,49663" img_size="medium" column_number="3" grayscale="no" space_between_images="no"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

VILLA CHAMA

The glamorous Villa Chama is perched high in the clouds on the cliff tops of Nusa Ceningan. This two-story grand slam provides its guests with infinite space and a feeling of utter seclusion. Greeted by an expansive living area and an unmatched 180-degree ocean view, Villa Chama is a feast for the senses and the perfect spot to withdraw from the busyness of the outside world.   Furnished to the nines, the upper level embodies style and contains a large indoor dining table, a fully equipped kitchen, a lounge suite, telescope, and plenty of room. Glass sliding doors rim the property and lead to the encircling indoor/outdoor terrace, where you will find a comfortable seating area as well as a selection of high stools and low lying chairs. The scenes below of turquoise water and lush greenery are truly magical and will transport your mind into a state of rest and rejuvenation.   A short flight of stairs leads down toward four uniquely crafted ensuite bedrooms, and although they share one large terrace, each guest room is private and ensures a tranquil night of sleep. Villa Chama boasts a divine pool area with ample sun loungers, hammocks, and couches that facilitate a much-needed timeout. As night falls, head to the enchanted tree house where stargazing is renowned, and peace is mandatory.   The friendly team at Villa Chama will provide daily breakfast at your convenience and inform you of the countless restaurants located nearby. Everything is reachable by scooter or island taxi. Definitely put it on your list if you are looking for a private villa on Nusa Ceningan.   Sleeps 10, From AU$550 / night CHECK AVAILABILITY[/vc_column_text][vc_single_image image="45269" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][vc_gallery type="image_grid" images="45286,45272,45281" img_size="medium" column_number="3" grayscale="no" space_between_images="no"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Title: Oasis of luxury at Villa Coral
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

WELCOME to VILLA CORAL

Perched on the pristine beach of Tamarind Bay,  an oasis of luxury at Villa Coral awaits, where seclusion and tranquillity are your baseline. Boasting 180-degree ocean views throughout the property, Villa Coral Nusa Lembongan is a private villa experience you will never forget. Sounds of the ocean hush the noise of the outside world as time slows and is dictated only by the movement of the tides. Once you've checked in, allow the silence to overcome your senses as you slip into a state of Nusa Lembongan bliss. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

REST easy

Four identical ensuite master bedrooms are spread over two stories and exude sophistication and style. Meticulously decorated with a blend of modern and traditional Balinese aesthetics, Rest easy in the king-size beds (one room with twin bed option), all with masses of natural light, knowing that every detail has been carefully crafted for your comfort. The bathroom has an open-concept design, featuring dual basins and sleek finishes. Find solace on the outdoor terrace that offers stunning ocean views, the perfect place to decompress.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="25757" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

LIVE the villa life

  Located on the top floor, the media room is a spacious entertainment area, perfect for movie nights, games, yoga, and more. The room is fully air-conditioned, ensuring that guests can relax and enjoy their time, regardless of the weather. Furnished with a smart TV and a cosy couch, the space provides an enjoyment for all. Beyond the media room, a semi open air lounge area extends to provide a panoramic view of the ocean, adding an extra touch of leisure to the space. Curl up and relish the peacefulness of villa life while reading a book or chatting with friends.   Designed with an open plan, the downstairs living area is complete with a fully equipped kitchen and an 8-seater glass-top dining table. Escape the tropical heat with a refreshing dip in the infinity pool that overlooks the ocean and majestic Balinese mountains. With enough length to swim laps and plenty of space to splash around, the pool is sure to bring endless fun to all the family. Comfortable sun loungers line the deck and offer an idyllic setting for relaxation and a great spot to soak up the sun. The outdoor Bale is fitted with more couches, day bed and bar where guests can enjoy a drink and take advantage of the beautiful sunsets with family and friends[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text] [gallery columns="1" size="large" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/img-fdd3ccbea47f1fcd3eec061b2fb142cf-e1526275856381.jpg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/FS-Jaz-with-Pete-scaled.jpg|"] [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

DINING to delight

Indulge in the best of Balinese hospitality at Villa Coral. Start your day with a scrumptious breakfast included in your stay, featuring an array of dishes that will tantalize your taste buds. The talented team can also prepare lunch and dinner from the in-villa dining menu. Using only the freshest ingredients, the menu showcases local and international cuisines. For those looking to eat out, a selection of Nusa Lembongan’s best restaurants are just around the corner. The Playful Table, a 5-minute walk from Villa Coral, offers unforgettable vistas of both Tamarind Bay and Jungutbatu beach. The gifted chef serves up a menu that is sure to fulfil your cravings. Head to Lago Cafe, a chic coffee house on Coconut Beach for mouth-watering coffee and all-day dining. If you're looking for a chilled-out morning and a laid-back day at the beach, Lago is the perfect spot. Situated under a large tree that functions as an umbrella, you can stay cool and refreshed while tucking into delicious food and drinks. This small slice of paradise is ideal for basking in the sun or enjoying a swim. The renowned boardwalk of Nusa Lembongan ascends from Coconut Beach and offers a list of restaurants that will please any pallet. Alternatively, hop on your scooter and explore the nearby Jungutbatu or Mushroom bay areas.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text] [gallery columns="1" size="large" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/WhatsApp-Image-2023-03-13-at-12.50.08-PM.jpeg|,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/tmrd-bch.jpg|"] [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

ENJOY a surf, SUP, snorkel, spa day or pilates

  A few steps lead directly to the white sandy beach of Tamarind bay. Complimentary SUP boards and snorkelling equipment are available to explore coral reefs that sit on your doorstep. Unroll your towel and make the most of the quiet beach, or take a short paddle to Playgrounds or Lacerations surf breaks. A speedy boat ride will drop you off in the lineup at Shipwrecks and Razors, two waves located in front of Jungutbatus’ main beach.   Private pilates classes are available upon request at Villa Coral and are an excellent way to enhance your wellness routine while on holidays. Villa Coral provides the opportunity to experience a personalized Pilates workout with a qualified instructor in the comfort of your own space. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned pro, each class will be tailored to your unique needs and goals. Plus, with flexible scheduling options, you can easily fit your Pilates session into your holiday schedule.     After a hot day in the sun, pamper yourself with a moment of luxury at Spring Day Spa, accessed either by scooter or a leisurely stroll from Villa Coral. Presenting a variety of rejuvenating treatments, you're sure to emerge feeling refreshed and invigorated.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text] [gallery columns="1" size="large" ids="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/FS-SUP-Portrait-Jaz-scaled.jpg|,|"] [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

TEAM Coral

The Villa Coral team is always available to assist in planning and organizing special, custom-made experiences. Whether you're interested in exploring the colourful reefs while scuba diving, island-hopping adventures, or discovering the many other exciting wonders of the island, they are here to help make your dream itinerary a reality.

[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

MAKING MEMORIES AT MORIN

Nestled on the serene and picturesque island of Nusa Lembongan, lies a boutique resort that promises an unforgettable retreat for travellers looking to escape the hustle of everyday life. This is not just a destination, but rather an institution where guests create memories they will cherish from their stay at Morin Resort. Accessible by a 30-minute fast ferry or private boat transfer with Morin Ocean Adventures, getting to Nusa Lembongan is easy. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

THE FOUNDATION

Built on the foundation of three decades of friendship and connection between the Monoh family, the proud landowners, and the Jamar family from Belgium, Morin is located on a tranquil and secluded clifftop. A short 3-minute stroll in either direction will lead you to one of two stunning beaches, presenting the ideal balance of serenity and convenience. The name "Morin" draws inspiration from the Mooring Buoy, which serves as an anchor for boats, symbolizing the resort as a safe haven for travellers to anchor their souls and relax.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="57636" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

THE RESORT

From the moment you step into Morin Resort, you are enveloped in a warm and welcoming atmosphere that instantly gives you the feeling of home. The boutique bungalows are meticulously designed to offer a perfect blend of comfort, refinement, and laid-back island vibes, making it one of the best accommodation in Nusa Lembongan. Assembled a stone's throw away from the ocean, Morin Resort boasts a range of accommodation options,, making it the ideal place for family and friends to stay in Nusa Lembongan. From ocean suites adorned with breathtaking sea views that captivate the senses to family bungalows snuggled among lush gardens, you are truly spoilt with choice. Each room is exquisitely decorated with flair, creativity, and authenticity, providing a comfortable and charming stay. At Morin, a large infinity pool offers sensational views of the ocean that will leave you in awe. From the pool, you can take in panoramic scenes of the surf breaks, creating an unparalleled experience for surf enthusiasts and beach lovers alike. Whether you choose to relax by the pool or take a short paddle to Playgrounds, Morin provides the best setting for those who appreciate the beauty of the deep blue and its surrounding landscape. Tucked in a tranquil corner away from the main road, Morin Resort supplies a sheltered oasis where you can escape the noise and chaos of traffic. The resort is cocooned in an all-encompassing feeling of tranquillity, inviting guests to unwind and disconnect from the outside world.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="57611" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][vc_single_image image="57229" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

THE RESTAURANT

  At Morin, you are not just treated as a visitor but welcomed as part of the family. The genuine warmth, personalized service, and careful attention to detail ensure that guests feel like they are in a home away from home, this extends to the food served by the resort restaurant.   Morin takes pride in its dining experience, which perfectly embodies the core values of the resort - connection, creativity, and inspiration. The restaurant, aptly named "The Playful Table", is led by the talented Chef Made and her team, who prepare delectable meals with love and care.   The menu features predominantly plant-based options, with gluten-free and locally sourced ingredients, offering a culinary journey that tantalizes the taste buds and nourishes the body.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="57234" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][vc_single_image image="54537" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

THE ENVIRONMENT

Morin Resort is dedicated to sustainability and community involvement. The resort actively promotes eco-friendly practices, such as waste reduction, energy conservation, and supporting local initiatives. As a guest, you are invited to participate in beach clean-ups, cultural activities, and help contribute to the preservation of Nusa Lembongan’s natural beauty.

THE OCEAN

For those seeking adventure, Morin offers a plethora of ocean experiences. Diving in Nusa Lembongan is a highlight, with Captain Wayan leading incredible ocean experiences in the pristine waters surrounding the island. Guests can also snorkel amongst the vibrant coral reefs, glide with Mantas, indulge in a sunset cruise, or customize a unique adventure. The team will do anything to help you create a lifetime of Morin memories whilst exploring the azure waters of Nusa Lembongan.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="57604" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=""]

THE MIND, BODY AND SOUL

Morin provides the space to connect with nature, ignite creativity, and inspire the soul. The leafy gardens, inviting pools, and spectacular ocean panoramas create an idyllic setting for leisure and revival. The open-air yoga shala, cradled amidst the natural beauty of the island, provides a serene space for guests to practice mindfulness, meditation, and movement. With accommodation for up to 24 people, Morin Resort offers retreat packages that are ideal for hosting team-building events, intimate family gatherings, or simply indulging in wellness activities. Guests can practice yoga, surf, cook, meditate, dive, and embark on infinite ocean adventures, letting the imagination create the perfect stay with endless things to do in Nusa Lembongan. Morin's retreat packages offer a customizable experience, allowing you to tailor your stay to your unique needs and desires. Morin is not just a resort, but rather a sanctuary for travellers looking for an authentic, soulful, and immersive experience, making it one of the best resorts in Nusa Lembongan. The unique accommodation, personalized service, plant-based dining, ocean adventures, and retreat packages provide a journey that is hard to replicate. Title: The Conscious Traveller
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

The Conscious Traveller

Travelling to Nusa Lembongan is a dream come true for anyone who lands on its pristine white sandy beaches. The crystal clear waters, immaculate shorelines, and vibrant culture make this destination a popular choice for all. It is important to remember that our actions can have a significant impact on the environment and local communities. Being a conscious traveller means minimising our negative impact on the places we visit. In this article, you will learn how to help preserve the beauty of Nusa Lembongan. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

REUSABLE WATER BOTTLES

Popular tourist destinations, such as Nusa Lembongan, face the issue of increased plastic waste. Play your part in addressing this problem by carrying a reusable water bottle and refilling it whenever necessary. Our villas come equipped with water refill stations, which are available to you free of charge. Furthermore, many of the island's restaurants and cafes provide complimentary water refills. Using your reusable bottle instead of a plastic one will help reduce the amount of plastic waste.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="57751" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

AVOID SINGLE-USE PLASTIC

Nusa Lembongan faces a severe problem with single-use plastic pollution, which calls for conscious travellers to take action. Carrying a reusable shopping bag is one of the most effective ways to achieve this, as it minimizes the need for single-use plastic bags. To further reduce the use of single-use plastics such as straws and utensils, consider bringing your own on your travels. Alternatively, you can easily find these items for sale on the island. While dining out, inform your server that you don’t want a plastic straw or utensils, and they will happily comply.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="57754" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

PROPER WASTE MANAGEMENT

Responsible waste management is crucial for ensuring that tourism has a positive impact on Nusa Lembongan. To play your part, utilize designated waste bins or facilities for proper disposal while exploring the island. By taking these simple yet effective steps, you can help reduce the amount of waste that harms natural habitats or ends up in landfills. An important initiative promoting sustainable waste management on the island is the Lembongan Recycling Center. They are actively involved in sorting and separating hard waste, composting food scraps from local restaurants and cafes, and encouraging visitors to use designated rubbish bins. Collaborating with the Lembongan Recycling Center will contribute to protecting the island and promoting sustainable tourism.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="57753" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

BE KIND TO THE OCEAN

Snorkelling and diving are two of the most popular activities in Nusa Lembongan. Home to a vibrant ecosystem of marine life and stunning coral reef, it is important to practice responsible ocean behaviours. Avoid feeding or touching marine animals, as well as littering or leaving any trash behind. Additionally, we recommend using reef-safe sunscreen to prevent harmful chemicals from entering the water and damaging the coral. It's crucial to remember that coral reefs are delicate and provide habitats for an array of underwater creatures. Choose a reputable tour operator as they prioritize environmental friendliness and provide education about appropriate conduct In the ocean. Engaging in responsible practices is a way to help protect these natural treasures for years to come.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="51161" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

REDUCE ENERGY CONSUMPTION

Reducing energy consumption is a key responsibility for conscious travellers. Take simple steps like turning off lights, air conditioning, fans, and electronics when not in use. Many accommodation in Nusa Lembongan adopt eco-friendly practices, changing towels and linen every third day to minimize environmental impact. As a mindful tourist, you can contribute by hanging your wet pool towels in the sun to dry, allowing for reuse during your stay. Water conservation is also critical. Keep showers short as this will help make a difference in preserving this precious commodity. These small actions can greatly reduce your carbon footprint while travelling.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="57852" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

CULTURAL TIPS

Respect the local culture by dressing modestly, following customs and traditions, and using pleasantries in the local language when you can. When visiting Hindu temples avoid wearing revealing clothing and opt for items that cover your shoulders and knees.  A sarong loosely tied over your clothes for both men and woman is an appropriate way of showing respect when attending ceremonies or entering a temple.   Embracing the local culture during your travels is key to fostering an enriching and authentic experience. When immersing yourself in the local customs, traditions, language, and way of life, you will gain a deeper appreciation for the culture and build meaningful connections with the Lembongan community. Becoming a mindful traveller involves making small yet significant efforts to reduce our environmental impact. It's within our power to preserve natural wonders such as Nusa Lembongan, ensuring their beauty remains for future generations. The decision lies with each of us, and once made, adopting a sustainable lifestyle becomes effortless.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="54504" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

YOGA AND WELLNESS IN NUSA LEMBONGAN

Zen out in Nusa Lembongan, only 30 minutes from Bali,  it is the ideal destination for yoga lovers. Offering the perfect escape from the hustle of city life, the white sandy beaches, blue skies, and gentle ocean sway create an ideal space to find your freedom. Come with us as we explore the best in yoga and wellness in Nusa Lembongan. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

Yoga Bliss

Situated in Nusa Lembongan's heart, Yoga Bliss was established in 2016. They are a distinctive haven for yoga exploration and instruction, welcoming newcomers and experienced practitioners alike. Offering a broad range of services, including drop-in classes, workshops, retreats, and teacher training, everyone finds a place at Yoga Bliss. Drenched in natural light and soft breezes, the wooden shala blends traditional design with modern comfort, providing a tranquil space for yoga practice amid lush greenery. Yoga Bliss takes pride in offering diverse yoga styles such as Yin, Ashtanga, Mandala flow, Slow and Vinyasa flow, enriching your yoga journey. Morning and evening classes cater to your schedule, with private sessions available at the shala or your villa. Their Nusa Lembongan yoga teacher training programs cover various yoga styles, philosophies, and teaching methodologies, promoting overall well-being. Online training packages are also available. Yoga Bliss also offersretreat packages blending intensive yoga with surfing and diving, providing an all-rounded wellness journey. Aspiring to create an open, welcoming space, Yoga Bliss focuses on deepening yoga practice, fostering spiritual growth, and facilitating self-discovery[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_single_image image="33311" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

All Yoga Training

All Yoga Training offers Yoga Alliance–certified 200-hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali. Our intimate 23-day course is practice-focused, so you build real teaching skills and deepen your personal practice with close guidance. Our trainings welcome motivated beginners and experienced practitioners. You’ll study Ashtanga Vinyasa, Creative Vinyasa Flow, pranayama, meditation, subtle anatomy, and teaching methodology in a supportive setting. The studio is a beachfront shala in Jungut Batu, Nusa Lembongan—steps from cafés, guesthouses, and the beach. Sea-breeze ventilation, an open roof line, and ocean views create a calm study environment. All Yoga Training began in 2009 with a simple idea: make high-quality yoga education accessible, practical, and community-minded. Our international teachers mentor small groups so each student receives personal feedback and clear direction. The course is capped at 22 students for better learning, with individual mentoring from a world-class team with decades of combined experience. By graduation you’ll be ready to lead safe and inspiring classes for all levels. Certification is Yoga Alliance 200-hour, recognized internationally so you can teach anywhere in the world. View dates & apply: https://www.allyogatraining.com/yoga-teacher-training-bali.html[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_single_image image="72960" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Title: Villa Kingfisher
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

VILLA KINGFISHER

Set your sights on Villa Kingfisher, highly rated by so many guests, this favourite private villa is tucked into Nusa Lembongan's secluded coastline. Perched above the water, this little piece of heaven serves up nature in its rawest form, with a jaw-dropping view of the seaweed farms and Nusa Ceningan's vibrant landscape.   Villa Kingfisher is your ticket to a dream vacation, tailor-made for the modern traveller. Boasting the perfect mix of privacy and luxury, it is a top pick for couples seeking an unforgettable, romantic getaway in Nusa Lembongan. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="50433" img_size="large" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

BLISSFUL SECLUSION

The main house, designed with an open-plan concept, encourages easy socializing while keeping you connected with the great outdoors. The blend of timber and earth tones creates an idyllic setting, perfect for creating timeless memories with your special person. With a smorgasbord of lounging at your disposal, you can sink into the low-slung sofas, engage in lively conversation around the dining table, or lose yourself in a good book while relaxing comfortably in one of the occasional chairs. Accommodating up to 4 guests, the bedrooms are a nod to its overarching theme of intimacy. The master is neatly tucked within the main house, elegantly partitioned by curtains for additional privacy. Offering an uninterrupted ocean view, waking up will be the best part of your day. The auxiliary bedroom, separate from the main house yet sharing a smiliar design, ensures a level of privacy that is second to none. Equipped with a kitchenette and sofa, it provides a refuge for your personal comfort. Each bedroom has air-conditioning, a king-sized bed and open-air bathrooms offering a unique starlit showering experience.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="58209" img_size="large" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

PARADISE FOUND

A stand-out feature at Villa Kingfisher is the 20m infinity pool, a surefire temptation for a refreshing swim or a few laps. If you are seeking relaxation, the spacious bale provides a sheltered place for all-day chilling, while poolside sunbeds and bean bags create an oasis for sunlovers. Unshackle yourself from the daily grind and embrace the liberating aura of Villa Kingfisher. Nusa Lembongan’s magic is endless and merely a stone's throw from your private villa. Whether you find yourself captivated by the artistry of the seaweed farms or intrigued by surfing at Mahana Point, you're in for a treat at this ocean front villa in Nusa Lembongan. Embark on an adventure and discover the beauty of Devil's Tear, soak up the sun at Dream Beach, or traverse the famous Yellow Bridge to check off those must-visit destinations on your Lembongan bucket list.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="58219" img_size="large" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

UNPARALLELED COMFORT

At Villa Kingfisher, your comfort is key. A dedicated team is on hand to cater to your every need, from preparing a delicious breakfast, daily house keeping, to organizing island activities or transportation - you can rest easy knowing every detail of your stay is taken care of.   Whether you are looking for a peaceful retreat or an adventurous getaway, Villa Kingfisher promises an unforgettable stay. Experience the best of Nusa Lembongan, from its stunning natural beauty to its rich culture and warm hospitality, all within the convenience and luxury of Villa Kingfisher.   This is not just a vacation; it's an experience of a lifetime at one of the most sought-after Nusa Lembongan luxury villas. Whether you’re traveling with friends, family or solo, we have listed What's New in Lembongan.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=""]

Activities in Nusa Lembongan

Nusa Lembongan is a haven for water sports with its clear blue waters. Explore Nusa Lembongan, Nusa Ceningan, and Nusa Penida in a thrilling way with Jetski Lembongan Adventure offering Jet Ski tours guided by professional captains using brand new JetSkis. There are four packages you can choose from, depending on your wishes and level. Explore scenic sights such as the Yellow Bridge, Kelingking Beach and encounter marine life along the way. For information and booking contact WhatsApp: +62 813-3776-3128 or Instagram : @jetski_lembongan[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="58357" img_size="large" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=""]

Yoga & Wellness in Nusa Lembongan

Keen to try something new during your holiday? Treat yourself to a  Sound Journey experience, every Thursday at 6:00 PM at The Yoga Shala Lembongan, located on the main street of Jungutbatu. Stretch ahead with a Yin yoga class at 4:30 PM and continue with a calming session of Sound Journey using specialized sound frequencies to heal the body, mind and soul. Intrigued? Learn more by contacting them on Whats App +62 812 4618 6550 or Instagram : the_yoga_shala_lembongan[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="58767" img_size="large" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Dining and Drinking in Nusa Lembongan

Eating out in Nusa Lembongan has elevated to new levels as more restaurants with specialty cuisine open. From authentic Italian at Al Ponte,  Indian curries at Curry Traders, French/Mediterranean La Kaban, plant-based meals at The Playful Table, to a new up and coming Greek restaurant, bakery and gelato parlor.  The culinary scene in Nusa Lembongan caters to all palates, including those with dietary needs.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="58771" img_size="large" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Entertainment in Nusa Lembongan

Sunset is best enjoyed in the company of good music and Nusa Lembongan offers a variety of live entertainment with something going on almost daily, from live bands, movies on the beach to DJs. Title: Why book with The Lembongan Traveller
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

7 reasons why you should book with The Lembongan Traveller

Planning your Nusa Lembongan holiday does not need to be a stressful process. We are to help and here’s 7 benefits why you should book with The Lembongan Traveller. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''] [/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

1. Best Rates

We guarantee the best rate on all our listed properties – that’s over 50 resorts, villas and bungalows! If you find price difference on Booking.com or AirBnB we will be happy to match the price. Another benefit of booking direct is we offer more personalized service and flexibility compared to Online Travel Agents.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="58253" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

2. Something for Every Traveller

Next to best rate guarantee, our portfolio of 50 accommodation in Nusa Lembongan and Nusa Ceningan provide something for every traveller’s preference and budget, from bungalow, family-friendly resort to luxury beachfront villa.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="74770" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

3. Local Presence

We’re the only villa booking agent to be based in Nusa Lembongan so our team knows the ins and outs of the island better than anyone. With an office open 7 days a week, our reservations team are here for you on-site or on-line should you need assistance.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="59135" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

4. One stop shop

With our expertise and partners, we make your travel to Nusa Lembongan a breeze. From choosing the best villa, organizing airport transfers and booking your boat, to planning activities, we can assist you in one instance,  saving you precious time and energy. You can enjoy the service ala carte too and we do not charge hidden costs  for our service.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="52861" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

5. Details, details, details

Nusa Lembongan makes a perfect couples, family or group holiday. However this often takes a lot of planning, from choosing the perfect villa, hiring babysitter to restaurant recommendations. Leave these details to our expert team, who have assisted thousands of people over the last 10 years plan their Nusa Lembongan holiday. Now all you have to do is check your passport is on hand.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="58742" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

6. Support the Community

We employ 100% locals and by booking with The Lembongan Traveller, you directly help the local community. Furthermore, we do more than just boat and villa booking, as we also raise funds to help the local community in education and health. Our cause Love for Lembongan  raised more than $70,000 during the pandemic which was channelled to fund a literacy program and much needed food relief.  We are continuing our community support with ongoing education and health programs, which include assisting priority patients receive specialised treatment in Bali.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="58743" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

7. Save more on boat transfer

When you book your accommodation with us, we will give 20% discount for your boat transfers, excluding private transfer and Bali Hai Cruise. This offer is only applicable for bookings made through email or our website and excludes Booking.com and AirBnb bookings.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="51764" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]Read recent reviews from our happy guests from Google Business:   “The Lembongan Traveller makes a holiday to the island a breeze. The website is very comprehensive. Being able to secure both a villa and transfers from/to the airport in the same booking is so easy and provides peace of mind ahead of travel. The staff are helpful and very prompt to respond.” G.M. “Great and professional operators who made our pre-arrangements a breeze and time on Nusa Lembongan effortless. Will book through The Lembongan Traveller again - recommended!” B.O. “Lembongan Traveller never disappoints with their customer service and ease of booking. Villas are stunning and attention to detail is exemplary.” C.C. "Thanks for all your assistance with our large family group holiday- we really appreciated all your quick and thorough replies to our emails and numerous questions.  We had a wonderful holiday and all the transfers you organised work beautifully." A&S So, what are you waiting for? Book your next Nusa Lembongan holiday with us and start packing your bags.
