Title: Our Journey
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]The Lembongan Traveller turns 10 this month ( August 2023)  and we’ve came a long way! What started as an Instagram post 10 years ago has now evolved to a boutique property management company with a website, app, and social media accounts with a strong following of fellow "Lembongan Lovers". We’d like to thank you for your support, without you our team (and smiles) would not have grown this big! Are you curious to learn more about our company? Learn more about our journey, milestones and team below. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

2013

Our founder, Tania Walker, made the first Instagram post on The Lembongan Traveller account. Shortly after returning to Australia from their Lembongan holiday, founders Tania and Mal Walker brainstormed of a business idea that focuses on promoting Nusa Lembongan as a tourism destination. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

2014

Our first website was launched. The Lembongan Traveller was born from the idea of having a platform dedicated to ‘everything’ Lembongan. Since then we have had expanded our website to include all things Lembongan and added a FREE Island mobile app too. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

2015

We welcomed our first staff member. The Lembongan Traveller was run from Dunsbrough, Western Australia, at this point. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

2016

The collapse of Yellow Bridge connecting Nusa Lembongan and Nusa Ceningan devastated the community in October 2016. We raised over AU$ 35,000 to assist the families impacted by loss of lives and injury, funds also went towards community education programs. This included the "Computer in the Village" initiative, co-ordinated by our charity partners Bali Children Foundation which ensured access to computers for high school students. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

2018

The company officially relocated their operations from Australia to Nusa Lembongan. The beginning of elevating the business to deliver the customer service we are renowned for today. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

2019

We welcomed opened first Nusa Lembongan office and welcomed three local staff. Since then we have moved to bigger offices as our team grew. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=""]

2020 - 2021

The pandemic hit the community badly and our cause Love for Lembongan was born to help the community in need. Thanks to the generous donations from you all, our team worked together to distribute food supplies and provide health care support for the community. Together with Bali Children Foundation, we also launched a literacy program for children who missed schooling during the pandemic. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

2022

Tourism slowly came back Lembongan and The Lembongan Traveller grew with expansion further into property management and offering a one stop solution for Nusa Lembongan holiday makers. It was a wonderful sight to see visitors on the island and local businesses re-opening.   [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

2023

We celebrate our 10th birthday and are extremely proud of the entire TLT team who have helped thousands of people with their Lembongan holiday plans.  As the only travel agent with an operations and reservations presence on the island representing Lembongan's best villas, resorts and bungalows, we are committed to making sure your holiday is planned to perfection and the Lembongan locals continue prosper from tourism in the years to come.   [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Title: The Best Coffee in Nusa Lembongan

Ranging from charming beachfront cafes to quaint roadside coffee huts, the island's coffee scene promises a journey filled with satisfying flavours. So, join us as we explore the finest coffee that Nusa Lembongan has to offer. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Ombak Zero Waste Cafe

Situated on the stunning Jungut Batu beach, Ombak Zero Waste Cafe is a hideout for coffee fanatics seeking a sustainable sip with an ocean view. This beachfront cafe, known for its almost 100% zero-waste commitment, offers an inviting space where the sound of the waves complements the rich aroma of freshly brewed coffee. Their signature homemade coconut milk adds a unique twist to your experience, providing a creamy addition to their potent coffee blend. Alternatively, choose from a variety of dairy and non-dairy milks. Offering ample seating, Ombak is an ideal spot for anyone wanting a reliable workspace and all day dining menu using the freshest produce and designed for all dietary needs. Looking to add a sweet bite to your coffee? Ombak's selection of homemade vegan desserts are not to be missed. From their mouthwatering salted caramel tart to the airy apple pie, these delights perfectly balance the flavours of the island with the richness of great coffee. Lago Beach Cafe

Lago serves as the perfect locale for those with families that are keen to play in the waves and soak up the sun, all within arms reach of the cafe. Title: The Best Sunset Spots on Nusa Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]Nusa Lembongan has effortlessly carved its name into the hearts of travellers with its crystal blue waters, white sandy beaches, relaxed island vibes, and of course, stunning sunsets on offer. We've listed the top 5 best sunset spots on Nusa Lembongan. Choosing the right spot to watch the sunset can elevate the experience from 'beautiful' to 'absolutely unforgettable'. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Ohana's Beach Club

Nestled on the pristine sands of Jungutbatu Beach, Ohana's isn't just a beach club; it's a sunset celebration. When night falls, their iconic "Sunsets on Fire" takes centre stage, with a bonfire igniting the beach, making the sun's descent even more enchanting. The energy is contagious here, amplified by pulsating beats from live bands or DJs that become the soundtrack to your evening. Dive into their eclectic range of cocktails, paired perfectly with a menu that's nothing short of amazing. From the casual vibe of bean bags along the shoreline to the sweeping views from the upper deck's day beds, or dips in the pool, Ohana's frames each sunset into a memorable experience.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="59447" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Mahana Point

Journey across the iconic Yellow Bridge to Nusa Ceningan, where the thrill and excitement meets the charm of Mahana Point, perched on a breathtaking cliff edge. Sipping on a chilled coconut, enjoying a cocktail, or tucking mei goreng, your attention is captivated by the scenes beyond where surfers skillfully dance with the waves. They flow in tune with house music pouring from the restaurant's speakers, all while the sun stages its spellbinding descent, tossing a glow over the ocean. At Mahana Point, every sunset becomes a tale of adventure, rhythm, and beauty.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="59442" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Devil Tears

Nusa Lembongan has its fair share of natural wonders, and Devil's Tears is the crown jewel. This coastal phenomenon is where the ocean’s might meets rocky ledges, sending dramatic sprays to the heavens above. As dusk approaches, the setting turns poetic. The powerful waters below and the soothing sun above create a scene that's both peaceful and mesmerizing. Though it's a spectacle that begs to be captured, tread with caution; the ocean demand respect and careful footing on the rocks (please adhere to the safety signage).[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="59445" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Mushroom Bay Beach

Sunset hits different on Mushroom Bay with its unspoiled natural beauty, unobstructed views and calm waters.  Its easy accessibility makes it an ideal place to witness a breathtaking sunset. Walk along the long stretch of golden sands or pick restaurants and bars on Mushroom Bay Beach and admire the colourful change of day to night. [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="59512" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Sandy Bay Beach Club

Ending on a note of sheer elegance, Sandy Bay Beach Club is where luxe meets nature's raw beauty. The sun's descent here is nothing short of dramatic, best viewed from their beachfront infinity pool. As the horizon showcases its daily sensation, the beach club ensures your palate isn't left behind—providing a feast not just for your eyes but also for your taste buds. In Nusa Lembongan, every sunset is a story, an event, a memory waiting to be made. It’s not just about the sun setting; it’s about where you are when it happens. So, go chasing sunsets, and let the island's charm sweep you off your feet.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="59468" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Title: Nusa Lembongan Guide for Family
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Nusa Lembongan Guide for Family

Nusa Lembongan is a family-friendly destination with its crystal clear waters, peaceful village vibe, wide variety of accommodation and dining options. Read our Nusa Lembongan Guide for Family to find the right accommodation, restaurants, activities and travel tips. P.s. save 20% for boat transfers when you book your accommodation with us! [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

1. Getting to Nusa Lembongan

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70054" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" img_link_target="_blank" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/boat-transfers/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Nusa Lembongan is 30 minutes boat ride from Sanur. We can assist with your boat and land transfer with our recommended boat companies: D’Stars Fast Ferry, Rocky Fast Cruise, Setia Fast Ferry and Morin Private Transfer. If you're traveling with toddlers or elderly family members, we recommend booking the Rocky Fast Cruise for its hassle-free jetty-to-jetty service. With four daily departures, Rocky Fast Cruise ensures a seamless journey to Lembongan. You can also get 20% off for boat transfers when you book your accommodation with us. Group travel can sometimes be challenging to coordinate. To guarantee a smooth trip from the airport or your Bali hotel to your villa in Nusa Lembongan, we strongly recommend booking land transfers for both legs of your journey. This precaution also minimizes the risk of missing the boat due to traffic to Sanur port. Please note that private land transfer applies only to the Bali portion; in Lembongan, you will share the pickup vehicle with other passengers. For those seeking flexibility and an exclusive experience, consider booking a private boat transfer with Morin. If your flight schedule doesn't align with D’Stars, Rocky or Setia’s services, Morin and Rocky Fast Cruise Private Transfer can arrange a boat transfer at your preferred time with capacity up to 12 people.[/vc_column_text][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

2. Accommodation

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]Accommodation options in Nusa Lembongan cater to various family sizes and budgets, with choices between small resorts, beachfront bungalows and  private villas. Resorts offer more amenities, room types, and on-site restaurants, bungalows offer an authentic island experience, while villas provide privacy, larger living spaces, and kitchen facilities perfect for Nusa lembongan Family Holiday.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70055" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Resorts Perched above Jungutbatu Beach, Lembongan Island Beach Villas (LIBV) offers 10 spacious two- and three-bedroom villas—perfect for families or groups travelling together. Each villa features open-plan living, full kitchens, and generous balconies. Some villas include private plunge pools, and all guests have access to the shared infinity pool overlooking the ocean and majestic Mount Agung. With a prime location near surf breaks and beachfront restaurants, LIBV combines comfort, convenience, and excellent value. Batu Karang Resort, just minutes from Coconut Beach, is a five-star haven featuring three pools, three restaurants, a bar, and an on-site spa. Families will find the Two Bedroom Apartment particularly appealing, as it includes a living room and accommodates up to five people. All-time favourite resort Hai Tide in Mushroom Bay offers a variety of family-friendly accommodation in Lumbung or Villa style. Their Family Lumbung can comfortably accommodate two adults and two children, while the 2 Bedroom Private Villas provide a more exclusive experience with two bedrooms, a private pool with Australian standard pool fence, and an open-air living room. Plus, families can enjoy complimentary activities such as the pontoon with slide, banana boat rides, and mountain bikes.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70056" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Villas Nusa Lembongan boasts numerous beautiful villas, a few are designed specifically families with younger children in mind. Sandy Bay is a home to Villa Tranquilla, a peaceful four-bedroom haven perched on the cliffside with sweeping ocean views. This villa features generous indoor and outdoor living spaces, a spacious garden, and a dramatic infinity pool. One of the bedrooms includes bunk beds, perfect for younger guests, making this a luxurious yet family-friendly option in a quiet, scenic corner of the island. If you want to stay on the coastline, Villa Pantai and Villa Sayang at Tamarind Bay are your perfect choice. Villa Pantai is a beachfront favourite with bunk beds for the kids, a rumpus room, in-villa dining, a small gym, and a massage bale — ideal for relaxed family living. Meanwhile, Villa Sayang offers a classic Balinese-style estate with three- and four-bedroom options, two infinity pools, a massage room, and full-time staff — perfect for large groups wanting to settle in and stay awhile. On Jungutbatu Hill, Tenang Villas overlook the turquoise sea and Mount Agung with its one-, two-, and three-bedroom villas each with their own private pool, making it perfect for families who want flexibility and stunning views of Jungutbatu Beach and the mountain. But, if you want to stay right in the heart of the village, Villa Kasih provides a cosy, central base just a short stroll from the beach and nearby eateries. With three bedrooms, a private pool and inviting open-plan design, it’s a great option for families wanting to stay within walking distance of everything. Looking for more family-friendly stays?
Click here for the full collection of stays to suit every family size, style and budget.[/vc_column_text][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

3. Dining with Ease

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70058" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Thanks to the continuously expanding list of restaurants, dining out in Nusa Lembongan is more fun than ever. There are multiple cuisines on offer, from Indonesian, Mediterranean, Italian, even plant-based menus. Head to our EAT page for a list of restaurants in each area, or find family-friendly restaurants on the island on our blog. Make family dining an enjoyable affair for all and let the venue take care of the pick up and drop off as part of their service. Restaurants which offer complimentary transport include Sandy Bay Beach Club, Ohana’s, and Hai Bar & Grill. Now all you need to do is just pick which menu to order 😊[/vc_column_text][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

4. Maximizing Your Family Time

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70059" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]With a decade of experience organizing Lembongan holidays, we understand the challenge of ensuring everyone in the family is comfortable, safe, and happy. We’ve listed a couple of services that you may consider when planning your family holiday : Getting around:
  • Contact Made Transport for Island Tour, Buggy Hire or Scooter Rental services
Baby care:
  • Our trusted partner, Nusa Baby Care, offers everything from pool fence installation at your villa to baby equipment hire and nanny services — so you can enjoy peace of mind during the day and a little grown-up time in the evening.
Groceries:
  • Pre-order your groceries or special dietary  with Island Fresh or drop by to their charming store in Jungutbatu for fresh fruits, vegetables and more
Shop:
  • Anak Shack is your one stop shop for all things fashion, health & wellness, souvenirs, swim accessories and essentials for your island child.
Birthday cakes & treats:
  • Nothing beats an island birthday celebration! Koa Donut is happy to provide you with birthday cakes and treats.
[/vc_column_text][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

5. Keeping the Family Engaged

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70060" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Now, let's dive into the fun part of Nusa Lembongan Family Holiday, you have the freedom to do as much or as little as you like. Active travellers can revel in water activities in the island's crystal-clear waters. From snorkelling, surfing, stand-up paddleboarding, and diving to Jet Skiing, visitors of all ages will find something enjoyable. And what better way to infuse fun into sports than enrolling the family in surf lessons? Explore our blog on surfing in Nusa Lembongan to learn more. For those who prefer relaxation, there are pristine beaches to explore and beach clubs to unwind in Lembongan. Alternatively, you can attend one of the island's Movie Nights. Engaging in activities as a family not only brings you closer but also offers an excellent opportunity to learn something new. Playing mini golf at The Coconut Hut is a fantastic way to keep the young ones entertained and educated.[/vc_column_text][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][vc_column_text css=""]For more information about any of the above please contact our reservations team, our office in Lembongan is open 7 days a week. Email us: holiday@thelembongantraveller.com Call us or text us on WhatsApp: +61 478 928 925[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_separator type="transparent" border_style="" up="21px"][vc_column_text]

Title: Sun, Sea, and Casa Batu
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Sun, Sea, and Casa Batu

Welcome to Casa Batu, a stunning villa perched on the hill of Nusa Lembongan. Here, the ease of island living meets modern comfort, creating the perfect setting for an unforgettable tropical getaway. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

A Peek Inside Casa Batu

As you enter Casa Batu, you're instantly wowed by a spacious open-plan room that combines living, dining, and cooking spaces. Throughout the villa, the decor is minimalist yet inviting. Wooden furniture provides a homely feel, while white walls keeps the spaces looking clean and bright. This simple combination creates a fresh atmosphere, making the Casa Batu villa feel welcoming and relaxing.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="59572" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

The Heart Of The Home

The kitchen is fully equipped to cater to all your culinary needs. It's a chef's dream, complete with modern appliances and ample cookware. Right next to the kitchen, a dining table stands ready, perfect for shared meals and good conversations. The living area at Casa Batu is complete with a smart TV ideal for movie nights, two occasional chairs and a large sofa offering plenty of room for everyone to lounge and relax, comfortably. The main house's upper level has two bedrooms. The master bedroom features a king-sized bed, while the second bedroom offers two single beds that can be converted into a king. This room also includes a smart TV. Both bedrooms share a spacious bathroom, ensuring privacy and convenience. Additionally, these rooms open onto a shared outdoor terrace, a space where the panoramic views of Jungutbatu Beach and Mount Agung are truly breathtaking. Whether you're lounging in bed or grabbing a breath of fresh air outside, these sweeping views are a constant companion.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="59570" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][vc_single_image image="59844" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Chill-Out in Island-Style

Moving from the interior, glass doors open up to a welcoming outdoor patio. This space is thoughtfully designed for leisure, featuring comfortable sun loungers that invite you to recline and take in the warm island sun. The patio also has a wet edge pool, providing a refreshing escape where you can take a dip and cool off.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="59573" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Seclusion without the Exclusion

Set apart from the main house, Casa Batu offers a completely independent suite, creating an enclave of privacy within the property. This detached bedroom is furnished with a queen-sized bed and ensuite bathroom. The separation of this suite makes it an excellent option for those in larger groups or families who appreciate having their own space, as it allows for moments of privacy away from the group's communal areas.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="59575" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Indulgent Comforts

Guests can enjoy a daily breakfast, prepared by the friendly staff at a time of their choosing. The team also provides evening turn-down service and daily cleaning, adding to the convenience of your stay.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text]

Easy Access

Casa Batu stands out in Nusa Lembongan for its exceptional accessibility. Unlike many hillside villas that require a climb, Casa Batu is conveniently reachable by scooter or island taxi without the challenge of navigating stairs. This ease of access is a welcome advantage for guests looking to explore the island with simplicity and ease.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="59571" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

It's All About The Location

The villa's prime location further enriches its appeal. Perched on a hill, it's a stone's throw away from a diverse range of dining options, from quaint cafes to cliff-top restaurants that cater to all tastes and preferences. Moreover, Coconut and Jungutbatu beaches are within easy reach, providing picturesque settings for seaside relaxation, swimming, surfing, or simply enjoying the island's natural beauty. Title: Slow living in Villa Celagi
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Slow living in Villa Celagi

Nusa Lembongan offers a variety of stays for families, but if you and your loved ones seek a quiet escape, Villa Celagi can be your happy place. This Nusa Lembongan private villa is a four-bedroom seaside accommodation located on Tamarind Bay, with direct beach access, a private ocean-facing pool, and an open-air living room. At Villa Celagi, there's hardly any need to leave! [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Beachfront Tamarind Bay

Perched in Tamarind Bay, Slow living in Villa Celagi is the perfect blend of traditional Balinese elegance and modern luxury in a four-bedroom sanctuary. This Nusa Lembongan beach villa features four spacious en-suite bedrooms, two with king beds on each floor, and one upstairs room adaptable to twin beds, all designed to echo the villa's serene ambiance. The master bedroom, with its private seaside terrace, offers an ideal setting for relaxing sunsets and features a bathtub. Its prime location not only provides easy access to the renowned Playgrounds surf break but also places guests amidst an array of local attractions and dining options, perfect for travelling families.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="35455" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Ocean views from your bed

'Look at the colour of that water' is often the first reaction to Nusa Lembongan, captivating visitors as soon as they arrive. This sentiment is mirrored in this charming Balinese-style beach villa. Whether it's the morning sun casting a shimmer on the ocean or the moon's reflection at night, Villa Celagi's beachfront location spoils you with an uninterrupted vista, accompanied by the soothing sound of waves to drift you away in a daydream. On clear days, you might be able to spot Bali's majestic Mount Agung, adding extra charm to this Lembongan island accommodation.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="25763" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

In-villa luxuries

Villa Celagi proves that luxury service isn't exclusive to high-end resorts— one can experience it all here. Once you've checked into this beachfront villa, you might find little reason to leave, except perhaps for aquatic reasons. For those evenings you don’t feel like going out to eat, speak to the staff to assist you with ordering from the in-villa dining menu or have meals delivered from nearby restaurants. Whether it's a dip in your private pool, snorkelling in the turquoise waters on your doorstep, relaxing in the gazebo with book — time moves slowly here, and so can you.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="50436" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

The thrill of water sports

Kayaking, surfing, or snorkelling– boats with a captain including equipment can be rented for those eager for ocean adventures. Those who prefer terra firma can stay nice and dry with land tours that offer an equally exciting experience. Just reach out to the villa staff, who are ready to assist in any way you need.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="22169" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Stroll the beach

Tamarind Beach, where Villa Celagi sits, is chic and languorous. Ideally located between Playground's surf break and Mushroom Bay, it offers a white sandy coastline with crystal-clear turquoise waters. If you seek stillness, sprinkled with just enough activities to keep you on your feet, you won't need to venture too far out of your accommodation. This side of Lembongan, the northeastern side, is compact enough to explore with your family. Walk 5 minutes easterly towards Jungut Batu, past Morin Resort, down a few steps, and you'll find Coconut Beach. One of the most family-friendly beaches on the island, this beachfront spot is just a short paddle away from Playgrounds surf break. The Lago Beach Cafe, serving one of the best coffees in Nusa Lembongan, makes a perfect spot for people watching.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="46018" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Why You’ll Love Villa Celagi

  Slow living in Villa Celagi on Nusa Lembongan is an ideal getaway for families and couples seeking both tranquility and adventure. With its direct access to the pristine Tamarind Bay, luxurious amenities, and peaceful atmosphere, this private villa provides a perfect balance for a memorable family holiday, embodying the essence of an island escape with the comforts of a luxury home.   Check rates and availability here.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="60324" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Title: Love for Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Love for Lembongan

Continuing the support for the Lembongan community

Help us help Nusa Lembongan! Love for Lembongan is back with education and health focused initiatives to further support the Lembongan community. Donate HERE. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="61775" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="61774" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]Your donation will help us achieve these goals :
  1. EdTech
Introduction of EdTech solutions to facilitate Remedial Literacy and Numeracy education for grade 2 to 6 students in Nusa Lembongan and Ceningan, utilizing tablets and specialized apps. We are seeking funds to support at least 65 students who require improvement in their numeracy and literacy skills through tablets and welfare of the teachers.
  1. Teacher & program funding
Ensure funding is met to sustain the presence of BCF teachers at 7 schools, who provide English as Foreign Language (EFL), STEAM-H (Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, Math, Humanity), EdTech for grade 1 students, and Youth Empowerment by educating and training junior & senior high school students with environmental issues to help keep Lembongan and Ceningan clean.
  1. Priority Patients
Continued support for the Priority Patients program, assisting individuals seeking treatment for early epilepsy, behavioural and mobility issues, plus speech therapy.
  1. Health care for the seniors
Continue working with Bunda (our ‘island angel’ and certified nurse) to provide health support to the elderly and disadvantaged.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_empty_space][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="60343" img_size="large" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="60365" img_size="large" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]Your donation will support our mission to improve the quality of life for Lembongan locals, one student and one patient at a time. We look forward to spreading the love, with regular updates on our initiatives. Title: Escape to Sea Shanty

Escape to Sea Shanty: Sandy Bay’s Boho Chic One Bedroom Villa

Solo travellers and couples hoping to relax and leave their worries behind can check into one of Sandy Bay’s newest additions, Sea Shanty. It’s a retreat that provides the opportunity to unwind in ways that are equal parts boho and luxe. The vibe, created by the natural colours of teak and rattan, is homely and welcoming. So, prepare to cosy up. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

A Sandy Bay sanctuary

A stone's throw from the shimmering Sandy Bay Beach and white sandy stretches of Dream Beach, you’ll find Sea Shanty. This tranquil gem is conveniently located, with the popular Devil’s Tear only 700 meters away and the quaint Mushroom Bay Beach a short stroll from your doorstep. The villa itself is a relaxed retreat featuring a single bedroom, a kitchenette, a living room, a private pool, and a lush garden. This Nusa Lembongan accommodation also celebrates the great outdoors with a spacious Bale right by the pool, an ideal spot to soak in nature's beauty. When you're in the mood for some quiet time, simply draw the curtains, turn on the air conditioning, and enjoy your own private, home-like haven.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="53376" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Out of Office Mode : ON

At Sea Shanty, ‘out of reach’ becomes a charming excuse. It’s the perfect setup to unplug and unwind. While we encourage a complete digital detox, rest assured our WiFi is strong and reliable for those moments when you need to connect. It's just one login away, offering the best of both worlds – serene disconnection with the convenience of connectivity whenever required. For entertainment, if you prefer watching to reading, the villa is equipped with a large flat-screen Smart TV, or immerse in soundscapes with Bose speakers in the lounge.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="54861" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Soak in the sunshine

At Sea Shanty, the only thing working overtime is your SPF! The sun loungers are positioned for optimal sun exposure, a feature past guests have consistently praised. This seaside Nusa Lembongan villa is bathed in just the right amount of sunlight. Whether you're an early riser catching the gentle morning rays or a sunset admirer basking in the day's last light, the poolside experience at Villa Sea Shanty promises a sun-kissed sojourn. For those seeking respite from the sun, there is plenty of shade available in the comfy Bale by the pool.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="53312" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Golden hour swims, cocktail in hand

You're just a leisurely stroll, barely a minute, from Sea Shanty to the Sandy Bay Beach Club that's all about laid-back luxury. You can dip into the beachside pool as the sun dips low, bathing everything in a golden hue. In the mood for a classic drink or a light bite? Swim, lounge, feast, and sip to your heart's content. You're never too far from your comfortable retreat for good food and entertainment![/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="58186" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Why You’ll Love Villa Sea Shanty

Sea Shanty is just ‘right’ - the right amount of space, the right location, and the right balance of coziness and tropical allure. Whether you’re travelling solo or with your loved ones, Sea Shanty Villa makes a perfect base for your Nusa Lembongan escape at an affordable price tag. Title: Nusa Penida vs Nusa Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Nusa Penida or Nusa Lembongan: Picking Your Island Paradise

Let us explain some of the differences between the two islands, so you can consider your preferences and decide if Nusa Penida or Nusa Lembongan is for you. Nestled southeast of Bali, Indonesia, the neighbouring islands of Nusa Penida and Nusa Lembongan have emerged as sought-after tourist destinations, each offering a distinct set of experiences for travellers seeking a tropical escape. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Big or Small?

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text]Nusa Penida is the big brother, 210 km² with wild and untamed coastlines giving it a rugged vibe. On the flip side, Nusa Lembongan is the smaller sibling, with a laid-back village vibe, offering significantly more developed tourism friendly areas, with a total of 9 km² including Nusa Ceningan.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="60948" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Scenic Views Alert!

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text]Nusa Penida is the go-to for jaw-dropping cliffs and incredible landscapes. Kelingking Beach and Angel's Billabong are Insta-worthy spots you can't miss. Expect to line up under the sun to get your perfect IG pics with Kelingking beach as your backdrop! But if you're more of a beach bum who loves ocean swims, and enjoying your time away from the screen, Nusa Lembongan has its own draw cards with Dream Beach and Mushroom Bay – pure paradise![/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_gallery interval="3" images="61300,61301" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Chill or Thrill?

Penida is wild and raw, with more cars navigating thrilling hills and turns due to the island's vast distances. However, it's important to note that a single day trip might not be enough on Penida, as exploring both the east and west parts of the island is near on impossible to do all in one day. However, Lembongan and Ceningan are all about ease, offering various transport options such as motorbikes (with driver options), pick-up trucks, or renting a buggy to explore the island's charm. The good news is, a day trip on Lembongan is very much possible, allowing you to soak in the laid-back atmosphere and enjoy the island's highlights without feeling rushed. Whether you crave a wild road adventure on Penida or a laid-back exploration with diverse transport choices on Lembongan, both islands promise a unique escape.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="61310" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Fun in the Water: To Surf or Not To Surf?

Penida is the spot for diving and snorkelling enthusiasts, with vibrant marine life buzzing beneath the waters. These can be easily accessed when staying on either Lembongan or Penida. However, it's important to note that surfing isn't an option in Nusa Penida. On the other hand, Lembongan offers tranquil waters perfect for snorkelling, diving, or simply swimming from the shore – the choice is yours. What's more, if you're a fan of riding the waves, Lembongan boasts four fantastic surf breaks. These breaks are strategically situated on the western side of the island, lining the router-reef parallel to Jungutbatu, the main village of Nusa Lembongan. Nusa Ceningan also offers Mahana Point, a famous left hand surf break and also cliff jumping spot where you can leap into the ocean from different heights or simply sit back with a cold bintang and take in the action in the turquoise waters below. So, whether you're exploring the ocean depths or catching waves, both Nusa Penida and Nusa Lembongan cater to a diverse range of water adventures.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_gallery interval="3" images="61313,61314" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Getting There, Quick Hop or Longer Journey

Nusa Penida demands a bit more commitment as it involves a longer boat ride, approximately 45 minutes, from Bali. On the other hand, Lembongan, being closer, offers a shorter journey of around 30 minutes from Bali – making it ideal for those planning a quick day-trip from the mainland. Whether you're up for a slightly longer voyage to Penida or a quicker jaunt to Lembongan, both islands promise an exciting escape just a boat ride away from the bustling vibes of Bali.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="61000" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Fun Fact: Fueling Up on the Islands

Here's a cool fact for your island trip: in Nusa Penida, there are two service stations to fill up your tank with petrol. But in Nusa Lembongan, there's only one, and you have to cross the Yellow bridge to Nusa Ceningan to find it and get ready to be in a long queue! No worries, though! If you ever need petrol, you'll find plenty of friendly folks selling gas right on the streets of both Nusa Penida and Lembongan.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="61317" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

Island Living: Navigating Accommodation Choices between Nusa Penida and Lembongan

Nusa Penida and Nusa Lembongan offer distinct accommodation experiences. Nusa Penida is renowned for its local and authentic feel, providing guesthouses and homestays that offer a budget-friendly stay with opportunities to engage closely with the local community. The island also features mid-range hotels and emerging eco-resorts, often situated in more secluded areas due to its larger size and less developed nature. In contrast, Nusa Lembongan, being a more established tourist destination, boasts a greater concentration of beachfront resorts catering to luxury-seeking travellers. Additionally, mid-range options, private villas, bungalows, and budget-friendly guesthouses are more prevalent on Nusa Lembongan, offering a diverse range of accommodations for various preferences and budgets. If you're looking to explore accommodations in Lembongan, be sure to check out our Nusa Lembongan accommodation page to book and enjoy a 15% discount on boat transfers.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="61320" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]

In a Nutshell: What's Your Vibe?

So, whether you're vibing with Penida's wild side or feeling the chilled Lembongan vibes, both islands promise an unforgettable tropical getaway for discerning travellers.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="61001" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]For further details about Lembongan, don't hesitate to get in touch with our reservations team. Our Lembongan office is at your service seven days a week. You can reach out via email at holiday@thelembongantraveller.com or drop us a message on WhatsApp at +61 478 928 925.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_bottom="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][vc_column_text]

The Lembongan Traveller unveils the island's most romantic retreats, tailored for couples seeking an intimate escape. From private villas for couples to enchanting getaways, let's dive into the allure of these dreamy abodes that promise to whisk you away on a journey of love. Villa Utopia – From AU$275 per night

Location: Bukit area, overlooking Jungutbatu village

Perched on Jungutbatu Hill, Villa Utopia offers a peaceful retreat with breathtaking views of Mount Agung, the ocean, and lush jungle. Just a 5-minute drive from Coconut Beach and Jungutbatu's vibrant eat street, this eco-friendly villa blends comfort with sustainability.

The 1-bedroom villa (50 sq m) is ideal for couples or solo travelers. It features a king bed, a plunge pool, an en-suite bathroom, a living room, a kitchen, a covered seating area, and a sundeck. Villa Utopia embraces green living with solar panels, chemical-free pools, and locally sourced furnishings. Thoughtful touches, like food-grade cleaning products, enhance the eco-conscious experience. Enjoy tranquility, modern amenities, and spectacular scenery at Villa Utopia—your perfect hideaway in Nusa Lembongan. Priced at a steal for AU$295 per night, this one-bedroom haven is a love nest featuring an open plan living space, a private pool, and panoramic views of Mount Agung. Designed for honeymooners, Villa Madu boasts an all-white decor with locally sourced furnishings, setting the stage for a romantic retreat. Imagine relaxing on the bedroom balcony, enveloped in a net, while the sun dips below the horizon. Despite being just a 5-minute scooter ride from Coconut Beach and Jungutbatu's vibrant eat street, Villa Madu offers seclusion and tranquility. Spend evenings in the poolside bale under the stars and listen to waves crashing onto Devils Tear. With a large Bale at the pool's end, Sea Shanty invites you to immerse yourself in nature. Draw the curtains and turn on the air-conditioning for a cosy retreat or revel in the outdoors. Just 50 meters from Sandy Bay Beach Club, this fully staffed villa ensures a relaxing stay with daily housekeeping and subtle luxuries. Located on Jungutbatu Hill, Villa Tenang’s 1-bedroom villa is perfect for couples seeking a romantic escape. Just a short walk from Spring Spa and many restaurants, this serene hideaway offers breathtaking views of Mount Agung and the ocean.

The villa features a private pool, ocean views, a fully equipped kitchen, free Wi-Fi, and daily housekeeping. Wake up to stunning sunrises and unwind in your private sanctuary. Experience romance and relaxation at Villa Tenang, where comfort meets idyllic island charm. Title: Visit Nusa Lembongan During Off Peak Season
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Why You Need to Visit Nusa Lembongan During Off Peak Season

Visiting Nusa Lembongan during off peak season, when the crowds thin out and the sun shines brighter, can give you a different kind of adventure! Here are the reasons why you need to visit Nusa Lembongan during the off peak season. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_single_image image="61564" img_size="full" alignment="center" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Affordable Adventures

Travelling to Nusa Lembongan in off peak season means big savings! From cheaper stays to budget-friendly activities, you can stretch your holiday budget and make the most of your trip without worrying about breaking the bank. Did you know that you can get special rates when you travel during mid-January until mid-March, and also from mid-September to mid-December? Get your accommodation HERE.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][vc_single_image image="61567" img_size="full" alignment="center" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

Personalized Hospitality

With fewer tourists around, you can enjoy a more attentive, personal interaction with the friendly team at your villa or hotel, snorkelling captain or scooter hire operator. It's the perfect time to get to know the island from the local’s perspective and make new friends![/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_single_image image="61571" img_size="full" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text css=""]

Escape the Crowds

Say goodbye to long lines at the port and crowded surf breaks! During the off peak season, you can explore Nusa Lembongan's stunning sights on your version of “island time”. Similarly, the demand for beach clubs, restaurant bookings, day-spas and other facilities is greatly reduced so you can choose your timing to suit your plans during low season! It's your chance to soak up the island's beauty at your own pace. See what you can do on the island HERE.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_single_image image="72565" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text css=""]

Meet Mola-mola

One of the most magical reasons to visit Lembongan during off peak season is the chance to encounter the elusive mola-mola (sunfish). From July to October, these incredible creatures rise from the deep to bask in the island’s cooler waters, offering divers a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Whether you’re a seasoned diver or looking to tick something special off your bucket list, you can join trusted operators like Bali Diving Academy, Bali Hai Diving Adventures or Scuba Center Asia for guided dives to safely meet these gentle giants in their natural habitat.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][vc_single_image image="61573" img_size="full" alignment="center" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Support Local Communities

By visiting during the off peak season, you're helping support the local community. Whether it's enjoying a meal at a family-owned restaurant or picking up souvenirs from local artisans, every little bit helps make a positive impact. You can also share your love for Lembongan HERE.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][vc_single_image image="61576" img_size="full" alignment="center" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Enjoy Sunny Days

Nusa Lembongan boasts its own micro-climate and weather patterns, offering more sunny days and less rain compared to Bali. Whilst it’s hard to predict the weather these days, you can still get reasonable amounts of sunshine and stunning sunsets during the off peak season! HERE is some recommendations for sunset spots on Nusa Lembongan.[/vc_column_text][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][vc_column_text css=""]In a nutshell, off peak season travel to Nusa Lembongan is a chance to experience this island paradise in a whole new light. With affordable adventures, personalized hospitality, and hidden treasures waiting to be discovered, it's an opportunity you won't want to miss. So pack your bags, embrace the off-season, and get ready for an unforgettable adventure in Nusa Lembongan! Our team is always here to help you have the perfect Lembongan stay and arrange the boat transfers for your next island getaway.
