Title: Where to Stay in Nusa Lembongan – Villas or Resorts?
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]Nusa Lembongan, a small island off the coast of Bali, boasts crystal clear waters just a 30-minute boat ride from Sanur. With its diverse range of accommodations, the island caters to every traveller's needs. If you're undecided between staying in a villa or resort, let us guide you through the main differences and options for your most memorable Nusa Lembongan holiday. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]

Villas

Offering the comfort and amenities akin to a private house, along with personalized service and unique designs, villas are the ultimate way to experience Nusa Lembongan. From cliff-top retreats to beachfront sanctuaries, the island's villas promise unforgettable holiday memories. Villas often feature spacious living areas, kitchens, private pools, and multiple bedrooms, creating an ideal environment for families or friends to bond.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="62584" img_size="full" add_caption="yes" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_column_text css=""]For those seeking opulent retreats, options like Villa Sayang, Tranquilla, or Pantai stand out with their lavish facilities and personalized services reminiscent of boutique hotels. Villa Sayang, a beloved choice for families and retreats, boasts seven bedrooms, expansive living spaces, two swimming pools, a massage room, and even a private boat for snorkelling and surfing adventures. Similarly, Villa Pantai, nestled along Tamarind Bay, offers beachfront luxury with six bedrooms, a rumpus room, massage bale, and exclusive access to a chartered catamaran for villa guests.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="62591" img_size="full" add_caption="yes" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_column_text css=""]Further along Sandy Bay area is Villa Tranquilla, a four-bedroom villa with beautifully manicured gardens, a rumpus room, bunk room, and a master bedroom and bathroom with ocean views. All villas come with in-villa dining facilities, allowing you to enjoy meals with your loved ones without stepping out.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="62697" img_size="full" add_caption="yes" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_column_text css=""]For couples, a villa offers more privacy and romantic ambiance than a hotel room. Couples havens like Madu, Sea Shanty, or Damai are tucked away and designed with privacy in mind. In essence, villas afford the luxury of quality time with loved ones in a home-like setting, enriched by personalized service and ample space for cherished memories.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_column_text]

Resorts

For travellers seeking a blend of practicality and leisure, resorts offer an enticing proposition with their amenities and prime locations. Unlike the sprawling resorts found on Bali's main island, those on Nusa Lembongan exude boutique charm, featuring fewer rooms yet more attentive service.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="62698" img_size="full" add_caption="yes" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_column_text css=""]Designed to feel playful, adventurous and carefree, Morin Resort is a heritage boutique hotel where everyone feels like family. Morin Resort offers a range of rooms and suites designed in a rustic, eco-chic style using repurposed wood and materials for a different and unique experience. Couples can opt for the Ocean Suite, while families can enjoy the comfort of Family Bungalow with a room for parents on top floor and a twin room for the children on the ground floor. Additionally, you can indulge in delicious cuisine crafted with fresh and locally sourced ingredients in their plant-based restaurant, The Playful Table. Located on a secluded and peaceful side of Nusa Lembongan, you can still access the beaches in just 3 minutes walk.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="76138" img_size="full" add_caption="yes" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_column_text css=""]White Horse Resort sits right on the beachfront of Tamarind Bay, making it an easy choice for those chasing ocean views and laid-back island days. Each room overlooks the resort’s beautiful pool, while accommodation ranges from cosy one-bedroom villas to spacious two-bedroom Poolside or Upper Lodges, perfect for families or small groups wanting extra space.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="62606" img_size="full" add_caption="yes" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_column_text css=""]Batu Karang Resort offers a diverse range of accommodation, along with three pools, a gym, a spa, and an eclectic mix of dining experiences, from fine dining to a whisky bar, all set against the stunning backdrop of Jungutbatu Beach. It’s a great choice for travellers seeking comfort, excellent facilities, and a convenient location with everything you need for a relaxing island stay.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="62599" img_size="full" add_caption="yes" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_column_text css=""]Ideal for small families, couples, or solo adventurers, resorts span expansive grounds and offer amenities such as multiple swimming pools, on-site dining options, and sometimes even spa facilities. Ohana's, nestled along Jungutbatu beach, is a perfect example with fewer than 25 rooms, a kids' playground, boutique, and a lively beach club hosting regular live music performances.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="62609" img_size="full" add_caption="yes" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_column_text css=""]A long-time family favourite, Hai Tide resort offers complimentary activities for in-house guests, from water sports to village visits. Their iconic lumbung-style accommodations are not the only option, as they also have two-bedroom villas with Australian standard pool fences. Their two beachfront restaurants Hai Bar & Grill and Hai Ri Zen are popular and can even cater to private functions such as weddings or birthdays.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="76139" img_size="full" add_caption="yes" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_column_text css=""]ARNA Suites and Ocean Lounge in Nusa Ceningan is a cliffside retreat just steps from Blue Lagoon Beach, offering a unique luxury tent stay with sweeping ocean views. Surrounded by lush gardens, the property features a swimming pool, terrace, and bar, creating a peaceful island escape. Each tent is thoughtfully designed with air-conditioning, a private bathroom, tea and coffee facilities, a mini-bar, and stunning sea views. Perfect for travellers seeking a unique stay, fresh ocean breezes, and unforgettable sunset views.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]Still not sure where to stay? Let our team at The Lembongan Traveller assist you with your travel planning. Contact us through holiday@thelembongantraveller.com or give us a call at +61 478 928 925.[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_bottom="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Title: Kids-approved Restaurants in Nusa Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]Travelling to Nusa Lembongan with your children is a special experience that is sure to create memories that will last a lifetime. To make your holiday an unforgettable and scrumptious one, we have created a list of the best child-friendly restaurants in Nusa Lembongan to go to as a family. Trust us when we say that these island gems will make your time on the island fun, relaxing and of course, tasty. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

The Coconut Hut

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="63289" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_column_text css=""]Are you looking for a slice of competitive family fun? The Coconut Hut, located towards the northern end of Jungutbatu's beach, has its very own mini golf course. Yes, you read that right! An island-themed mini golf course! But, this isn't just any old putting green, it's an adventure for the whole family! Their kids’ menu, aptly named, 'Little Coconuts' offers delicious animal-faced peanut butter toast, cheese toasties (served with or without crusts), fresh fruits, and the classic Nasi Goreng. Celebrate your game of golf with these scrumptious bites that will truly impress your little champions. It's the perfect mix of play and taste, not to be missed! IG:@thecoconuthutlembongan[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

The Beach Shack

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="63017" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_column_text css=""]If you're looking for a sandy playground on the beach, look no further than The Beach Shack! With its stunning ocean views, beautiful sunsets, and a menu full of tasty treats, this spot offers a fantastic day out for families and friends alike. While the kids enjoy the wooden climbing wall, parents can kick back on cosy daybeds and indulge in a yummy bite to eat. P.S. Their vegan milkshakes are a must-try and will be hard for your little ones to resist! IG: @thebeachshack.lembongan[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Ombak Cafe & Huts

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="63021" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_column_text css=""]Perfectly placed in the heart of Jungutbatu Beach, Ombak Cafe & Huts offers something special for everyone. Toddlers can build sandcastles, play with toys, and cool off in the picture-perfect blue waters. But the fun doesn’t end there. Ombak's 'Grommies' menu, with crowd favourites such as crispy chicken n' chips, grilled cheese, chocolate brownies, and refreshing ice creams, will keep the groms as satisfied as their parents. IG: @ombakcafeandhuts[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Kayu Lembongan

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="63023" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_column_text css=""]Kayu Lembongan is where delicious dining meets play in a kid-friendly environment. Nestled in a lush garden on the main street of Jungutbatu, your youngsters have the freedom to run free in the grass and play under the trees, or enjoy colouring-in while they wait for their meals. The kids' menu includes baby puree pouches, fruit salad, chicken tenders, and fluffy pancakes. I mean, who doesn’t love pancakes? IG: @kayulembongan[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Ohana's

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="63290" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_column_text css=""]It’s no coincidence that Ohana’s means ‘family’ in Hawaiian. More than just a boutique resort and beach club, it's Lembongan's go-to destination for unforgettable moments with your loved ones. Featuring a wonderful playground, two pools with shallow ends, and marshmallow roasting by the bonfire, Ohanas guarantees that your adventurous kiddos are always entertained. Adding to the fun, the 'Little People' menu allures younger guests with crispy battered fish fingers, rigatoni bolognese, corn cobs, and sweet Little Ohana’s waffles, topped off with an excellent selection of ice creams. IG: @ohanaslembongan[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

The Sampan

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="63036" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_column_text css=""]Dive into a cultural feast at The Sampan, perfectly positioned on the bustling northern end of Jungutbatu’s main road. This spot offers more than just good food; it's a playground for the senses. Children can let loose in the dedicated play area, while the whole family can enjoy daily live music. It's a unique eating experience that spices up your meal with a dash of local flair! Not keen on driving? No problem! The Sampan offers free pick-up and drop-off services from your accommodation. IG: @thesampan.lembongan[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Sandy Bay Beach Club

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="63861" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_column_text css=""]Sandy Bay Beach Club is a paradise for families in Nusa Lembongan! Overlooking the stunning Devil's Tear, this beachfront gem offers a new kids' play area that will keep your little ones entertained for hours. Parents can relax by the pool or enjoy a meal from their extensive menu while the kids have fun. And don't forget the sweet treats – their delicious gelatos and popsicles are a hit with children. With its magical setting and family-friendly atmosphere, Sandy Bay Beach Club is the perfect spot for a day of fun and relaxation. IG: @sandybaylembongan[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Hai Bar & Grill

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="63038" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_column_text css=""]A classic family favourite, Hai Bar & Grill ticks all the boxes for families: great food selection, beachfront, complimentary shuttle, bean bags to watch sunset and movies under the stars, and a large pool. Parents would love a cocktail by the beach bar whilst kids spend time on the beach or pool - win win! IG: @haibarandgrill[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Sanghyang Bay Bar & Restaurant

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="71895" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Sanghyang Bay Bar & Restaurant in Mushroom Bay is the perfect spot for families to enjoy a relaxed meal by the sea. Set under shady trees with sunset views, parents can unwind while little ones have fun in the kids’ playground or play on the sand just steps away.

The menu caters to all tastes, from wood-fired pizzas and fresh salads to hearty favourites like seafood sets, pork ribs, and steak. Kids will love sharing pizzas or simple grilled dishes, while parents can take advantage of the daily happy hour with buy 1, get 1 free cocktails from 4–6.30pm.

Adding a fun twist, families can also join a cooking class with Sanghyang Bay’s Balinese chef – a hands-on experience that lets everyone discover local flavours together. It’s a place where great food, family time, and stunning sunsets come together beautifully.

IG: @sanghyangbaybar[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Alponte Ristorante

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="63041" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_column_text css=""]Delicious pizzas with breathtaking scenery of Nusa Ceningan Island? Yes, please! Both adults and kids will love Alponte Ristorante. From mini margaritas to mouth-watering pizzas, this beachside restaurant is a treat for the eyes and the tummies. Besides its authentic Italian cuisine, they have a pool with a view, where everyone can play and relax under the sun. Oh, and before I forget, If you are a party of 3 or more, Alponte offers a free pick-up and drop-off service from your hotel. Indeed, Alponte is sure to keep you and your little bambini at the table, very happy. IG: @alponte_ristorante[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Koa Donuts

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="63006" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Filled with delicious, colourful doughnuts and the warm smiles of Lembongan locals, Koa Donuts is a hit for both kids and adults. Baked fresh with love each morning, these treats sell like hotcakes, so make sure to swing by early. You may as well grab a few extra for an afternoon snack.

Title: How to Get to Nusa Lembongan from Sanur

How to Get to Nusa Lembongan from Sanur

Are you ready to embark on an unforgettable adventure from Sanur to Nusa Lembongan? With its stunning beaches and crystal-clear waters, Nusa Lembongan is a paradise waiting to be explored. Here's everything you need to know to ensure a smooth boarding process and an enjoyable journey. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Distance and Duration

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_single_image image="63303" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]

The distance between Bali and Nusa Lembongan is approximately 15 kilometres, with a quick 30 to 40-minutes boat ride. Rest assured, the boats are spacious, safe, and equipped with modern safety gear, ensuring your peace of mind throughout the journey.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Sanur Port

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_single_image image="63309" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]

The Port is newly opened in 2022 and located on Jalan Matahari Terbit. Every day, more than 20 vessels take travellers to various destinations including Nusa Lembongan, Nusa Ceningan, Nusa Penida and Gili islands.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Boarding Steps

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_single_image image="63305" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]Get your boarding pass Head to the fast boat office to collect your boarding pass and check in your luggage. At the office, you will receive a small paper boarding pass with QR code along with either a boat lanyard tag or a wristband, depending on the boat provider. Additionally, you'll be given a note for your return journey, which is essential to keep safe as you'll need to present it to the boat office in Nusa Lembongan on your departure date. Walk to the port Take a short walk to the port where your boat awaits. The entrance gate is located on the left side of the port. Along the way, you'll pass several stalls where you can purchase water and snacks for your boat ride before entering the port. Security Check and wait in the waiting room Once you enter the port, you'll encounter a barrier gate in the terminal. Here, the staff will scan the QR code on your boarding pass. Only those with a boarding pass QR code are permitted to enter the gate and proceed to the waiting room upstairs. Board your boat An announcer will call your boat’s name. Prepare your boarding pass once again and follow the crew for instructions.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Arrival Points in Nusa Lembongan

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_single_image image="67525" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]When arriving in Nusa Lembongan, different fast boat operators drop passengers at different locations. Choosing the right one can save you time and make your transfer smoother. Here’s a quick guide to help you pick the best arrival point based on your stay: Jungutbatu Bay If you're staying in the Jungutbatu area, D’Stars Fast Ferry and Setia Fast Ferry are the most convenient choices. They drop you right in the heart of Jungutbatu, making it easy to reach nearby accommodations. Mushroom Bay Staying near Mushroom Bay? The Tanis Fast Cruise and Dream Beach Express are your options. They offer direct access to this area, known for its calm waters and scenic surroundings. Telatak Harbour For a jetty-to-jetty experience, Rocky Fast Cruise is the ideal choice. Unlike other arrival points where passengers disembark into the water, Telatak is the only harbor that offers a dry landing via a proper jetty. Each arrival point offers different advantages, so selecting the right fast boat operator ensures a hassle-free start to your Nusa Lembongan getaway![/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Tips

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_single_image image="63310" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="10px"][vc_column_text css=""]
  • Unless you book Rocky Fast Cruise with jetty to jetty service, you will land on water. Wear appropriate clothes (shorts and flip flops) and be mindful when carrying your suitcase as it can be hard to drag on sand. You can opt to store your luggage at one of the luggage drop services near the port for extra convenience.
  • Traffic to reach Sanur Port can be unpredictable and we strongly suggest to spare extra transport time. For the most practical way to reach the port, book a transfer that includes pickup and drop off by the boat company.
  • Go to the toilet before boarding as only some fast boats have a toilet onboard. But with the boat going at 50 km/h, it will not be the easiest toilet experience.
  • Sit at the back of the boat to reduce the up and down bouncing motion experienced during the ride.
  • The smoothest rides are often in the morning before the wind picks up. Less chop on the water.
  • No F&B service on the boat, so you can bring your own water and snacks.
  • Separate your travel bag and take a small backpack for your water and snacks as your luggage will be put in the main storage area of the boat.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Title: Nusa Lembongan Snorkelling Guide
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

SNORKELLING IN NUSA LEMBONGAN

Imagine a world where coral reefs light up the sea floor and lively fish zip in and around the waves. Welcome to Nusa Lembongan, a snorkeller's heaven that promises every visitor an experience to remember forever. Whether you're a first-timer clinging to a floatation device or a seasoned snorkeller free diving into deeper waters, Lembongan's ocean has treasures for all. So, if you're ready to float over some of the most pristine reefs on the planet, here’s your ultimate guide to snorkelling in Nusa Lembongan. First things first — these are our go-to ocean guides on the island, the ones we trust to show you Lembongan at its best. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][portfolio_list type="standard" masonry_space="no" columns="3" image_size="square" order_by="title" order="ASC" lightbox="no" show_like="no" category="Snorkel & SUP" title_font_size="12"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Top Snorkelling Spots to Explore around Nusa Lembongan

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="64036" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text css=""]

Mangrove Point

Located off the Northeast coast of the island, Mangrove Point is a crowd favourite, and you will soon understand why. Famous for its stronger currents, Mangrove Point is a drift snorkel that will have you feeling like you’re motoring through the water.  Bursting with marine life, swimming pool-like waters, and lively coral reefs, you can expect to encounter schools of reef fish that will have you memorised, also keep your eyes peeled for turtles.

Manta Point

Situated off the southern coast of Nusa Penida, Manta Point offers an awe-inspiring snorkelling experience where you can witness the majestic dance of reef manta rays. Getting to Manta Point is an adventure in itself, but the ± 40-minute boat ride is well worth the chance to snorkel alongside these gentle giants. The journey to and from promises scenic views of towering limestone cliff faces and incredible rock formations, so don't forget your camera. The clear waters and frequent manta sightings make this spot unforgettable.

Crystal Bay

Famous for its crystal-clear waters and vibrant marine life, Crystal Bay is a snorkeller's dream. Nestled on the west coast of Nusa Penida, this bay is home to a colourful array of fish, sea turtles, and the occasional sunfish, a.k.a the Mola-Mola. Crystal Bay’s calm waters and rich coral gardens offer a spectacular underwater display, making it a perfect spot home for Nemo’s and snorkellers of all skill levels.

The North Coast of Nusa Penida

The North Coast offers a unique snorkelling adventure, known best for its drift snorkelling sites. The mild to moderate currents carry you over sloping reefs teeming with marine life. From colourful coral formations to schools of tropical fish, the dynamic underwater environment here is nothing short of a live-action natural masterpiece. This area is ideal for those looking to experience the thrill of drift snorkelling in a breathtaking setting.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Snorkelling Tips for the Best Experience

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="64015" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text css=""]

Flotation

Consider using a life jacket if you’re not a strong swimmer. This will help you to enjoy the experience even more, and prevent accidental damage to the reef from standing on it.

Sun Protection

Don't let the breezy ocean fool you; the sun in tropical climates doesn't pull any punches. To avoid a sunburn that could ruin your holiday vibe, wear a rash guard or a UV protective suit. Lather on some waterproof sunscreen that’s reef-safe to protect your skin and the marine environment.

Respect Marine Life

It’s awesome to see marine creatures in their natural habitat, but remember, we’re just visitors. Chasing or touching animals like turtles and fish can stress them out or cause them harm. Remember to keep a respectful distance from all marine life and coral formations.

Be Environmentally Conscious

Snorkelling offers a unique opportunity to interact with marine life of all shapes and sizes, but with great snorkelling spots comes great responsibility. Always avoid leaving any trash behind, including plastic wrappers, bottles, or cigarette butts. If you see rubbish floating around, grab a few pieces and take them back to the boat with you. This will help to keep the reefs as pristine as possible.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

What to Bring on the Boat

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="64023" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text css=""]

Water and Snacks

It’s easy to get dehydrated out on the water, so bring plenty of water to drink throughout the day. Healthy snacks like fruits, nuts, or energy bars can keep your energy up during your snorkelling sessions.

Towels and Extra Clothing

A few towels will come in handy for drying off after your snorkel. It's also a good idea to bring extra clothing for changing into once you're done, as sitting in wet gear can be uncomfortable and chilly.

Seasickness Medication

If you’re prone to motion sickness, consider taking seasickness medication before boarding or bring some with you just in case.

Camera or Waterproof Phone Case

You’ll definitely want to capture the underwater magic, so bring along a waterproof camera or a waterproof case for your phone.

Eco-Friendly Bag for Trash

Keep a reusable bag handy for collecting any trash during the trip, ensuring nothing gets left behind or thrown overboard.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Making the Most of Your Trip

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="64034" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text css=""]After a day spent marvelling at the underwater wonders, unwind on the soft sands of Nusa Lembongan’s beaches. Littered with incredible cafes and restaurants, you can sip a cold coconut and grab a bite to eat while watching the sun dip below the horizon.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Embark on Your Snorkelling Adventure

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="64030" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text css=""]Nusa Lembongan is the gateway to exploring the vibrant life under the waves. Each snorkel site on the island offers a unique experience, ensuring that your days here are filled with awe and happiness. So, gear up, dive in, and let the aquamarine waters of Nusa Lembongan turn your vacation into an unforgettable snorkelling adventure![/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_bottom="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Title: Bali Brunch Island Style
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Bali Brunch Island Style: Nusa Lembongan Day Trip with Lembongan Beach Club

With Nusa Lembongan being so popular now, have you always wanted to visit the island for a day to see what the buzz is all about? A day trip from Bali is just what you need, made even better with a Bali Brunch island style. Our day package tour from Lembongan Beach Club may be the right experience for you. With return boat transfers from Sanur to Nusa Lembongan, the day trip includes beachfront brunch, pool use, an island tour, and snorkelling, all packaged in one. You can experience the best of the island in one day. The itinerary is packed with action but also gives you ample time to relax and enjoy the village vibe of the island, as well as the resort’s facilities and tranquil ambiance. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

What to Expect

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="64254" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]

Once you’re in Sanur Port, you will go to the Equator boat office to check-in and enjoy complimentary coffee and tea whilst waiting to board. Please note that Equator does not provide pick-up services from your accommodation in Bali, so you should be at Sanur Port at least 30 minutes before the boarding time. Nusa Lembongan is just a 30-minute boat ride from Bali, and the Equator boat conveniently drops you off close to Lembongan Beach Club, so there's no extra travel time or hassle.

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="64255" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]

The day starts with an island tour with the resort’s very own buggy car and driver. First time visitors will enjoy a visit to the breath-taking Devil’s Tears to see the waves crashing against rock-formation. Just steps away from the Devil’s Tears is Dream Beach, a favourite spot to tan, picnic or have a few beers. The next stop is Yellow Bridge, which connects Nusa Lembongan with Nusa Ceningan, with sparkling crystal-clear waters under the bridge. A photo at Yellow Bridge completes the tour and you’re ready for the next activity – brunch!

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="64256" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]

Having been back from sightseeing around the island, the brunch at their SeaSky Restaurant feels like a treat with its selection of local and Asian-inspired dishes, snacks and desserts. Tea or coffee is included, and so is the turquoise blue waters view from the beach!

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="64259" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]

Take a break on the sun lounger before you embark on your next fun activity – snorkelling. A local snorkelling captain will take you to Mangrove point to discover the rich and colourful marine life not far from the resort. All equipment is provided (just carry a bottle of water with you) so all you have to do is change into your swimsuit and revel in the marvellous underwater life.

With all the fun, it’s hard to imagine the day coming to a wrap.  By now you would have had a taste of the island life – the diverse landscape, clear waters, friendly locals and rich marine life. The driver will take you back to the drop off point to embark on your return journey to Sanur.

Title: Best Areas to Stay in Nusa Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]Nusa Lembongan is a tropical paradise that attracts travellers from all corners of the world. With its crystal-clear waters, white sand beaches, perfect waves, stunning coral reefs, and laid-back vibe it's no wonder that it features on most people's bucket lists. But where are the best areas to stay in Nusa Lembongan to make the most of your visit? Let’s explore the island’s most popular areas to help you find the perfect pad for your dream holiday. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Sandy Bay

[/vc_column_text][vc_single_image image="64398" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]Sandy Bay, located on the western side of Nusa Lembongan, is known for its tranquillity and stunning natural scenery. This area is perfect for those looking for a more secluded getaway. Sandy Bay is renowned for its pretty sunsets, dramatic cliffs, and secret beaches. The rocky landscape and fewer crowds make for a peaceful environment, perfect for relaxation. The famous Devil’s Tear is a highlight in this area, where waves crash against the cliffs, creating blowholes and impressive sea sprays. While Sandy Bay doesn’t have as many dining options as other parts of the island, the quality of the available restaurants is exceptional. The Sandy Bay Beach Club is a popular spot, offering delicious meals with a beachfront view. The dining experience here is more intimate and upscale, perfect for romantic dinners or special occasions. Since Sandy Bay is further away from the action, you might need to rent a scooter to get around, but don't worry, Nusa Lembongan is small, making everything easy to get to. Our accommodation picks: Villa Tranquilla (4 bedrooms) is ideal for families whilst couples will like Sea Shanty (1 bedroom), and young families or friends love Kokomo (2 bedrooms), or Lagarto (2 bedrooms).[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Jungutbatu - Village

[/vc_column_text][vc_single_image image="64399" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]Jungutbatu, positioned on the northern coast of Nusa Lembongan, is the hub and the main entrance to the island. This area is ideal for those who want to be in the middle of the action, with easy access to activities, restaurants, and ease of getting around. Jungutbatu has the longest stretch of beach on the island, perfect for morning or afternoon strolls, sunbathing, and swimming. With a variety of cafes, restaurants, and beach clubs lining the beach, it is easy to get comfy and spend the whole day lounging on the sand. For surfers, Shipwrecks and Razors surf breaks are located just off Jungutbatu Beach and can be reached either by paddling out or by taking a surf taxi. Alternatively, Playground and Lacerations are best accessed from Coconut Beach, which is conveniently connected to Jungutbatu by the boardwalk. Numerous dive shops and tour operators are located on and around Jungutbatu Beach, offering a variety of excursions, from snorkeling, and scuba diving, to surf lessons, jet skiing, and much more. Staying in Jungutbatu is great for travellers who enjoy being in a social environment with plenty of amenities and activities at their fingertips. Jungutbatu offers a wide range of accommodation options to suit every type of traveller. From cozy bungalows to the best Nusa Lembongan resorts and luxurious villas, there’s something for everyone. The area also boasts the most extensive selection of restaurants on Nusa Lembongan. From local warungs serving delicious Indonesian food to international restaurants offering a variety of cuisines, you’ll never run out of places to eat. Many restaurants are either beach or cliff-front, providing a wonderful setting for enjoying meals with a view of the ocean. Getting around Jungutbatu is easy, with well-paved roads and a variety of transportation options, including scooters, bicycles, taxis, and even buggies. Our accommodation picks: Villa Kasih is a 3 bedroom private villa located on a quiet alley of Indiana Kenanga. Those looking for a more affordable option can consider Gecko Villa & Bungalows and Tropica Tranquility, both are minutes away from the beach and Jungutbatu’s eat street.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Jungutbatu - The Hill

[/vc_column_text][vc_single_image image="64400" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]Perched between Jungutbatu Beach and Coconut Beach, The Hill is littered with luxurious accommodations and offers panoramic views of the ocean and the iconic Mount Agung. This slice of the island is ideal for families, couples, and groups of friends looking for a serene and upscale retreat with convenient access to a variety of amenities. Most of the Nusa Lembongan villas have private pools, spacious living areas, and modern finishings. They often come with multiple bedrooms, large living spaces, private pools and fully equipped kitchens, making them ideal for your island getaway. Wondering where to eat on Nusa Lembongan while staying on the hill? A wide selection of restaurants can be found on the boardwalk that cater to various tastes. From traditional Indonesian dishes to global favourites, you’ll find something to satisfy every palate. The restaurants offer spectacular views and a unique dining experience where you can enjoy your food while staring out over the island and the ocean. Coconut Beach is easily reachable via the boardwalk on the Hill. This boardwalk not only offers a convenient route but also provides a pleasant stroll with beautiful coastal vistas, making it a highlight for both tourists and locals. Our accommodation picks: Enjoy panoramic ocean and mount Agung views from Lembongan Island Beach Villas, Casa Batu, Tenang Villas, and Beach Tonic. Surfers and beach goers will love its close distance to Playground and Laceration surf breaks, Coconut & Jungubatu beach, restaurants and day spas.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Bukit

[/vc_column_text][vc_single_image image="65547" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]The Bukit area, just east of Jungutbatu Hill, offers breathtaking views of Jungutbatu Village and the majestic Mount Agung. It’s a peaceful retreat, ideal for those wanting to escape the crowds while still being close to the island’s main attractions. The area’s elevated position offers tranquil surroundings, perfect for relaxing and enjoying the natural beauty of the island. Our accommodation picks: Villa Madu (1 bedroom) offers a romantic and intimate setting that makes it ideal for couples, while Villa Madu Dua (2 bedrooms) provides more space for families or groups.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Tamarind Bay

[/vc_column_text][vc_single_image image="64401" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]Tamarind Bay is a real slice of our Island paradise, perfect for those who love to swim, sunbathe, and enjoy the peace and quiet. Home to some of the best Nusa Lembongan luxury villas, Tamarind Bay is especially popular with families or groups looking to spend quality time in the villa. Most of the villas in the area offer multiple bedrooms and facilities such as bunk room, game room as well as in-villa dining options so you can enjoy delicious meals prepared by the staff without having to venture out to eat. From the beach, you can paddle to Playgrounds and Lacerations surf breaks in just a few minutes, making it a favourite locale for surfers and water sport enthusiasts alike. Tamarind Bay is also a great spot for snorkelling tours on Nusa Lembongan, with boats departing directly from the beach (depending on sea conditions).This makes it an ideal base for exploring the underwater wonders of the island without having to go too far from your front door. If you are in the mood for a unique dining experience, head over to The Playful Table, a mostly plant-based restaurant just a short walk over the nearby headland. For a change of scenery, continue your stroll over the headland to Coconut Beach, which connects you to the boardwalk and Jungutbatu Beach. Here you will find countless restaurants and activities for the whole family. While making your way along the boardwalk, you'll find Spring Spa, touted as one of the best spas on Nusa Lembongan. With its blissful ambience, luxurious accommodations, and convenient access to activities, staying in Tamarind Bay should definitely be on your list when choosing your next Nusa Lembongan private villa. Our accommodation picks : Villa Pantai is a haven for families with absolute beachfront location, 6 bedrooms and a bunk room and a private pool. Right next to it is White Horse, a stylish compound of 8 villas and 2 pools. Jipsi Beach House, Villa Coral and Villa Celagi feature 4 bedrooms each with private pool and stunning ocean and Mount Agung views. And not to be forgotten, set on the headland of Tamarind Beach with views to Bali and Mount Agung is Villa Sayang, which offers luxury accommodation sleeping up to 14 people.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Mushroom Bay

[/vc_column_text][vc_single_image image="64402" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_column_text css=""]Mushroom Bay in Nusa Lembongan is situated on the southwestern coast of the island and strikes a perfect balance between seclusion and convenience. It is a great spot for those who want to unwind but still have easy access to what the island has to offer. The Bay itself is one of the main entry points to the island and offers visitors the chance to roll out their towels and enjoy a refreshing swim. If you wake up early enough, you may be the first one in the water. On the other side of Mushroom Bay's main beach, you'll find another beautiful shoreline that provides a fantastic spot to lay out on the white sand and take dips in the turquoise seas. Dream Beach, which is a popular attraction, is found in the Mushroom Bay area and is a must-visit. There are numerous scuba diving shops, snorkelling centers, and tour operators scattered around the area. These shops offer everything from beginner diving courses to advanced dive trips, allowing you to explore the vibrant coral reefs and diverse marine life that Nusa Lembongan is famous for. Snorkelling tours are also popular, providing an easy and enjoyable way to discover the underwater world. And if you're looking for something else, you can book various other excursions, such as fishing trips, sunset cruises, and island-hopping tours. The area has a mix of accommodations, from lavish villas to beachfront bungalows, ensuring that every visitor can find the perfect place to stay. Mushroom Bay also offers a good selection of restaurants and cafes, many of which are located right on the sand. You won't have a problem finding your way around here and if you want to explore further, everything else is just a short scooter or taxi ride away. Our accommodation picks: Family-favourite Hai Tide Resort spoils children with activities whilst couples will enjoy Castaway Boutique Resort or Good Day Villas.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Spoiled for Choice

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]Nusa Lembongan is a versatile destination with something for every preference. Whether you’re looking for the secluded luxury of Sandy Bay or the energy of Jungutbatu, each area offers unique landscapes, great beaches, and easy access to dining and activities. Each spot ensures that your stay on this beautiful island is nothing short of amazing. Now that we’ve answered your questions about where to stay in Lembongan for your next visit, what are you waiting for? Get packing! And don't forget to follow us on Instagram for updates on the best stay recommendations in Nusa Lembongan. Title: Mindful Travel Tips to Nusa Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Mindful Travel Tips to Nusa Lembongan

Slow down, tune in, and make your holiday count both for you and the island.

Nusa Lembongan’s charm lies in its simplicity: small warungs, friendly faces, a slower rhythm, and stunning natural beauty. As travellers, our impact matters—how we explore, shop, eat, and play makes a difference to the people and places that make this island so special.

Here are some mindful travel tips to help you tread gently while enjoying everything Nusa Lembongan has to offer.

[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Support Local Businesses

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70279" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

The charm of Nusa Lembongan is in its small-scale, locally owned experiences. From beachfront warungs to family-run snorkelling tours, your choices matter. By spending your money locally, you're helping the island's economy thrive and empowering families to continue sharing their culture and hospitality with visitors.

Here’s how you can support locals:

  • Eat in warungs – These small eateries offer delicious, home-cooked Indonesian meals and a chance to interact with local families. Watch our reels to get local warung recommendations from TLT team here.
  • Shop at island markets – Pick up souvenirs, clothing, or fresh fruit from local vendors.
  • Hire transport directly – Whether it’s a scooter or buggy, you can hire it from local operators.
  • Book locally run activities – Snorkelling, diving, and surf lessons are often run by islanders who know the sea best.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Honour Island Rhythm & Traditions

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70276" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Balinese traditions are deeply woven into everyday life on Nusa Lembongan. Ceremonies take place daily, offerings line the streets, and locals live by a rhythm that balances work, prayer, and community. As a guest, your respect for these customs goes a long way.

Keep these cultural tips in mind:

  • Greet local elders as “Bapak” (male) or “Ibu” (female).
  • Use your right hand for giving or receiving items.
  • Avoid using your fingers to point and refrain from touching someone’s head.
  • Wear clothing that covers your shoulders and below your knees when entering a temple.
  • Do not enter a temple if you are on your period.
  • Honk your scooter horn when you ride past a cemetery, temple, or any other sacred sites.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Use Electricity & Water Mindfully

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70281" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Nusa Lembongan has limited infrastructure for electricity and fresh water. While modern comforts are available, they come with environmental costs. Adopting mindful habits during your stay helps reduce your impact on island resources.

Here’s how you can help:

  • Turn off the air conditioning, lights, and TV when not in use.
  • Keep showers short, and reuse towels instead of requesting daily laundry service.
  • Bring a dry towel, it dries faster after a swim and reduces laundry loads.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Say No to Fireworks

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70278" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

While fireworks might seem like a fun way to celebrate, they pose serious risks on an island like Nusa Lembongan. The safety of guests, locals, and the environment should always come first.

Here’s why fireworks are discouraged:
  • Safety Concerns: Injuries can easily occur in unfamiliar surroundings, especially without emergency services.
  • Fire Hazards: Many buildings use alang-alang (thatched) roofing, which is highly flammable.
  • Noise Pollution: Loud fireworks disturb the peaceful atmosphere, local wildlife, and nearby families.
  • Environmental Impact: Fireworks release toxic chemicals and debris, polluting land and sea.
Instead of fireworks, you can enjoy a beautiful sunset followed by a quiet night full of stars from your stay or from our favourite beaches on the island.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Protect Coastal & Marine Life

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="71690" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

The vibrant coral reefs and marine life surrounding Nusa Lembongan are some of the island’s most valuable treasures. But they’re also incredibly fragile. A little extra care goes a long way in keeping them pristine.

Here’s how to protect the underwater world:

  • Use reef-safe sunscreen which is available at several shops on the island.
  • Avoid touching corals, sea turtles, or other marine animals. Even a gentle brush can cause harm.
  • Always follow your guide’s instructions when snorkelling or diving.

Remember, you’re a guest in their home.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Travel Thoughtfully

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="77371" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Scooters are a popular way to explore Nusa Lembongan, but they’re not always the most sustainable or safest option, especially for larger groups.

Here are some low-impact alternatives:

  • Share transport – Travelling with friends or family? Hire a pick-up car or buggy together instead of renting multiple scooters.
  • Use restaurant shuttles – Many venues offer free pick-up and drop-off services. It’s more efficient and eco-friendly.

Being thoughtful about how you get around helps reduce carbon emissions and traffic on the island’s narrow roads.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Embrace the Slow Island Life

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70275" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Nusa Lembongan isn’t the place to tick off a to-do list. It’s a place to pause, reflect, and savour the moment. Whether you're lounging at your villa, wandering through village lanes, or watching the waves roll in, the island invites you to slow down and reconnect with nature, with others, and with yourself.

Ways to slow down and soak it in:

  • Stay longer – Spend a few extra nights. Revisit favourite beaches. Linger a little longer over lunch.
  • Explore wellness offerings – Try a yoga class, enjoy a massage, or spend time at a retreat.
  • Dine like a local – Discover hidden warungs and meet the people behind the meals.
  • Disconnect to reconnect – Less screen time, more stargazing.

The less you rush, the more you’ll remember.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

By following these guidelines, you’ll help preserve the beauty and serenity of Nusa Lembongan for everyone. Thank you for being a mindful traveller.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_bottom="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Title: Eat, Stay and Play at Lago
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Discover the Ultimate Island Experience at Lago: From a Floating Bar to an Oceanfront Private Villa in Nusa Lembongan

Upon your arrival in Nusa Lembongan waters, you’ll spot a black floating bar near the Playgrounds surf break. This is the Lago Pontoon, one of a MUST things-to-do in Nusa Lembongan.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Known as a top sunset spot, the Pontoon is accessible by private boat charter and open daily from 12 PM to 7 PM on a first-come, first-served basis (no reservations). Entirely powered by solar panels and featuring its own water filtration system, the Pontoon provides an unforgettable front-row seat to the Playgrounds surf break, complete with great cocktails, floating sun loungers, year-round sunshine and Happy Hour on the Pontoon - 50% off all cocktails from 4 PM to 5.30 PM every day!

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="64835" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]But Lago offers more than just the Pontoon. Open daily from 6 AM to 6 PM, dawn by Lago is a relaxed grab-and-go café located right on the beach. Whether you're heading out for a morning surf, looking for a beachside coffee, or after a light lunch, dawn offers specialty coffee, fresh juices, house-made pastries, wholesome bites, and a selection of refreshing drinks including Aperol, beer on tap, and signature DAWN canned cocktails. With its laid-back island atmosphere and unbeatable beachfront setting, it's the perfect spot to start your day or enjoy a casual break between adventures.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

As the afternoon rolls into evening, dusk by Lago offers a completely different experience. Perched above Coconut Beach, this refined seaside bistro combines relaxed island charm with elevated dining.

Guests can enjoy uninterrupted ocean views, creative dishes inspired by fresh local ingredients, and thoughtfully crafted cocktails while watching the sunset over one of Nusa Lembongan's most beautiful bays. The atmosphere is sophisticated yet welcoming, making it ideal for long lunches, sunset drinks, or memorable dinners by the sea.

Together, dawn and dusk create a seamless all-day dining experience, making Lago a destination worth visiting from sunrise through sunset.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="77414" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]Above the next to dawn and dusk is the Sundeck, where you can relax in an ice bath or sauna with day passes for IDR 200,000 per person. Open daily from 7 AM to 7 PM, the Sundeck is perfect for sunbathing and enjoying views of the beach and surf. It’s also home to the only ice bath on the island and offers membership for long-term stayers or regular visitors.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="64837" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]To fully embrace #thelagolife, stay at the Beach House, a haven with breathtaking views of the crystal-clear ocean and unspoiled nature. This private Nusa Lembongan villa features 5 bedrooms, each with contemporary décor and an ensuite, including a kid’s room with a bunk bed. The stylish, spacious villa also boasts a 15m infinity pool, airy living and dining areas where a homemade breakfast is served each morning, and an outdoor dining space perfect for sunset drinks or a barbeque. With its thoughtful design, modern amenities, and unobstructed sea views, the Beach House feels like your home away from home in paradise.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="64918" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][vc_column_text css=""]Lago is the ideal destination for those seeking quiet luxury, island adventures, and unforgettable experiences. From chilling at the Pontoon, relaxing at the Sundeck and indulging in post-surf meals at the Beach Café to waking up to the sound of gentle waves at the Beach House, Lago offers the best way to experience the charm of Nusa Lembongan.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_bottom="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]
