Title: Stay Guide : Nusa Lembongan Resorts
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]If you're planning a trip to Nusa Lembongan, finding the perfect Nusa Lembongan resort is key to enjoying your tropical getaway. This beautiful island offers a variety of stays, from luxurious resorts to stunning Lembongan private villas, catering to every type of traveller looking for the ultimate Bali holiday. While Nusa Lembongan is famous for its upscale beachfront properties, there are plenty of smaller, charming resorts that provide a more intimate experience. Here’s our curated guide on our favourite resort stays in Nusa Lembongan. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Hai Tide Beach Resort, Mushroom Bay

Best for: Families & Couples Highlights: Pontoon access, complimentary activities, beachfront location, two restaurants[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="64946" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]One of the top choices for family-friendly Nusa Lembongan accommodation, Hai Tide Beach Resort is located on picturesque Mushroom Bay. Established in 1997, this Nusa Lembongan resort offers traditional lumbung bungalows as well as modern one and two bedroom villas, perfect for families. The resort’s recreation centre is a hive of activity, offering complimentary water and land-based activities. Families can also enjoy day cruises around Nusa Lembongan and nearby islands. Don’t miss the Bali Hai floating pontoon, which features a 35-meter waterslide, underwater viewing chamber, and more—all inclusive for guests staying at Hai Tide Beach Resort. Hai Tide's two on-site restaurants, Hai Bar & Grill and Hai Ri Zen, make it convenient to enjoy breakfast, long lunches and sunset dining without leaving the resort. [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Batu Karang Lembongan Resort & Spa, Jungutbatu

Best for: Families and couples Highlights: Multiple dining options, close to Coconut Beach, varied room types[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="64948" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]For those searching for luxury Lembongan resorts, Batu Karang Lembongan Resort & Spa is an excellent choice. This high-end resort sits along Nusa Lembongan's iconic boardwalk in Jungutbatu, offering spectacular ocean and Mount Agung views. The rooms, suites, penthouses, and exclusive Lembongan villas are all designed for comfort incorporating contemporary Balinese touches. Located within walking distance of famous surf spots like Playground and Lacerations, it’s perfect for surfers. The resort’s facilities include three pools, a spa, gym, and five dining outlets, from fine dining, whiskey bar, gelato parlour to The Deck, a must-visit for sunset views and delicious food. If you’re wondering where to stay in Nusa Lembongan for a mix of relaxation, luxury and activity, Batu Karang ticks all your boxes. [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Morin Resort Lembongan, Tamarind Bay

Best for: Couples and solo travellers Highlights: Plant-based restaurant, eco-friendly design, yoga shala, located between Coconut and Tamarind beaches.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="64950" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]For eco-conscious travellers looking for unique Nusa Lembongan accommodation, Morin Resort is a standout. Located between the turquoise water of Coconut and Tamarind beach, this boutique Nusa Lembongan resort combines sustainability with subtle touches of luxury. Its diverse room options make it ideal for couples or solo travellers seeking a unique way to enjoy Nusa Lembongan’s spectacular landscapes. The resort’s Playful Table restaurant is the island’s only fully plant-based eatery and a popular choice for vegan and vegetarian visitors. Guests can also enjoy private yoga in the resort shala and romantic dinners, or embark on ocean adventures on the resort’s boat. Morin’s exclusive private boat transfer service, available to both in-house and outside guests, adds convenience for those travelling between Nusa Lembongan and Bali main island. [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

ARNA Suites & Ocean Lounge, Nusa Ceningan

Best for: Couples and travellers looking for a scenic, elevated stay with ocean views Highlights: Clifftop location, Blue Lagoon views, pool & pool bar, luxury tent suites, walking distance to attractions[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="71511" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Set on the cliffs overlooking Blue Lagoon, Arna Suites offers a unique stay combining luxury tent-style accommodation with modern comforts and panoramic ocean views. Surrounded by lush greenery, the property features a swimming pool, terrace, and relaxed lounge spaces designed for slow, scenic island days.

Each suite is thoughtfully equipped with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and sea views, creating a comfortable and elevated experience. Located just steps from Blue Lagoon and close to spots like Mahana Point & Secret Beach, it’s an ideal base for exploring Nusa Ceningan while enjoying a more tranquil, view-focused stay.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Ohana's, Jungutbatu

Best for: Families, solo travellers, friends, and couples. Highlights: Beachfront location, lively atmosphere, beach club, kids’ playground[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="64975" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]For those looking for a lively atmosphere and casual resort experience, Ohana’s is a great choice among Nusa Lembongan resorts with its beach club, live DJ nights, bonfire events, and rooftop bar, it offers a laid-back and social vibe. Choose from spacious rooms, suites, or three bedrooms villa, each with a private balcony overlooking the pool or garden. Ohana’s location on Jungutbatu Beach places you just steps from Shipwreck surf break and the island's eat street. End your day by watching a breathtaking sunset from the comfort of a beach club day bed or cooling off in the resort’s “guests only” pool.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

White Horse Resort, Tamarind Bay

Best for: Couples, groups, and travellers seeking a quiet, boutique beachfront stay Highlights: Ocean views, 30m pool, beachfront location, colonial-Caribbean design, private villas, restaurant & bar[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="74562" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Set along Tamarind Bay, White Horse Resort offers a peaceful beachfront escape with a unique colonial-Caribbean design and modern, open living spaces. Surrounded by tropical gardens, the villas are designed for comfort, privacy, and relaxed island living.

Title: Best Places to Visit in Bali: Top 5 Hidden Gems
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]Bali is famous for its beautiful beaches, vibrant culture, and bustling tourist spots. But if you’re seeking the best places to visit in Bali that showcase the island's authentic charm, venture beyond the well-travelled paths. These hidden gems offer nature and ocean lovers the perfect escape from the crowds, providing the fresh air and serene experiences that make Bali so special. Keep reading to uncover the best places to visit in Bali and find your next unforgettable adventure. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Sidemen: A Tranquil Retreat

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="65613" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Sidemen, often referred to as the "Ubud of old," is a serene escape in Bali’s eastern valley, surrounded by terraced rice fields and stunning views of Mount Agung. This peaceful village is perfect for those looking to experience traditional Balinese life at a slower pace. Stay at Samanvaya Resort, an adults-only haven offering luxurious bamboo villas and infinity pools that blend seamlessly with the natural surroundings. The resort’s focus on privacy and comfort makes it an ideal choice for couples seeking a romantic getaway. Beyond the resort, Sidemen invites you to explore its own version of Bali’s famous yellow bridge, a hidden gem that adds to the village's charm. Whether wandering through rice paddies, visiting small temples, or taking a Balinese cooking class, Sidemen offers an authentic and tranquil experience. Other accommodations such as Wapa di Ume Sidemen, Camaya Bali, and Veluvana Sidemen also provide a range of luxurious and cozy options, ensuring there’s something for everyone in this peaceful retreat. Image by depositphotos.com[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Medewi: Surfing's Best-Kept Secret

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="65614" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Medewi, located on Bali’s west coast, is a hidden gem for surfers seeking long, uncrowded waves and a laid-back atmosphere. Known for its gentle left-hand breaks, Medewi is perfect for both beginners and seasoned surfers looking to refine their skills away from the crowded lineups of Bali’s more popular surf spots. While the waves draw surfers from around the world, Medewi also offers a chance to experience the island’s traditional charm in a serene setting. Bombora Medewi Wave Lodge stands out as a top choice for those seeking modern comforts combined with spectacular ocean views, providing a perfect blend of relaxation and adventure. Newly opened Lost Lindenberg offers an edgy, sustainability-focused alternative, with a minimalist design and eco-friendly practices like offering electric vehicle charging energy and locally sourced organic produce. The boutique hotel also promotes communal dining and immersive experiences that connect guests with local culture, making it perfect for eco-conscious travelers seeking something unique. As you explore Medewi, you’ll find yourself surrounded by lush rice paddies and breathtaking sunsets over the Indian Ocean. The village’s unspoiled beauty, black sand beach and welcoming atmosphere make it an ideal retreat for those looking to unwind in an authentic yet luxurious environment. Image by @fran_pitzalis_yoga[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Munduk: A Highland Escape

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="65945" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Munduk, in Bali’s northern highlands, is a serene retreat known for its cool climate, lush landscapes, and beautiful waterfalls. Ideal for nature lovers, the area offers hiking trails leading to spots like Munduk and Melanting Waterfalls, surrounded by dense tropical forests. A short trip from the village, the Bali Botanical Gardens are perfect for leisurely strolls or picnics. For a memorable dining experience, Munduk Farmhouse serves the best rendang and margaritas, making it a must-visit spot for food lovers. Accommodations like Elevate Bali, Munduk Moding Plantation Nature Resort, and Sanctua Luxury Glamping Resort provide stunning views and luxurious comfort, making Munduk an ideal destination for tranquility in Bali’s highlands. Image by depositphotos.com[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Amed: Dive into Tranquility

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="65616" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Amed, located on Bali’s northeastern coast, is a diver’s paradise, known for its crystal-clear waters and vibrant marine life. The highlight for many is exploring the USAT Liberty shipwreck, one of Bali’s most famous dive sites, teeming with colorful coral and diverse sea creatures. Whether you’re an experienced diver or a beginner, Amed offers some of the best underwater experiences in Bali. Beyond diving, Amed’s tranquil vibe makes it a perfect escape. The area has evolved from a quiet fishing village into a laid-back destination with luxury accommodations that cater to discerning travelers. The Griya Villas and Spa and Palm Garden Amed Beach & Spa Resort offer elegant beachfront villas, stunning ocean views, and high-end amenities, providing the perfect base for your underwater adventures. With its combination of world-class diving, volcanic black sand beach and boutique accommodations, Amed is a must-visit for those looking to explore Bali’s underwater treasures in style. Image by depositphotos.com[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Nusa Lembongan: Island Bliss Just 30 Minutes from Bali

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="65617" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]A short 30-minute boat ride from Bali, Nusa Lembongan offers a perfect blend of adventure and relaxation. Known for its stunning white sand beaches, crystal-clear waters, and vibrant marine life, it’s an ideal destination for surfers, snorkelers, and anyone looking to unwind in a serene island setting. Surfers can catch some of Bali’s best waves at spots like Playgrounds, Lacerations, and Shipwrecks, which cater to all skill levels. For those who prefer underwater exploration, snorkeling and diving at Manta Point is a must, where you can swim alongside majestic manta rays. When it comes to accommodation, Nusa Lembongan has something for everyone. Families will appreciate spacious villas like Lembongan Island Beach Villas, offering child-friendly facilities, while couples might prefer the seclusion of Villa Madu, which features luxurious suites with stunning ocean views. For a more authentic island experience, charming bungalows like Tropica Tranquility provide a cozy stay. The island’s food scene is diverse, offering everything from fresh seafood to plant-based options at beachfront restaurants. And for those looking to relax, Nusa Lembongan boasts several spas and yoga studios, providing the perfect setting to find your zen. Whether you’re seeking adventure or tranquility, Nusa Lembongan offers the ultimate island escape, just a short trip from Bali.

Time to Escape

Title: Guide for Nusa Lembongan First Timers
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

ISLAND TRAVEL TIPS BEFORE COMING TO NUSA LEMBONGAN

If you've recently discovered Bali's best kept secret, here are 5 tips for first-time visitors to Nusa Lembongan. This enchanting island, just a short boat ride from Bali, is a slice of paradise waiting to be explored. To make your journey smooth and your experience unforgettable, here are some essential tips with a little added flair to get you excited! [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Book Your Stay Early

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="67055" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Nusa Lembongan is a small island with limited accommodation options, and availability can fill up quickly, especially during high season. Booking your stay sooner than later is essential. The limited availability and high demand means some properties impose non-refundable cancellation policies. We recommend taking up travel insurance, valid from the day of your booking, to protect you from "just in case" moments. This way, you’re covered for unexpected changes and can relax knowing your plans are protected.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Know When To Go

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="67052" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Planning your trip during the right season can make a big difference. High season (June to August) is lively, with lots of visitors and a bustling atmosphere. This season also offers clear skies and calm seas, perfect for adventures.  It’s a great time if you love vibrant energy, but keep in mind that prices for accommodation and activities will be higher, and popular spots may be busier. Low season (November to March) brings a quieter vibe, with fewer crowds and often better deals on places to stay. It’s perfect if you prefer a more relaxed experience. However, you might encounter some tropical rain showers, which can add a touch of adventure to your stay. Whichever season you choose, Nusa Lembongan’s beauty and charm remain constant.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Pick The Perfect Stay

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="66912" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Your home away from home matters. Nusa Lembongan has a variety of accommodation options to suit every traveller. Here’s a quick guide:
  • Jungutbatu: Bustling and central, ideal for families and first-time visitors with lots of dining options and swimmable beaches.
  • Mushroom Bay: Quiet, secluded and perfect for beach lovers and everything within walking distance.
  • Sandy Bay: A luxurious haven with stunning ocean views, home to the island’s most stunning villas.
Some areas are harder to reach than others, so you need to choose the area of your stay wisely. Check out our guide to the best areas to stay in Nusa Lembongan for more insights. Then, choose the type of accommodation that suits your style and budget. Do you prefer a resort or a villa? Each offers a unique experience. For a deeper dive into the differences, check out our article on where to stay on Nusa Lembongan: villas vs resorts.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Book The Right Boat Company

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="67111" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Most fast boats from Bali drop you at either Jungutbatu Beach or Mushroom Bay. Knowing where you’ll arrive can save time and hassle. Many accommodations offer pick-up services, so reach out and let them take care of the details. For a detailed look at which boat companies arrive at which harbours, check our cheat sheet here 😉[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Stay a Little Longer

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="67057" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Many people assume Nusa Lembongan is just for day-trippers, but the island has so much more to offer. Here’s the secret sauce to experiencing Nusa Lembongan: don’t rush it. Give yourself the luxury of time to:
  • Dive into vibrant underwater worlds.
  • Explore our sister island, Nusa Ceningan.
  • Have the pleasure of trying out different beachfront cafes, bars and a wide variety of restaurants.
A few extra days mean more sunsets, more adventures, and more memories to cherish![/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Final Word

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]Nusa Lembongan isn’t just a place to visit; it’s a place to savour. Follow these tips, embrace the island’s unique charm, and prepare for a holiday that will leave you longing to return. Our team is always here to help you choose the perfect Lembongan stay and arrange the boat transfers for your next island getaway. Title: Checking in to Villa Utopia: A Stay to Remember
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

CHECKING IN TO VILLA UTOPIA: A STAY TO REMEMBER

From the moment we arrived at Villa Utopia, it felt like we had stepped into another world. The views of Mount Agung, the ocean, and the surrounding greenery were breathtaking, and the gentle sounds of birds set the perfect tone for a relaxing getaway. Nestled on the eastern side of Jungutbatu Hill, its location strikes the perfect balance—away from the busy streets of Jungutbatu but still close to the area’s popular restaurants with only 10 minutes scooter ride. Exploring the Villas

Title: 5 Best Romantic Restaurants for Valentine's Day
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

5 BEST RESTAURANTS FOR A ROMANTIC VALENTINE'S DAY ON NUSA LEMBONGAN

Valentine’s Day calls for an unforgettable dining experience, and Nusa Lembongan offers the perfect setting—pristine beaches, breathtaking sunsets, and seaside cuisine. Whether you’re toasting with a cocktail by the sea or indulging in a candlelit dinner, these five restaurants provide the ideal backdrop for romance. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

La Bianca – Sunset Romance by the Sea

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="67377" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/la-bianca-nusa-lembongan/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Located in Jungutbatu, La Bianca invites couples to dine under a tree-lined terrace with uninterrupted 180° ocean views. The beachfront ambiance, combined with wood-fired pizzas, fresh seafood, and grilled specialties, creates the perfect setting for a relaxed yet intimate evening. As the sun sets over the turquoise horizon, sip on a handcrafted cocktail and soak in the magic of the moment.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Indiana Kenanga – French Elegance on the Beach

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="67378" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/indiana-kenanga/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]For a touch of fine dining, Indiana Kenanga blends Balinese charm with French sophistication. Its beachfront restaurant offers an enchanting atmosphere, where flickering candlelight and white linens set the stage for an unforgettable night. The refined menu showcases Western cuisine, carefully curated wine selections, and exquisite service—perfect for couples seeking a luxurious Valentine’s experience.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

The Playful Table by Morin – A Culinary Experience to Remember

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="67379" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/the-playful-table/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Perched on a cliff at the east end of Tamarind Beach, The Playful Table is more than just a restaurant—it’s an experience. With a focus on connection and creativity, this plant-based and gluten-free haven serves meals crafted with love and intention. The serene ocean views, combined with fresh organic ingredients, make it the perfect choice for couples looking for a mindful and unique dining experience.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Hai Ri Zen – Intimate Dining with a Sunset Backdrop

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="67380" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/hai-ri-zen/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Set on Mushroom Bay, Hai Ri Zen is a beautifully designed beachfront restaurant known for its bamboo-style architecture and sweeping ocean views. Offering a "Small Plate" concept that blends Western and Asian flavours, couples can indulge in a variety of exquisite dishes while watching the sun dip below the horizon. With handcrafted cocktails and a relaxed yet sophisticated atmosphere, Hai Ri Zen is an idyllic choice for a romantic dinner.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Sandy Bay – Beachfront Bliss with Crashing Waves

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="67381" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/sandy-bay/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Overlooking the dramatic Devil’s Tear, Sandy Bay Beach Club provides a dreamy setting for couples looking to dine by the sea. Whether enjoying a seafood feast, a juicy steak, or a tropical cocktail, the alfresco ambiance and beachfront pool set the scene for an effortless island romance. Arrive for sunset and let the sound of the waves complete your Valentine’s Day celebration.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Romantic Activities to Complete Your Valentine’s Day

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_gallery interval="3" images="67382,67383,67384,67385" img_size="full" css=""][vc_column_text css=""]💆‍♀Rejuvenate with a couple’s massage at Spring Spa – Indulge in a soothing spa experience together, leaving you both relaxed and refreshed. 🏄 SUP or surf at Coconut Beach – Whether you're paddling side by side or catching waves, this is a fun and active way to bond. 🌊 Jetski around the island – For adventurous couples, a thrilling ride on the crystal-clear waters of Nusa Lembongan is an experience to remember. 🏖 Simply lounge by the beach – Sometimes, the best moments are the simplest. Pick a quiet beach or explore the beach clubs on Nusa Lembongan, lay back, and watch the waves roll in.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Celebrate Love on Nusa Lembongan

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]With stunning coastal views, world-class cuisine, and unforgettable island vibes, these five restaurants and romantic activities offer the ultimate Valentine’s Day experience on Nusa Lembongan. Be sure to book in advance and make this special day truly magical. For more tips on the island, feel free to contact us on: Email: holiday@thelembongantraveller.com WhatsApp: +61 478 928 925[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_bottom="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

There’s something magical about finding a place that feels like your own private slice of paradise. For us, Seaview Private Villas is exactly that kind of place. Tucked away between Coconut Beach and Tamarind Bay, Seaview Private Villas offers a coastal hideaway that’s perfect for couples, families, or groups of friends looking for a stay that’s a little more special — and a lot more memorable. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Title: Easter Guide to Nusa Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Hop Into Easter: The Ultimate Family Guide to Nusa Lembongan

Easter is the perfect excuse to pack up the family and escape to the islands. Nusa Lembongan is small, safe, and genuinely fun for kids — with calm beaches, a great dining scene, and just enough to do to fill a long weekend without anyone getting overwhelmed. Whether the little ones want to splash in a pool, chase a mini golf ball, or catch their first wave, Lembongan delivers. Here's your guide to spending Easter on the island — where to eat, where to play, and what to look forward to over the long weekend. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Where to Eat & Play

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="75577" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]The best thing about Nusa Lembongan's family dining scene? Half the restaurants come with a side of entertainment. Here's where to eat well and keep the kids busy at the same time.

The Beach Shack

🛝 Kids Playground  ·  🎬 Movie Nights  Right on Jungutbatu Beach, The Beach Shack has a wooden climbing wall to keep the kids occupied while you settle into a daybed with something cold. The vibe is easy and fun, the menu is kid-approved, and on select evenings they run outdoor movie nights on the beach.

The Coconut Hut

⛳ Mini Golf  ·  🍽 Kids' Menu Honestly, the mini golf alone makes this a must-visit. The Coconut Hut's island-themed course at the northern end of Jungutbatu Beach is casual, colourful, and a genuine hit with all ages. Their kids' menu keeps everyone fuelled between holes.

Karana Lembongan

🏊 Pool Access  ·  🌊 Ocean & Mt Agung Views For something a little more elevated, Karana offers poolside dining with sweeping ocean views. It's the kind of place that makes for excellent holiday photos as much as a great meal — and the whole family gets to enjoy it.

Koa Donuts

🍩 Fresh Daily  ·  🧡 Local Favourite No Easter family holiday is complete without a doughnut stop. Koa Donuts bakes fresh every morning and sells out quickly — so get there early, grab a bag, and stash a couple for later. The kids will thank you.

Ohana's Beach Club

🏊 Pool Access  ·  🛝 Playground  ·  🍽 Kids' Menu

It’s no coincidence that Ohana's Beach Club means “family” in Hawaiian. This beach club is genuinely built around kids — there are two pools with shallow ends, a proper playground, and marshmallow roasting by the bonfire come evening. The ‘Little People’ menu covers all the classics: battered fish fingers, rigatoni bolognese, corn cobs, and Ohana’s signature waffles with ice cream. Plan to spend most of the day here.

Over Easter Weekend, the vibe turns even more festive. On 3rd April (Good Friday), there’s a sunset session with DJ Saul Bliss (UK), followed by a relaxed Easter Sunday on 5th April with live music at sunset. Little ones can also enjoy free marshmallows to toast on the bonfire as the sun goes down — a simple, sweet way to end the day.

See full information here.

Ombak Cafe & Huts

🏖 Beach Play  ·  🎬 Movie Nights  ·  🍽 Kids' Menu Right in the heart of Jungutbatu Beach, Ombak is where toddlers can build sandcastles and paddle in the shallows while parents actually sit down and eat. The 'Grommies' menu — crispy chicken and chips, grilled cheese, brownies, ice cream — keeps even the fussiest eaters happy. Ombak also hosts outdoor movie nights, making it a great choice for a laid-back Easter evening.

Sandy Bay Beach Club

🏊 Pool Access  ·  🛝 Kids Playground

Located on the island’s southern tip, Sandy Bay Beach Club is one of Lembongan’s most stunning day-out destinations. Relax poolside with a long lunch while the kids burn energy at the onsite play area. The menu is extensive and the setting is hard to beat — and the gelatos and popsicles are a non-negotiable after a morning in the sun.

Over Easter weekend (4–5 April, from 7AM), there’s even more reason to visit. Expect Easter Egg Hunts, face painting, colouring kit activities, and a few fun surprises along the way — perfect for keeping little ones entertained all day.

See full information here.

Sanghyang Bay Bar & Restaurant

🛝 Kids Playground  ·  👨‍🍳 Cooking Class  ·  🍕 Wood-Fired Pizza Tucked into Mushroom Bay under shady trees with gorgeous sunset views, Sanghyang Bay is a lovely spot for a relaxed family meal. Kids can play in the onsite playground or explore the beach steps away. The menu spans wood-fired pizzas, fresh salads, seafood and pork ribs — something for everyone. For something a bit different, families can also book a hands-on Balinese cooking class with the in-house chef. And parents: there's a buy-one-get-one cocktail happy hour from 4–6:30pm.

The Sampan Restaurant

🛝 Kids Playground  ·  🎵 Live Music  ·  🚗 Free Shuttle

With a dedicated play area, daily live music, and a free pick-up and drop-off service from your accommodation, The Sampan makes family dining genuinely easy. It’s on the northern end of Jungutbatu’s main road and has a lively, welcoming atmosphere that the whole family will enjoy.

For Easter, they’re also hosting a special event on 5th April starting from 10AM — Colour the Joy of Easter. Little ones can enjoy face painting, egg painting, storytelling, an egg hunt, and live music, all for IDR 150k per child.

See full information here.

Lago Dawn Beach Cafe

🏖 Beach Play   ·  🎵 Live Music  

Dawn by Lago is a lively grab-and-go café located right on Coconut Beach, offering specialty coffee, fresh juices, Aperol and beer on tap, signature DAWN canned cocktails, wholesome bites, and house-made pastries from early morning through late afternoon.

For Easter, there a special live acoustic set featuring 1Day on 5th April starting from 2:30 - 5:30PM — enjoy the sunset swim with the whole family.

See full information here.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

More Easter Fun Beyond the Table

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="75578" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Beyond the restaurants, Lembongan has a handful of activities that make great Easter holiday additions.

Bali Hai Cruises Beach Club & Pontoon

A full-day ocean playground just off Mushroom Bay, Bali Hai Cruises offers an Ultimate Lembongan Day Cruise that’s especially fun for families. For Easter Sunday (5 April 2026), the experience comes with extra festive touches — including an Easter Egg Treasure Hunt, Easter Bunny painting, splash around in the kids’ pool, and a lively Easter Egg Race.

The day runs from 9:15AM to 4:15PM at the Bali Hai Beach Club in Nusa Lembongan, with plenty packed in: snorkelling, a 35m waterslide, banana boat rides, an underwater viewing chamber, and more — plus morning tea, snacks, and a tropical BBQ lunch. Pricing starts from IDR 1,925,000 per adult and IDR 1,330,000 per child (4–14 years), with infants going free. A family package is also available. Booking at least one day ahead is recommended. See full information here.

Surf Lessons

For confident swimmers aged 7 and up, Nusa Island Surf School offers private lessons in gentle conditions with instructors who are experienced with kids. Watching your little one catch their first wave is a holiday highlight you won't forget.

Easter Shopping at Anak Shack

A boutique on the Jungutbatu main road stocked with island-inspired kids' clothing, toys, and accessories. Anak Shack is a sweet spot for picking up an Easter treat that isn't chocolate.

Nusa Baby Care

Travelling with very young children? Nusa Baby Care offers babysitting by trained carers and also hires out portable pool fences for installation at your villa — a brilliant peace-of-mind option around the water.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Easter, Island Style

Easter on Nusa Lembongan is all about slowing down, reconnecting, and soaking up island magic with your favourite people. Whether you’re building sandcastles, swimming in turquoise waters, or sharing laughs over dinner, it’s a holiday you’ll remember long after the bunny has hopped away. If you're wondering where to base yourselves, Jungutbatu and Mushroom Bay are the two most family-friendly areas on the island. Both have calm, swimmable beaches, and between them they cover most of the restaurants and activities on this list — so you're never far from the action (or a good meal). Email: holiday@thelembongantraveller.com WhatsApp: +61 478 928 925.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_bottom="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Title: Support our Cause : Love for Lembongan

Love for Lembongan: Empowering Health and Education in Our Community

At Love for Lembongan, our mission is to uplift the local community by ensuring access to quality healthcare and education. Thanks to the generosity of our donors, and our partnership with Bali Children Foundation, we’ve made significant strides in both areas, focusing on those who need it most. Here’s an update on how your support has been making a difference. [/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][qbutton icon_pack="" target="_blank" font_weight="" text="Share Your Love for Lembongan" link="https://bit.ly/DonateLFL" background_color="#C22F83" hover_background_color="#FFFFFF" border_color="#C22F83" hover_border_color="#C22F83" color="#FFFFFF" hover_color="#C22F83"][vc_column_text css=""][vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Revolutionising Education with EdTech and Engaging Learning Programs

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="68617" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]During our visit on 18th March 2025 to SDN 3 Lembongan (Primary School in Jungut Batu) , we saw first-hand how our EdTech and English as a Foreign Language (EFL) programs are transforming classrooms. Each Grade 1 student is equipped with a tablet pre-loaded with interactive apps designed to enhance literacy and numeracy skills. With a user-friendly interface and engaging elements, these tablets have made learning more accessible, fun, and effective for young students.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Who is benefiting?

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="68642" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]This initiative which was launched in September 2024, is already making a meaningful impact, reaching 147 Grade 1 students across five primary schools: SDN 1 in Sandy Bay, SDN 2 in Nusa Ceningan, SDN 3 Lembongan village, SDN 1 Jungutbatu, and SDN 3 Jungutbatu. A recent assessment conducted by the Bali Children Foundation showed that students from Nusa Lembongan and Ceningan outperformed those in other regencies in Bali, including Buleleng, Bangli, and Tabanan, where schools also participate in the EdTech program. The students here achieved the highest midline scores in both literacy and numeracy—an encouraging result! You can support our initiative here.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="68635" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation="" el_class="desktop-image"][vc_single_image image="68637" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation="" el_class="mobile-image"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Extra English Lessons

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="68618" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Beyond digital learning, we continue to enhance students’ education with our English as a Foreign Language (EFL) program, taught by Pak Benhar, who splits his time teaching at the five primary schools each week. The EFL program is being taught to grade 3 to 6 students. Thanks to your generous donations together with the support and implementation of  the Bali Children Foundation, tablets were purchased, as well as the recruitment and training of teachers to support these programs. Your contributions have played a pivotal role in shaping a brighter future for Nusa Lembongan’s youngest learners.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Prioritising Health for a Stronger Community

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="68619" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]In the health sector, our priority remains providing essential medical care to those in urgent need. We are currently updating and reviewing our list of priority patients, as some of the elderly individuals we previously cared for have, sadly, passed away. While supporting seniors and children remains a key focus, this year we are also expanding our efforts to women’s and reproductive health. Through a new partnership with Bunda, we conduct Visual Inspection with Acetic Acid (VIA) screenings—an early detection method for cervical cancer—among local residents. Your donations are crucial in ensuring these vital healthcare initiatives continue to run, keeping Nusa Lembongan a healthy and thriving community.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Emergency Relief and Community Support

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="68620" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Last year, we supported a local resident, Ketut Stanley, who lost his home and belongings in a devastating fire. Thanks to your generosity, we were able to provide him with essential supplies to help him rebuild his life. This year, we remain committed to providing emergency relief for local families facing unexpected hardships. Whether it’s medical emergencies, natural disasters, or other crises, your support allows us to respond swiftly and make a tangible difference in people’s lives.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Looking Ahead

As we continue our mission, we remain dedicated to expanding access to healthcare and education in Nusa Lembongan. Every donation, big or small, plays a vital role in sustaining and growing these initiatives. We extend our heartfelt gratitude to our donors and supporters who make this work possible. Together, we are creating lasting change. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue making a positive impact in our community![/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_empty_space height="25px"][qbutton icon_pack="" target="_blank" font_weight="" text="Donate Now" link="https://bit.ly/DonateLFL" background_color="#C22F83" hover_background_color="#FFFFFF" border_color="#C22F83" hover_border_color="#C22F83" color="#FFFFFF" hover_color="#C22F83"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_bottom="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Surrounded by turquoise waters and the calming island pace, this retreat invites you to explore your energy centres through daily yoga, breathwork, sound healing, and mindful movement. Title: Guide to Mushroom Bay, Nusa Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Explore Mushroom Bay: Food, Stays, & Must-Do Experiences on Nusa Lembongan

Mushroom Bay is a compact, charming corner of Nusa Lembongan that’s incredibly easy to explore on foot. With a picturesque white-sand beach, calm swimmable waters, its own harbour for fast boat arrivals, and postcard-worthy views of Mount Agung—this area is a perfect mix of convenience and natural beauty. Whether you’re staying a few days or simply visiting, here’s how to make the most of Mushroom Bay. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Where to Eat

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Hai Bar & Grill

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70577" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/hai-bar-grill/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Open daily for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, Hai Bar & Grill delivers a true beachfront dining experience right on the soft white sands of Mushroom Bay. The open-air design blends traditional island style with modern comfort—perfect for breezy lunches or laid-back dinners with uninterrupted ocean views.

The menu features a mix of family-friendly favourites and island classics, and in the evenings, the relaxed vibe is elevated with movie nights—a fun way to unwind after a day in the sun.

Getting there is easy too—just ask your villa or hotel to arrange the complimentary pickup service, and you’ll be on your way to one of the most scenic dining spots on the island.

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Hai Ri Zen

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70578" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/hai-ri-zen/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Next door to its sister restaurant, Hai Ri Zen brings a more refined twist to beachfront dining. Open daily for dinner, Hai Ri Zen offers front-row views of the ocean and Mushroom Bay’s spectacular sunsets.

The menu follows a small plate concept created by an award-winning chef that blends Asian and Western flavours, with fresh dishes introduced weekly. Pair it all with a handcrafted cocktail and enjoy an unforgettable island evening.

Complimentary pick-up and drop-off is available from anywhere on the island.

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Sanghyang Bay Bar & Restaurant

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70579" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/sanghyang-bay-bar-restaurant/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Located right by the sea under a shaded terrace, Sanghyang Bay Bar & Restaurant is open daily from breakfast through dinner. The vibe is casual, the views are west-facing for sunset magic, and the menu is packed with variety—from fresh seafood and juicy pork ribs to pizzas, skewers, and Indonesian favourites.

Their set menu seafood, pork ribs, and steak are house favourites, best enjoyed with a cold drink and the backdrop of live music every evening.

For a more hands-on experience, join their Balinese cooking class, led by a professional chef and offered in three different packages—featuring everything from appetisers to dessert, with a generous dose of fun and smiles.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Things to Do

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Swim at Mushroom Bay

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70583" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Mushroom Bay is one of the safest and most swimmable beaches on Nusa Lembongan. The gentle waves and clear turquoise water make it perfect for a refreshing dip any time of day. It’s an ideal spot for families with young kids or anyone just looking to float, snorkel close to shore, or soak up the sun with their feet in the sea.

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Take a Surf Lesson or Go Paddleboarding

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70582" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/nusa-island-surf-school/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

If you're looking to dive into the island's surf scene, Nusa Island Surf School offers lessons for all levels, with friendly instructors and access to nearby breaks suited to beginners and intermediate surfers alike. Transport to the surf spots is included, making it an easy and fun way to get started or improve your skills in a safe and beautiful environment.

Prefer something more relaxed? You can rent a stand-up paddleboard from Nusa Island Surf School and glide across the calm waters of Mushroom Bay. Early mornings are ideal when the ocean is smooth and glassy—perfect for soaking up the serenity at your own pace.

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Catch a Glimpse of the Island with Bali Hai Cruises

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70584" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/bali-hai/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

If you want to experience Mushroom Bay from the water, Bali Hai Cruises offers the perfect introduction. Their day cruises from mainland Bali stop right at Mushroom Bay, where guests disembark onto the Bali Hai Pontoon—a floating playground just off the coast.

From there, enjoy a full day of water activities like snorkelling, banana boat rides, waterslides, diving boards, parasailing, and have a coral restoration workshop. It’s a fun, family-friendly experience with something for everyone. Lunch is included, and there’s plenty of space to relax in between activities. Guests staying at Hai Tide Beach Resort (right on the beach) also enjoy direct and unlimited access to the pontoon throughout their stay.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Where to Stay in Mushroom Bay

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Hai Tide Beach Resort

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70588" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/hai-tide-resort/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Located directly on the sands of Mushroom Bay, Hai Tide Beach Resort offers a unique beachfront escape with Balinese-style “Lumbung” bungalows and private two-bedroom villas with pools. The resort features 24 upgraded lumbungs—each with modern en-suite bathrooms—and three beautifully appointed villas, perfect for families or friends travelling together.

Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurants—Hai Bar & Grill and Hai Ri Zen—two swimming pools, and a new garden lounge area. As part of the Bali Hai family, resort guests also gain access to the Bali Hai Beach Club and the Bali Hai Pontoon for snorkelling, waterslides, and other marine activities, making it a perfect all-in-one destination.

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Castaway

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70589" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/castaway/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Just 200 metres from the beach, Castaway is an Australian-owned boutique stay offering a mix of privacy and luxury in the heart of Mushroom Bay. The two-bedroom villas overlook a central pool and feature open-air bathrooms, king-sized beds, stylish furnishings, and outdoor decks with daybeds—ideal for unwinding in comfort.

The villas can also be booked as one-bedroom suites, making them perfect for couples. For larger groups, there’s a private three-bedroom villa with a full kitchen, private pool, and room for up to seven guests—great for family holidays or group getaways.

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Good Day Villas

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="70590" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/good-day-villa-lembongan/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Boho charm meets modern comfort at Good Day Villas, a newly opened holiday home just a short walk from the beach. This two-bedroom villa is designed for effortless island living, complete with a private pool, kitchenette, and dining area—ideal for friends or families travelling together.

The first bedroom, on the ground floor, features a queen bed, while the master bedroom upstairs offers a king bed and peaceful retreat-like feel. Located near a yoga studio and several restaurants and cafés, this Pinterest-worthy villa is as convenient as it is stylish.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]If you’re looking for a relaxed stay with everything within walking distance—great food, beachfront stays, and family-friendly activities—Mushroom Bay ticks every box. Compact yet full of character, it’s one of the most convenient and charming places to base yourself on Nusa Lembongan. Island Stays: Discover the Best Villas in Sandy Bay

Looking for beautiful villas in Sandy Bay? This dreamy corner of Nusa Lembongan is known for its stunning coastline, chilled beach club vibe, and some of the island’s most charming boutique accommodation. Whether you're travelling solo, as a couple, or with friends and family, Sandy Bay offers a handful of small, stylish stays that bring together comfort, personality, and a true island feel.

Here are our favourite places to stay — all just a short stroll from the beach, the spa, and those famous sunset views.

One of the most romantic villas in Sandy Bay, Sea Shanty is full of soul. Open the doors wide, feel the breeze, and fall asleep to the sound of the waves. You’re just 50 metres from Sandy Bay Beach Club — perfect for sunset drinks or a slow breakfast by the sea.

The villa itself is crafted from reclaimed teak, giving it a warm, rustic feel. Relax under the shaded bale, dip in the pool, and unwind in complete privacy. Ideal for couples wanting a peaceful, tropical escape.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Light, airy, and made for laid-back living, Villa Lagarto is the kind of place where you instantly feel at ease. The pool flows through the centre of the villa, with both bedrooms opening directly onto it — morning swims are part of the daily routine.

Located just 50 metres from the beach and walking distance to shops, spa, and restaurants, this is one of the most conveniently located villas in Sandy Bay. It’s a great choice for couples or small families wanting comfort and style with everything close by.
