Title: Built Mindfully: Morin’s Story of Conservation
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Built Mindfully: Morin’s Story of Conservation

At Morin Resort, we believe that a business can, and should, be a force for good. From the materials we build with, to the energy we use, to the way we treat people and the ocean, we are doing our best to operate in a way that protects, uplifts, and regenerates. We don’t claim to have it all figured out, but we are committed to learning, improving and treading as lightly as we can. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Business as a Force for Conservation

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="71269" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Our barefoot-luxury resort is more than just a place to stay, it’s a small platform we hope can help raise awareness and inspire thoughtful action. We see ourselves as students and stewards of the natural world that surrounds us, especially the vibrant marine life that makes Nusa Lembongan island so unique.

As part of our ongoing commitment to conservation, we are proud to support Marine Megafauna Foundation (MMF), whose work focuses on the research and conservation of manta rays, sea turtles and whale sharks. One way we support their efforts is through guided manta ray trips with our private boat, Pari Manta, which aim to be more than a snorkeling experience. These outings are co-hosted by two MMF biologists: one shares knowledge with guests about local marine life and conservation efforts, while the other collects data that directly contributes to ongoing research and the preservation of these species and their habitats. For our guests, it's a chance to witness ocean conservation in action, and for us, it’s a way to connect tourism with tangible, science-based conservation.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Mindful Materials & Timeless Design

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="71270" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Our commitment to sustainability began with the building of Morin itself. No trees were cut down to make space for the resort. Instead, we chose to build with mostly antique teak, giving a second life to materials that already carried history. Much of the wood you’ll see has been upcycled with care, reflecting a simple belief: we can often work with what’s already here.

To us, sustainability means looking beyond short-term convenience and considering long-term impact. We’re still learning every day, but we try to ask not just ‘what does this cost today?’ but ‘what will this mean tomorrow?’

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

A Work in Progress: Responsible Operations

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="71271" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Beyond design, we take responsibility for how we operate. Our wastewater is treated before being released, something that should be standard practice, yet still worth mentioning in today’s world. It’s a simple act of respect for the reef and sea around us.

Some everyday examples: we use solar panels to reduce our energy footprint and make small, practical choices that reflect our values, like edible rice straws instead of plastic, refillable glass water bottles, and fans in rooms to reduce reliance on air conditioning. These details may go unnoticed, but they help protect the environment we depend on.

At our restaurant, The Playful Table, we extend this philosophy to the plate. Our menu leans proudly plant-based, celebrating local roots—literally—with ingredients like cassava, the island’s staple crop. We believe travel should remain a journey of discovery, not a repetition of the familiar. After all, what’s the point of going halfway around the world if you're served the same continental breakfast you could find anywhere?

Around the property, we also share information with guests about local species, like geckos and frogs, to help everyone better understand and peacefully coexist with the wildlife that lives here.

We know we still have more to learn and more to do, and we’re always looking for thoughtful ways to do better, one small step at a time.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Conscious Business Means Conscious People

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="71272" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Sustainability at Morin isn’t just about the environment, it’s also about how we treat each other. We’re gently challenging some of the outdated norms in hospitality, where the guest is seen as king at the expense of the team’s well-being. We don’t believe respect should be a one-way street.

At Morin, our team is the heart of everything. We’re cultivating a safe, supportive space where each individual can grow, personally and professionally. Our workplace isn’t just a resort; it’s a playground for growth, a place where people are encouraged to be themselves and thrive.

And when we welcome you to Morin, we hope it’s not just about service, but about connection. To each other. To nature. And to yourself.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

A New Kind of Luxury

We are still learning. Still growing. But we believe in a kind of luxury that gives back, one that is rooted in respect, care and purpose. If you choose to stay with us, we hope you leave lighter, inspired and perhaps even a little more connected to this beautiful planet we all share. Come experience a new kind of luxury, one that gives back, grows together and leaves the world better than we found it. Title: Hassle Free Dining in Nusa Lembongan

[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Dining Made Easy: Restaurants in Nusa Lembongan with Pick-Up, Drop-Off & Delivery Services

Planning where to eat in Nusa Lembongan? While the island is home to a great selection of scenic restaurants and local favourites, getting there isn’t always straightforward—especially since Gojek and other ride-hailing apps aren’t available on the island. Whether you’re staying in a secluded villa or don’t feel like navigating the island’s narrow roads on a scooter, having access to pick-up/drop-off or delivery services makes dining out (or in) a whole lot easier.

Fortunately, many local restaurants have stepped up to provide transport or food delivery options to make your holiday more convenient. [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

How Travel Insurance Works for Your Bali or Lembongan Trip

Travel insurance isn’t just a box to tick—it’s a clear process that protects you before and during your trip. Here’s how it really works, with examples from Bali and Nusa Lembongan. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][vc_single_image image="71844" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Choosing Your Policy

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]Start by deciding what kind of cover you need. Are you only looking for basic medical coverage, or do you want cancellation, luggage, and activity protection? For Australian travellers heading to Bali, Cover-More offers Basic, Comprehensive, or Comprehensive+ plans that include medical emergencies, evacuation, trip cancellations, theft, and adventure sports like snorkelling or diving in Nusa Lembongan. If you’re a frequent traveller, Cover-More also offers an Annual Multi-Trip policy, which covers an unlimited number of trips within a 12-month period, up to the maximum trip duration you choose.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Buying Your Policy

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

Purchase insurance as soon as you book flights or accommodation. This ensures you’re covered if you need to cancel due to unexpected illness or accidents before departure. Policies can be purchased online through Cover-More, where you’ll get an instant confirmation and policy number.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

What's Covered (and What's Not)

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

Typical claims include medical treatment (e.g., a scooter accident in Lembongan), stolen items, or trip delays (like ferry cancellations between Sanur and Jungutbatu). However, you won’t be covered if you ride a motorbike without a valid licence or ignore local safety rules. Pre-existing conditions might also require additional cover.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

How to Claim

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

If something happens, notify Cover-More as soon as possible. Keep receipts, medical reports, or police statements for proof. Claims can be submitted online, and many are processed within 5–10 working days. Urgent medical claims are prioritised and often settled faster.

Why It Matters

Medical evacuation from Bali to Australia can cost over $50,000. Travel insurance is a small price for peace of mind, letting you enjoy paradise without worry. Before you finalise your holiday plans, make sure you have reliable travel insurance like Cover-More to protect your trip, health, and belongings—so you can fully enjoy Nusa Lembongan activities and adventures without worry. Where to Stay in Bali with Kids: The Ultimate Family Resort Guide

Planning a Bali holiday with kids? Whether you're after sandy toes by the sea or a jungle retreat in the highlands, Bali delivers family-friendly resorts to match every style. From water slides and kids clubs to beachfront sunsets and wellness spas, we’ve rounded up top-rated resorts across Nusa Dua, Sanur, Kuta & Legian, Jimbaran, and Ubud. Here’s your guide to a stress-free, fun-filled family getaway in Bali. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Nusa Dua

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="71741" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Known for its manicured streets, calm beaches, and exclusive resort zone, Nusa Dua is ideal for families who want a peaceful, all-inclusive holiday. The area is home to large beachfront resorts, making it perfect for travellers who want everything in one place, away from the crowds and traffic. Grand Hyatt Bali – Set in lush tropical gardens with five pools, two water slides, themed kids’ rooms, and a kids club, this resort is a long-standing family favourite. The Mulia Bali – Offering luxury suites, impeccable service, two kids clubs, a teen zone, and a family pool, The Mulia is perfect for families looking to splurge on space and tranquillity. Their Sunday Brunch is a great way to gather the family with endless food choices. Hilton Bali Resort – With a dramatic cliffside setting, family rooms, a 30-metre waterslide, and a jungle-themed kids club, the recently-renovated resort is an adventure in itself. Do keep balcony doors closed—cheeky monkeys often visit! The Apurva Kempinski Bali – One of the newest five-star resorts in Nusa Dua, it wows every visitor from the moment you step in, with a lavish lobby, underwater restaurant, and grand staircase. There’s plenty of fun to be had, with 60% of the rooms featuring private plunge pools. The resort’s family club ensures kids of all ages (and parents) feel welcome.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Sanur

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="71742" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Sanur offers laid-back coastal charm with a long beachfront promenade, calm waters for little ones, and quick access to the harbour for trips to Nusa Lembongan. It’s ideal for those seeking a quieter pace with plenty of walkable cafes and shops. Andaz Bali – A design-led resort by Hyatt, featuring modern Balinese touches, multiple pools, lush gardens, and two hours of complimentary kids club access. Their à la carte breakfast is one of the best on the island, offering unique locally inspired dishes. Segara Village Hotel – One of Sanur’s oldest hotels, it features mature gardens and a village-style layout, making it great for relaxed family stays with easy beach access. Hyatt Regency Bali – One of the island’s first resorts, combining lush tropical grounds, kids activities, and old-world charm.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Kuta & Legian

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="71744" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]This classic combo strikes a balance between buzz and relaxation. Families love it for its walkability, sunset beaches, and resort options that cater specifically to children. Padma Resort Legian – Consistently ranked among Bali’s best family resorts, with a dedicated family wing, water slides, and a world-class kids club. Bali Mandira Beach Resort & Spa – Popular for its beachfront location and fun pools with slides and a splash area for little ones. Their beach club is a favourite among both tourists and residents. Legian Beach Hotel – Offering dedicated family rooms, a departure lounge for late-night flights, and easy access to the beach, shops, bars, malls, and restaurants. This family-owned hotel is a practical and well-rounded choice. Hard Rock Hotel Bali – Home to Bali’s largest free-form pool, this hotel satisfies both kids and parents with music-themed family lofts and suites, weekly events at Hard Rock Café, and unique amenities like a teen club and Fender guitar rentals. Bali Dynasty Resort – Just steps from Waterbom, this resort is packed with family perks: kids and teens clubs, 56m waterslide, rooftop padel court, and a dedicated kids breakfast area. Sheraton Bali Kuta Resort – Located next to Beachwalk Shopping Mall, this hotel is great for those who want to be near everything. Guests enjoy an ocean-view infinity pool, complimentary access to the kids club, and ‘Side by Side’ offers for families travelling with grandparents.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Jimbaran

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="71745" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Just south of the airport, Jimbaran is famous for its sunset seafood dinners and calm bay waters. It’s quieter than Kuta and Seminyak, making it ideal for families seeking a beach escape without the crowds. InterContinental Bali Resort – Set on a long stretch of beach with tropical gardens, kids’ facilities, and a relaxed beachfront lounge for sunsets. Mövenpick Resort & Spa Jimbaran Bali – Loved by families for its daily chocolate hour, kids club, and lagoon-style pool that winds through the resort. While it doesn’t offer direct beach access, a complimentary shuttle makes it easy to reach the nearby shore. Right next door, the open-air Samasta Lifestyle Village offers a great selection of cafes, restaurants, and shops. Rimba by Ayana Bali – Located within a large resort complex, these sister properties offer 26 pools combined, the largest kids club on the island, and curated family itineraries including visits to their on-site cultural museum and Ayana Farm. Parents will appreciate a sunset cocktail at the world-renowned Rock Bar.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Ubud

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="71746" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]For families wanting to experience Bali’s cultural heart and lush jungle landscapes, Ubud is a magical escape. Expect rice paddies, monkey forests, and a cooler mountain climate. Four Seasons Resort Bali at Sayan – A dreamy riverside retreat with 216 sqm Family Suites, kids’ robes and slippers, children’s yoga, and cultural activities. Viceroy Bali – A luxury boutique resort with just 40 villas perched on a jungle valley. Private pool villas, personalised service, and the exceptional 1920s-inspired restaurant Apéritif make it both family-friendly and indulgent. Padma Resort Ubud – Set amidst lush forest in Payangan, this resort offers an infinity pool with jungle views, a kids’ playground with own kids pool, an animal garden and farm, as well as a variety of complimentary daily activities. Spacious family suites provide comfort for all ages, while a free shuttle service connects guests to Ubud city centre in just 30 minutes.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Title: Gabet’s Pub: The First and Only Irish Pub in Nusa Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Gabet's Pub: The First and Only Irish Pub in Nusa Lembongan

Beer, Views, and Fun All in One Place If you’re looking for a spot that blends classic Irish pub character with the easy rhythm of island life, Gabet’s Pub is where it all comes together. Sitting just before the iconic Yellow Bridge, it’s the first and only Irish pub in Nusa Lembongan—offering hearty food, cold pints, creative cocktails, and that unmistakable warm, communal spirit pubs are known for. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_single_image image="72681" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]One of the biggest draws is the scenic view and island atmosphere. The semi–open layout looks out toward the seaweed farms and across to Nusa Ceningan, so there’s always something to catch your eye—whether it’s local farmers at work, fishing boats drifting by, or the Yellow Bridge glowing at sundown. It captures the easygoing warmth you’d expect in a local, while giving you a backdrop you simply won’t find anywhere else.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="72602" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]And of course, what’s a pub without a drink in hand? At Gabet’s, the drinks list is a centrepiece. Guinness is on tap from the Ireland, while Bali craft beers bring a local twist. The cocktail menu strikes a nice balance between classics and inventive house creations, keeping the choices broad and interesting. Even if you’re not drinking alcohol, the mocktails and soft options mean you can still enjoy the full pub experience.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="72603" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]The food punches well above expectations, staying true to pub tradition with hearty, satisfying dishes. We tried the Irish stew, pork ribs, and tender beef cheek—all generous in portion, beautifully plated, and rich in flavour. The menu mixes pub staples with international favourites, making it easy for groups to find something for everyone. Desserts are often overlooked on the island, but at Gabet’s they’re a highlight—well worth saving room for if you’ve got a sweet tooth.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="72604" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]What really sets this place apart are the unique extras. Gabet’s is one of the few venues in Lembongan where you can enjoy shisha, and it’s also one of the rare spots hosting live music every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday night. Sports screenings keep travellers connected to the games they don’t want to miss. And just downstairs, you can find their Game zone with pool and ping pong, plus “Cat Island” adds a playful twist, where you can spend time with a lively crew of cats—unexpected and fun.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_empty_space height="20px"][vc_single_image image="72684" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="20px"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]What makes Gabet’s special, though, is that it’s not just for pub-goers. Even if you don’t usually step into pubs, the mix of views, food, drinks, and entertainment makes it worth the visit. Whether you come for a cold pint, a hearty meal, or just to watch the Yellow Bridge glow at sunset, Gabet’s Pub proves that Irish hospitality feels right at home on Nusa Lembongan.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_bottom="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Title: Day Trip Nusa Lembongan: Top Options for a Quick Island Escape
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Day Trip Nusa Lembongan: Top Options for a Quick Island Escape

You might be holidaying in Bali (or planning one) and want to explore the Nusa islands but are short on time. A day trip to Nusa Lembongan is the perfect solution. Despite their small size, the Nusa islands offer something completely different from mainland Bali. Think rugged coastlines, dramatic cliffs, turquoise waters, world-class snorkelling, and a laid-back vibe away from Bali’s busier crowds. We’ve rounded up some of the best ways to experience Lembongan things to do—even if you only have a single day to spare. These tours and packages make it easy to hop over from Sanur and explore the highlights of Nusa Lembongan, Nusa Ceningan, and even a glimpse of Nusa Penida. Nusa Lembongan & Ceningan Day Trip Package

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="72639" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]If you want to tick off two islands in one go, this is a cost- and time-effective choice. The package includes return boat transfers from Sanur and your pick of snorkelling, a mangrove tour, or a guided sightseeing trip across both islands. Departing Sanur at 9:15 AM, you’ll explore the islands’ highlights and still be back before sunset—making it one of the most efficient Day Trip Sanur Lembongan options. View Package[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Catamaran Tour to Nusa Lembongan

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="72640" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]For a stylish escape, set sail on the 23m Aneecha Catamaran. Departing from Sanur’s exclusive Mertasari Harbour, this tour includes a leisurely ocean cruise, snorkelling, a mangrove tour, banana boat rides, plus food and drinks onboard. The catamaran moves more slowly than a fast boat, giving you extra time to soak in sweeping sea views and relax with your loved ones. View Package[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

E-Bike Tour on Nusa Lembongan

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="72674" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Looking for active activities in Nusa Lembongan? This guided e-bike tour combines adventure, culture, and sightseeing. In four hours you’ll ride through scenic backroads, stop at temples, historical sites, and Dream Beach. With e-bikes, the hilly terrain feels achievable and comfortable for all ages. Perfect for solo travellers, couples, or families with active kids. The tour finishes in time for you to catch the last ferry back to Bali at 4:00 PM. These tours prove that a Day Trip Nusa Lembongan can be just as rewarding as a longer stay. From turquoise bays and dramatic cliffs to authentic island life, Lembongan offers a side of Bali worth exploring. And once you’ve had a taste, you might just want to come back for more. If you’re planning time on the mainland before or after your island escape, see our recommendations for family-friendly resorts in Bali. Title: Three Family Villas Side by Side at Tamarind Beach
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Three Family Villas Side by Side at Tamarind Beach

Tamarind Beach is one of Nusa Lembongan’s most picturesque stretches of coastline — calm waters, soft white sand, and the sound of gentle waves lapping the shore. Tucked along this idyllic bay are three stunning beachfront villas — Villa Coral, Villa Celagi, and Jipsi Beach House — each offering its own take on relaxed island luxury.

Whether you’re travelling with family or a group of friends, these neighbouring villas provide the perfect setup to stay close while still enjoying your own private space. Let’s take a look inside each one.

[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Villa Coral

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="72993" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Welcome to your home away from home. Villa Coral is a four-bedroom family villa designed for comfort and connection, accommodating up to nine guests. Each of the four master suites is equal in size, giving everyone the luxury of space and privacy, complete with private balconies, ocean views, and elegant ensuites — the perfect balance of comfort and style.

Positioned right on the beachfront, guests can enjoy uninterrupted views of the Playgrounds and Lacerations surf breaks, or simply spend the day by the infinity pool. When you’re ready for some downtime, unwind in the games room, enjoy sunset drinks by the poolside bar bale, or relax in the upstairs alfresco lounge with views across to Mt Agung.

Snorkelling gear and stand-up paddle boards are provided, so you can easily slip into the turquoise waters just steps from your villa.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Villa Celagi

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="72994" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Just next door, Villa Celagi blends traditional Balinese architecture with laid-back island charm, offering barefoot luxury at its finest. Imagine walking straight from your front gate onto soft white sand, the tide gently brushing the villa’s stone wall, and the majestic Mt Agung rising in the distance.

This four-bedroom, four-bathroom villa is cared for by a dedicated team of four staff who quickly become part of your holiday family. Spend your days relaxing by the pool with a cocktail in hand or set out to explore — world-class surf breaks, scenic island trails, and colourful coral gardens are all within reach.

Your villa manager can arrange unforgettable experiences like swimming with manta rays or drift snorkelling through vibrant reefs. And when evening comes, enjoy a meal prepared by your in-villa chef or head out to one of Nusa Lembongan’s many nearby restaurants.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Jipsi Beach House

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="72995" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Rounding out the trio, Jipsi Beach House captures the spirit of laid-back island living with just the right touch of indulgence. Set on a sprawling 2000m² of tropical gardens, this four-bedroom, four-bathroom villa opens directly onto Tamarind Beach — a paradise of white sand and crystal-clear water.

The villa’s design blends indoor-outdoor living seamlessly. Bi-fold doors open from the main house onto a large timber deck, perfect for alfresco dining with views across the lush lawns, 10 x 5m pool, and ocean beyond. The accommodation layout makes it ideal for families, with a mix of king, queen, and bunk beds plus a private bungalow-style room for extra guests.

A friendly team of staff ensures everything runs smoothly — from transport and scooter hire to snorkelling trips and restaurant bookings — so you can focus on what matters most: slowing down and soaking up island life.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

A Family Escape to Remember

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]Staying at Villa Coral, Villa Celagi, or Jipsi Beach House — or even booking two or three together — offers a rare opportunity to share an unforgettable beachfront experience with your family. With direct access to Tamarind Beach, sweeping ocean views, and the charm of Nusa Lembongan right at your doorstep, these villas promise the ultimate family retreat. Our team is always here to help you have the perfect Lembongan stay and arrange the boat transfers for your next island getaway. Title: Reaching Out with Care: Health Visits to Nusa Ceningan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Reaching Out with Care: Health Visits to Nusa Ceningan

Our Love for Lembongan journey took us across to Nusa Ceningan, together with the dedicated medical teams from East Medical Clinic Center and Puskesmas (local hospital). The goal was simple yet vital — to check on our priority patients and elderly who need ongoing care and support.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][qbutton icon_pack="" target="_blank" font_weight="" text="Share Your Love for Lembongan" link="https://bit.ly/DonateLFL" background_color="#C22F83" hover_background_color="#FFFFFF" border_color="#C22F83" hover_border_color="#C22F83" color="#FFFFFF" hover_color="#C22F83"][vc_column_text css=""][vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Pandu's Story

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="72999" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Among the many faces we met was Pandu, a bright and resilient young boy living with cerebral palsy. Pandu’s father, with remarkable love and resourcefulness, built a handmade wheelchair so his son could move around the house. However, Pandu now needs a special wheelchair that can properly support his posture and mobility — something that would make a world of difference to his comfort, safety, and quality of life. Accessing this kind of equipment is challenging on the island, and we’re hoping to raise funds to help Pandu get the wheelchair he deserves.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Supporting Our Elderly

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="73000" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]We also checked on several elderly recovering from surgery, many of whom are still in need of physiotherapy and follow-up medical care. With limited healthcare access on Nusa Ceningan, visits like this are crucial to monitor their recovery and receive the medicines and vitamins they need.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Collaborative Care

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="73001" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Working alongside East Medical and Puskesmas (local hospital), our team carried out blood sugar and blood pressure checks, distributed multivitamins, and provided essential medication . These simple steps can prevent complications and give reassurance to those who otherwise might not have access to regular healthcare.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

How You Can Help

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]Every visit reminds us of the ongoing needs within our island community. From specialised equipment like Pandu’s wheelchair to physiotherapy and recovery care for the elderlies, your contribution helps us continue this mission. Your donations allow Love for Lembongan to provide vital health support where it’s needed most — reaching people who would otherwise go without care. If you’d like to help Pandu receive his new wheelchair or support our ongoing medical visits, please consider donating to Love for Lembongan. Together, we can keep building a healthier, kinder future for Nusa Lembongan and Nusa Ceningan.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_empty_space height="25px"][qbutton icon_pack="" target="_blank" font_weight="" text="Donate Now" link="https://bit.ly/DonateLFL" background_color="#C22F83" hover_background_color="#FFFFFF" border_color="#C22F83" hover_border_color="#C22F83" color="#FFFFFF" hover_color="#C22F83"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_bottom="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Title: Guide to Jungutbatu, Nusa Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Guide to Jungutbatu: Where to Stay, Eat, and Play on Nusa Lembongan

Jungutbatu is the main hub of Nusa Lembongan where a lively village by the sea with everything you need for a great island stay. Here, you’ll find beach cafes, local warungs, and surf breaks all with stunning views of Mount Agung. This area offers the perfect mix of laid-back vibes and adventure. Whether you’re here to surf the island’s famous waves, explore underwater worlds, or simply unwind with sunset cocktails, Jungutbatu has it all. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Where to Eat

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="73274" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Jungutbatu is home to some of the island’s best dining spots — from casual beachfront cafés to lively restaurants tucked along the main street. Start your day with breakfast at The General, Ginger & Jamu, or Kayu Restaurant, where you’ll find great coffee, fresh smoothies, and healthy bites to fuel your morning.

For lunch, Karana is a favourite with its pool club vibe and stunning Mount Agung views, while The Coconut Hut is a fun choice for families with its mini golf course and relaxed atmosphere.

As the sun sets, head to Nyoman's Warung for fresh seafood served right on the sand, or enjoy wood-fired pizzas and good tunes at Baliwood Social Club. For cocktails with a view, Bar Riva and Pontoon at Lago are top spots for golden hour drinks. And if you’re after an oceanfront dinner with a touch of elegance, La Bianca and Indiana Kenanga never disappoint.

Whether you’re after a casual bite or a stylish evening out, Jungutbatu’s food scene has something for everyone.

👉 Explore more restaurants in Jungutbatu here.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Things to Do

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="73275" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

From ocean adventures to peaceful escapes, Jungutbatu has plenty to keep you busy. The main beach is home to four surf breaks, and you’ll easily find surf schools along the sand offering lessons for all levels — from first-timers to confident riders chasing the next wave.

If you’re after something slower, join a yoga class by the sea with Yoga Bliss, or take your practice further with All Yoga Training, which attracts students from around the world. For pure relaxation, book a treatment at Spring Spa, where you can unwind with views of the ocean and Mount Agung, or visit Karuna Island Spa in the village for a calming massage and UMI Nail Bar to get your nails done with a glass of good matcha.

You can also spend an easy day by the water — try stand-up paddleboarding through the calm mangroves or simply chill on the beach and enjoy the laid-back rhythm of island life.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Where to Stay

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="73276" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

There are stays in Jungutbatu for every kind of traveller and every budget. You can find cosy bungalows under AU$100 per night, such as Gecko Villa & Bungalows and Tropica Tranquility, perfect for a simple and comfortable island stay.

If you prefer a little more style, Lembongan Island Beach Villas and Batu Karang Resort offer beautiful ocean views, full facilities, and easy access to the beach. For families and groups, private villas like Beach Tonic, Tenang Villas, Villa Kasih, Villa Utopia, and Villa Madu Dua provide plenty of space and privacy — ideal for relaxing together.

Stay by the beach if you love waking up to the sound of waves and colourful sunsets, in the village if you want to be close to shops and restaurants, or up on the hill for peace and sweeping views of the island and Mount Agung. Each area has its own charm — it just depends on the vibe you’re after.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Ready to Explore?

Whether you’re here for a quick island escape or a longer stay, Jungutbatu has everything you need to make your time on Nusa Lembongan unforgettable. With plenty of great places to eat, stay, and explore, it’s the perfect spot to experience the island’s easygoing charm. Pack your sandals, bring your sense of adventure, and let Jungutbatu show you the best of island life.

Our team is always here to help you have the perfect Lembongan stay and arrange the boat transfers for your next island getaway. Title: Guide to Tamarind Bay, Nusa Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Guide to Tamarind Bay: Your Hidden Escape on Nusa Lembongan

Tamarind Bay is one of Nusa Lembongan’s most peaceful pockets — a sheltered curve of turquoise water tucked between Jungutbatu and Mushroom Bay. With calm mornings, epic sunsets, and front-row views of Mount Agung, it’s a favourite for travellers who want the best of both worlds: close to everything, yet quietly tucked away. Whether you’re planning a family holiday or a solo escape, here’s your guide to staying and dining around Tamarind Bay.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Where to Stay

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]Tamarind Bay is home to some of the island’s most beloved villas and boutique stays. From family-friendly beachfront homes to romantic suites perched above the water, you’re spoiled for choice. [/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

For Families

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="73692" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/villa-pantai/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]If you’re travelling with little ones or a bigger group, these villas offer space, comfort, and facilities that make holiday life easy:
  • Villa Pantai – A 7-bedroom absolute-beachfront villa featuring a bunkbed room and a rumpus room, plus its own spa and gym. Perfect for multi-generational stays and large family holidays.
  • Villa Coral – A 4-bedroom beachfront villa with a private pool, large open spaces, and direct beach access. Ideal for families wanting both comfort and convenience.
  • Villa Celagi – Another beautiful 4-bedroom villa with a private pool, spacious indoor–outdoor living, and beachfront access, perfect for relaxed family days by the water.
  • Jipsi Beach House – A 4-bedroom tropical hideaway set within a lush garden, complete with a private pool and beach access right at its doorstep.
  • Villa Sayang – Available as a 3- or 4-bedroom villa, or combined into a spacious 7-bedroom property. Guests can also enjoy the villa’s private catamaran for snorkelling or fishing trips, a standout family experience.
  • Seaview Private Villas – A collection of 1–3 bedroom villas ideal for families looking for flexibility. Multi-level layouts, shared pool, and even a private beach cave accessible by lift.
[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

For Couples or Solo Travellers

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="73693" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/white-horse-resort/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Looking for a romantic getaway or a peaceful retreat for one? These stays blend comfort, style, and peaceful Tamarind Bay scenery:
  • White Horse Resort – A beachfront boutique stay offering privacy, curated interiors, and a sunny pool deck made for long lazing.
  • Morin Resort – Oceanfront suites with panoramic cliffside views, barefoot-luxury design, and a serene atmosphere perfect for slow days by the water.
  • Villa Sofia at Seaview Private Villas – A beautiful one-bedroom villa with ocean views, private spaces, and easy access to the shared resort facilities.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Where to Eat

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="73694" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Tamarind Bay is more secluded than busier pockets of Lembongan — and that’s part of its charm. While there are fewer restaurants within immediate walking distance, the area is home to two standout dining experiences:
  • Tales Bookcafé – Just a step away from Tamarind Beach, this independent café offers a cosy spot for coffee, books and board games in a relaxed setting.
  • The Playful Table at Morin Resort – A thoughtful, plant-based dining experience with creative plates and warm hospitality.
Most villas in this area also offer in-villa dining menus, so you can enjoy breakfast by your pool, sunset canapés, or family dinners without leaving your holiday home. Resorts in Jungutbatu, Nusa Lembongan

Jungutbatu is one of the most popular areas to stay on Nusa Lembongan, known for its beachfront setting, easy access to restaurants and a relaxed island atmosphere. It’s a great choice for travellers who want to be close to the action while still enjoying peaceful resort living.

Resorts in Jungutbatu offer the best of both worlds — swimming pools, tropical gardens and ocean views paired with walkable access to cafés, beach clubs and island activities. Title: Where to Stay in Nusa Ceningan: Private Villas with Views & Space to Unwind

Where to Stay in Nusa Ceningan: Private Villas with Views & Space to Unwind

Just across the iconic Yellow Bridge from Nusa Lembongan lies Nusa Ceningan — a smaller, quieter island loved for its dramatic cliffs, clear waters, and laid-back atmosphere. Life moves slower here, making it ideal for travellers who want to escape the crowds while still being close to great cafes, beach clubs, and island activities.

Accommodation on Ceningan leans towards private villas and boutique stays, perfect for families or groups travelling together. If you’re looking for space, privacy, and unforgettable views, here are two of our favourite villas to consider for your next island stay.

New to the island? Take a moment to explore our Nusa Ceningan destination guide for handpicked things to do, must-visit spots, and local favourites to eat your way around the island.

[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="74539" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation="" link="https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/villa-cahaya-nusa-ceningan/"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Set on a peaceful hillside overlooking the ocean, Villa Cahaya offers the feeling of a private island retreat while still being within walking distance of some of Ceningan’s best spots.

The property is thoughtfully designed for families and groups, with five individual bungalows set within lush tropical gardens. Each bungalow comes with air-conditioning and an ensuite bathroom, giving everyone privacy while still sharing a communal holiday space.

Days here naturally flow between the spacious swimming pool, shaded lounge areas, and the ocean-view deck where you can often spot surfers, dolphins, and glowing sunsets over Mount Agung. Evenings are best spent cooking together in the fully equipped modern kitchen or requesting in-villa dining prepared by the friendly local team.

A highlight for families and groups is the TV and games room, plus plenty of spaces to gather or sneak away with a book. With Starlink Wi-Fi, it’s also easy to stay connected when needed.

Another big plus is the location. Guests can easily walk to Blue Lagoon, Mahana Point, Arna Ocean Lounge, and Suku Beach Club, making it simple to explore without long drives.

Why it works well for families & groups:
Multiple bungalows provide privacy for everyone while still keeping the group together in shared spaces. Kids love the pool and gardens, while adults appreciate the views and relaxed setting.

The villa features four ensuite bedrooms, three of which enjoy ocean views. The master bedroom also includes a sofa bed that can convert into an extra bed for children, making the villa suitable for families travelling together.

Inside, guests will find a generous 100m² living area, a fully equipped kitchen, tropical garden, and a private pool — perfect for slow days spent at the villa between island adventures.

Although breakfast isn’t included, meals can easily be arranged, and the villa team can organise everything from scooter rentals to snorkelling, diving, island tours, spa treatments, yoga, and more — making holiday planning effortless.

Valentine’s Day on Nusa Lembongan is best enjoyed slowly — barefoot mornings, saltwater adventures, spa indulgence, and a romantic dinner under the stars. Here’s a simple, flexible itinerary that lets couples mix and match their perfect island day, featuring some of Lembongan and Ceningan’s most loved spots.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Island Adventures & Ocean Fun

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="74755" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Title: Where Should You Stay on Your First Trip to Nusa Lembongan?
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Where Should You Stay on Your First Trip to Nusa Lembongan?

Nusa Lembongan may be a small island, but choosing where to stay can shape your entire experience.

Different parts of the island offer different vibes — from lively beachfront villages to quiet family-friendly bays and dramatic sunset cliffs. The good news? Everything is still within a short drive. The key is choosing the area that best matches the kind of holiday you’re looking for.

If it’s your first time visiting Nusa Lembongan, these three areas are the most popular places to stay: Jungutbatu, Mushroom Bay, Tamarind Bay, and Sandy Bay.

Let’s break down what makes each one special.

[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Jungutbatu – The Heart of the Island

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="75115" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

If you want to stay somewhere lively, convenient, and right by the beach, Jungutbatu is the most popular area on the island.

This is where most of the resorts, beachfront restaurants, and water activity operators are located. Jungutbatu Beach stretches along the village, offering a long swimmable coastline with calm water — perfect for morning dips, paddleboarding, or simply relaxing on the sand.

The area is also home to the island’s main harbour, making arrival and departure especially easy. Many snorkelling trips, diving boats, and fishing excursions depart directly from the beach, where you’ll often see traditional jukungs (small wooden boats) lining the shore.

One of the best things about staying here is how effortless everything feels. Breakfast cafés, beach bars, sunset spots, and activity centres are all within walking distance. Read our full guide to Jungutbatu here.

Why stay in Jungutbatu?

  • Long swimmable beach
  • The largest choice of restaurants and cafés
  • Great range of villas, resorts, and bungalows
  • Easy access to snorkelling, diving, and boat trips
  • Walking distance to many attractions
  • Lively island atmosphere

For first-time visitors who want convenience and plenty to do, Jungutbatu is often the easiest place to start — explore our Jungutbatu stays here.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Mushroom Bay – A Charming Village Feel

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="75175" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Mushroom Bay offers a similar convenience to Jungutbatu, but with a smaller, more village-like atmosphere. The area centres around a picturesque bay with a smaller harbour, where boats arrive and depart throughout the day.

The road leading into the bay is shaded by trees, giving the area a relaxed tropical feel, and the neighbourhood is home to a mix of local coffee shops, boutique villas, and relaxed beachfront restaurants. One of the most well-known resorts here is Hai Tide Beach Resort, a long-standing beachfront resort that has helped shape Mushroom Bay into one of the island’s classic holiday spots.

While quieter than Jungutbatu, Mushroom Bay still offers plenty within walking distance — making it a lovely option for travellers who want easy access to the beach, cosy cafés, and a laid-back island atmosphere without the busier feel of the main village. Read our full guide to Mushroom Bay here.

Why stay in Mushroom Bay?

  • Smaller, relaxed bay with a village feel
  • Calm beach for swimming and beach days
  • Boutique villas and beach resort
  • Cosy cafés and local coffee spots
  • Shaded roads lined with tropical trees
  • Convenient harbour access for boats and transfers

For travellers who enjoy a laid-back beach village atmosphere with easy access to cafés and the sea, Mushroom Bay is a lovely place to stay — explore our Mushroom Bay stays here.

Tamarind Bay – Quiet, Relaxed, and Family-Friendly

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="75117" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

Just around the corner from Jungutbatu, Tamarind Bay offers a more peaceful and laid-back side of Nusa Lembongan.

The bay is known for its calm waters and relaxed atmosphere, making it a favourite for families and travellers looking to slow down. While the area feels quieter and more secluded, it’s still only a short drive to the restaurants and beach bars of Jungutbatu.

Days here are often spent enjoying the beach, reading under the shade of trees, or taking a refreshing swim in the bay.

Tamarind Bay is also home to one of the island’s most loved cafés, Tales Bookcafé, a cosy spot known for great coffee and shelves filled with books — a perfect place to spend a relaxed morning. Read our full guide to Tamarind Bay here.

  • Quiet and peaceful atmosphere
  • Beachfront luxury family villas
  • Great for relaxed holidays
  • Close to Jungutbatu but away from the crowds

If you want to stay somewhere that feels calm yet connected, Tamarind Bay strikes a beautiful balance — explore our Tamarind Bay stays here.

Sandy Bay – Cliff Views and Sunset Magic

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="75116" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]

On the opposite side of the island, Sandy Bay offers a completely different atmosphere — dramatic coastal views, luxury villas, and unforgettable sunsets.

This area sits along rugged cliffs facing the open ocean, making it one of the most scenic parts of Nusa Lembongan. The coastline here isn’t suitable for swimming, but what it lacks in swimmable beaches it more than makes up for in spectacular views and natural landmarks.

Sandy Bay is home to several stylish villas, boutique stays, and a small collection of restaurants and shops. The area revolves around Sandy Bay Beach Club, a popular spot for sunset drinks and oceanfront dining.

Nearby, you’ll also find two of the island’s most famous viewpoints — Dream Beach, with its stunning turquoise cove, and Devil’s Tears, where powerful waves crash dramatically against the cliffs. Read our full guide to Sandy Bay here.

Why stay in Sandy Bay?

  • Some of the island’s best sunset views
  • Luxury villas and boutique stays
  • Close to Dream Beach and Devil’s Tears
  • Stylish restaurants and beach clubs
  • Scenic cliffs and dramatic ocean views

For travellers looking for romantic scenery and a more upscale atmosphere, Sandy Bay offers a completely different side of the island — explore our Sandy Bay stays here.

So… Where Should You Stay?

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

The best place to stay really depends on the kind of holiday you want.

  • Jungutbatu – Best for first-time visitors who want convenience, swimmable beaches, and plenty of restaurants and activities.
  • Mushroom Bay – A smaller beach village with boutique stays, cosy cafés, and easy harbour access, offering a relaxed alternative close to the action.
  • Tamarind Bay – Ideal for families and travellers looking for a quieter, relaxed stay close to everything.
  • Sandy Bay – Perfect for sunset lovers, scenic views, and a more luxurious escape.

The beauty of Nusa Lembongan is that nothing is far away — you can easily explore all three areas during your stay.

The Best Cafes to Work From on Nusa Lembongan

Not long ago, getting online on Nusa Lembongan meant crossing your fingers over a warung’s patchy Wi-Fi — or giving up entirely. The island ran on island time in every sense, and that was part of the charm. But things have quietly shifted. Proper cafes have settled across the island, Starlink has found its way into many spaces (and our villas too), and reliable internet is no longer a lucky find. Whether you’re a digital nomad chasing a few productive hours, a dad on holiday clearing the inbox, or just organising tomorrow’s plans over a good coffee — Nusa Lembongan now does both: work, then switch off. Easy.
