Title: Healthy Cafés and Plant-Based Eats in Nusa Lembongan
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]There is something about island life that makes you want to eat well. Maybe it is the slow mornings, the salt in the air, or the fact that you have just spent the day swimming, cycling and chasing sunsets. Whatever it is, Nusa Lembongan delivers. This tiny island has quietly become one of the easiest places in Bali to eat healthy, with cafes serving up vibrant smoothie bowls, proper specialty coffee and plant-based plates that taste as good as they look. The best part is that you do not have to be vegan to love it here. Review sites now list more than 25 vegetarian-friendly cafes and restaurants across Nusa Lembongan, and nearly every one marks its vegan and vegetarian dishes clearly, so the same menu that does a beautiful tofu scramble will also do you a perfect flat white and a slice of carrot cake. So whether you are fully plant-based, gently flexitarian, or just looking for a fresh, wholesome meal between adventures, here is our guide to the healthy cafes and plant-based eats in Nusa Lembongan.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="78375" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Why Nusa Lembongan Is a Plant-Based Paradise

Lembongan has always had a gentle, conscious soul. That same spirit is reflected in the island's mindful, eco-conscious approach to travel, and it even extends to the food on your plate.  What makes the island so friendly for healthy eating is the variety. Plant-based here does not mean a single sad salad. You will find colourful Buddha bowls, raw treats, fresh juices, traditional Indonesian gado gado and tempeh dishes, plus pizzas, pastas and burgers with vegan versions ready to go. If you want to go deeper on the fully vegan side of things, we also have a dedicated guide to the best vegan food on Nusa Lembongan that pairs perfectly with this one. For now, let us walk you through the cafes worth building your days around.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

The Best Healthy Cafés and Plant-Based Spots in Nusa Lembongan

Most of these sit in and around Jungutbatu and Mushroom Bay, so they are easy to weave into a day of exploring. We have noted the vibe, the dishes to order and who each spot is best for.

Bali ECO Deli

  If you only have time for one healthy cafe on the island, make it this one. Tucked just off the main road in Jungutbatu, Bali ECO Deli offers a leafy little oasis. With 4.7 stars from more than 2,300 Google reviews, it has clearly built a loyal following. The menu is built around fresh, balanced, made-from-scratch food, with a huge range of vegan and vegetarian options, and Bali ECO Deli is proud to be the island's first healthy restaurant. Come for breakfast and order a smoothie bowl; the Island Berry Bliss or the Green Glow are both lovely, or go for the loaded avocado toast and scrambled tofu on sourdough. Later in the day, the lentil dal, watermelon salad and Thai green curry are the crowd favourites. The coffee is properly good too, with alternative milks across the board. Best for a healthy start to the day, a long lazy brunch or a sweet treat like brownies, carrot cake and cookies.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="74145" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text css=""]

Ombak Zero Waste Café

Right on the Jungutbatu beachfront, Ombak takes the island ethos and turns it all the way up. The cafe embraces a low-waste approach, with a wide selection of vegan-friendly dishes and one of the island's nicest ocean views. Grab a table overlooking Shipwreck surf break, watch the surfers take on the waves, order something fresh, and feel good knowing the kitchen is committed to reducing its environmental footprint. Every Monday evening, Ombak also hosts an Ocean-themed Movie Night, adding another reason to visit. Best for conscious travellers and a slow beachfront breakfast.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="78474" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text css=""]

Ginger & Jamu

Sitting directly on Jungutbatu Beach, Ginger & Jamu has that easy, chilled-out vibe that makes you lose track of time. Vegan options are clearly marked, and their signature jamu is a must-try, offering a refreshing taste of Indonesia's traditional herbal drink. The view of the surfers paddling out is exactly what visitors come to the island for. Stay through to golden hour, or head upstairs to Santhosa Yoga Village, where the yoga shala overlooks the sunset and offers one of the most peaceful spots to end the day. Best for a relaxed lunch followed by sunset views and an evening yoga session.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="78477" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text css=""]

Tigerlilly’s

On the main road in Jungutbatu, Tigerlilly’s brings a slightly more boho, design-led energy and a menu that plant-based eaters will have fun with. Tofu gyoza, tempeh barbecue ribs, Vietnamese chicken salad, tacos and bao buns all make appearances, alongside the popular build your own meal option, allowing diners to customize their plate to suit their tastes. Prices sit a touch above the simple warungs, but you are paying for the vibe and the plating. Best for dinner with friends or a treat-yourself kind of meal.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="78476" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text css=""]

Hai Ri Zen at Hai Tide Beach Resort

For an elevated beachfront dining experience, Hai Ri Zen at Hai Tide Beach Resort is well worth a visit. Overlooking the calm waters of Mushroom Bay, this semi-fine dining restaurant blends East-meets-West flavours with a menu featuring fresh seafood, vegetarian dishes and beautifully presented seasonal specials. The beachfront setting makes it an ideal choice for a leisurely lunch or sunset dinner, while complimentary pick-up and drop-off services add an extra level of convenience for diners. Best for relaxed seaside dining with refined flavours and stunning ocean views.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="78473" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text css=""]

The Playful Table by Morin

Perched above the coastline with sweeping ocean views, The Playful Table by Morin is the island's only fully plant-based restaurant. The menu combines fresh salads, cassava wraps and Asian-inspired dishes, alongside nourishing smoothies and a comforting turmeric chai latte. Visit on Taco Tuesday for creative plant-based tacos, or on Fisherman's Friday for a seasonal plant-based interpretation inspired by the catch of the day. Best for a wholesome meal with panoramic ocean views.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_single_image image="78475" img_size="full" alignment="center" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text css=""]

A Local Warung for Budget Plant-Based Eats

For all the polished cafes, do not skip the humble warungs. Lembongan is dotted with family-run spots where a big plate of mie goreng or nasi campur loaded with tempeh, tofu and vegetables costs a fraction of the cafe prices. The owners are some of the warmest people you will meet, and many know exactly what vegan means and will happily help you order. This is where the island feeds itself, and it is every bit as worthy of your appetite. Best for authentic, affordable plant-based meals and a genuine local welcome.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Vegetarian-Friendly Cafés with a View on Nusa Ceningan

When you are ready to explore a little further, hop across the iconic Yellow Bridge to Nusa Ceningan. It is an easy add-on to your day, and there are a couple of healthy spots over here that are well worth the ride. While you are at it, you can fold in a few of the best things to do on Nusa Ceningan like the Blue Lagoon and the cliff jump. Klyf Club Blue Lagoon perches on the cliff overlooking impossibly blue water, and you might even spot turtles swimming in the lagoon below while sipping a fresh juice. Vegan options are clearly marked, and the drinks menu is generous. A little closer to the Yellow Bridge, The Sand Ceningan sits right over the sea with views across the seaweed farms, making it the perfect stop for a coconut and a plant-based bite before heading back to Lembongan. Suku Beach Club also offers a relaxed beachfront setting with healthy dishes, fresh juices, and vegetarian-friendly options. While Sea Breeze is another great spot to enjoy wholesome meals, tropical drinks, and stunning sea views in a laid-back atmosphere.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Find Your Spot by Diet and Craving

Short on time and just want a quick steer? Here is the cheat sheet.[/vc_column_text][vc_raw_html css=""][/vc_raw_html][vc_column_text css=""]If you want even more ideas across every cuisine, our roundup of Lembongan's best restaurants and our guide to island-style brunch will keep you very well fed.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Tips for Eating Healthy and Plant-Based in Nusa Lembongan

A few small things make eating well on the island even easier. Bring cash. Many of the smaller cafes and warungs are cash only, and an ATM run can eat into your beach time, so carry enough rupiah for the day. Most cafes open early, with popular spots like Bali ECO Deli serving from 7 am right through to 9 pm, so breakfast people and brunch people are equally spoiled. Kitchens can wind down earlier than you expect though, so do not leave dinner too late. In the warungs, a friendly "tanpa daging" or simply asking for the vegetarian version goes a long way, and most owners are happy to adapt a dish for you. Tempeh and tofu are everywhere and always a safe, delicious bet. Refill rather than buy. Plenty of cafes here will top up your reusable bottle, which keeps single-use plastic off the island. It is a small habit that fits right in with the conscious way of travelling that makes Lembongan special. If wellness is your reason for the trip, pair your healthy eating with a class or two from our yoga and wellness guide to Nusa Lembongan. And if you are still planning the basics, our guide to getting to Nusa Lembongan covers the boats from Sanur.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Frequently Asked Questions

Is Nusa Lembongan good for vegans and vegetarians?

Yes, it is one of the easiest islands in Bali for plant-based eating. Review sites list more than 25 vegetarian-friendly cafes and restaurants across Nusa Lembongan and neighbouring Ceningan; most cafes clearly mark their vegan and vegetarian dishes, and even the local warungs are happy to prepare meat-free versions of classics like nasi goreng and gado gado.

Where is the best healthy breakfast in Nusa Lembongan?

Bali ECO Deli is the standout for a healthy breakfast, with smoothie bowls, avocado toast and scrambled tofu. For a beachfront option, the Beach Cafe at Lago, Ginger and Jamu,  and Ombak Zero Waste Cafe are both excellent.

Are there gluten-free options in Nusa Lembongan?

There are. Bali ECO Deli in particular offers gluten-free choices, and many cafes can adapt salads, bowls and rice-based dishes on request. It always helps to mention your needs when you order.

How much does a healthy meal cost in Nusa Lembongan?

A meal at a cafe typically runs from around 60,000 to 150,000 rupiah, while a plate at a local warung can be as little as 25,000 to 35,000 rupiah. Specialty coffee usually sits between 30,000 and 65,000 rupiah.

Do cafés in Nusa Lembongan take cards or cash?

Some of the larger cafes accept cards, some are strictly cashless, but many smaller spots and warungs are cash only, so it is best to carry rupiah with you.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Eat Well, Island Style

Eating healthy on Nusa Lembongan never feels like a compromise. It feels like part of the holiday. Start your mornings with a smoothie bowl by the sea, fuel up on plant-based plates between swims and dives, and let the island's slow, conscious rhythm do the rest. Pick one cafe from this list to begin with, and we have a feeling you will be working your way through the rest before your trip is over. Here at The Lembongan Traveller, we eat our way around the island so you can arrive knowing exactly where to go. Ready to plan the whole thing? Our complete Nusa Lembongan guide has everything else you need, from beaches to boats to where to stay.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][vc_column_text css=""]Email: holiday@thelembongantraveller.com WhatsApp: +61 478 928 925[/vc_column_text][vc_separator type="normal" border_style=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Title: Why Villa Owners in Nusa Lembongan Need a Property Management Company
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Why Villa Owners in Nusa Lembongan Need a Property Management Company

Owning a villa in Nusa Lembongan sounds like the dream — and it can be. But once your villa becomes a holiday rental, there is much more involved than simply putting it on an OTA and waiting for bookings. From marketing and reservations to guest communication, housekeeping, maintenance and pricing, running a successful holiday villa is a full-time job. That’s where a professional property management company in Nusa Lembongan can make all the difference. At The Lembongan Traveller, we help villa owners take the day-to-day work off their hands while making sure their property is professionally presented, well cared for and positioned to attract the right guests. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Your Villa Needs More Than Just a Listing

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="78578" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Having your villa listed on OTAs like Airbnb or Booking.com is only the beginning. A successful holiday rental needs professional photography, compelling descriptions, accurate information, competitive pricing and consistent visibility across booking channels. More importantly, your listing needs to be actively managed as the market changes. A property management company can take care of this ongoing work, helping your villa stay competitive rather than simply sitting online waiting for bookings. At The Lembongan Traveller, we combine property management, holiday bookings and island expertise to promote properties to travellers specifically looking to stay in Nusa Lembongan.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

You Need Someone on the Island

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="78577" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]This is particularly important when your villa is in Nusa Lembongan. If you live overseas or spend most of your time in Bali or elsewhere, who is going to deal with a leaking tap, a broken air conditioner or a guest arriving late at night? Having a trusted local team means there is someone on the ground who understands the island, knows reliable suppliers and can respond when something needs attention. It also gives you access to the local talent pool. Hiring in Nusa Lembongan can be challenging when you don't live here with no established local connections. A property management company with an existing team and network can help you find reliable housekeeping, maintenance and other hospitality staff without having to start from scratch.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Guest Experience Is Everything

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="78570" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Beautiful villas get people to click Book. Great experiences get them to leave five-star reviews and come back. Guest communication starts well before arrival. Guests may need help organising boat transfers, arranging airport transport, booking activities, understanding where to eat or simply figuring out how to get around the island. This is where local knowledge really matters. Your team can tell guests which beaches are actually suitable for swimming, where to go for sunset or the best way to get around — including little details visitors may not know, such as the fact that golf buggies can't cross the Yellow Bridge. These small details make a big difference to the guest experience and help prevent confusion during their stay.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Housekeeping & Maintenance Can't Be an Afterthought

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="78571" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]A villa is only as good as its upkeep. Pool cleaning, gardens, linen, housekeeping, air conditioning, plumbing, electrical issues and general repairs all need regular attention — especially in a tropical island environment. Small maintenance issues can quickly become expensive problems if they aren't noticed early. Professional management means your property is regularly monitored and issues can be addressed before they affect your guests or your reviews. It also means having an established network of local suppliers and tradespeople who can help keep your property running smoothly.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Pricing Should Change With Demand

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="78572" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]One of the biggest mistakes villa owners can make is setting one nightly rate and leaving it there. Holiday rental pricing should respond to seasonality, demand, holidays, school breaks, availability and booking patterns. Nusa Lembongan has clear periods of high and low demand, so your pricing strategy needs to work across the entire year — not just during July and August. A professional manager can adjust rates and promotional strategies to help maximise both occupancy and revenue, rather than simply chasing bookings at any price.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

You Get Access to a Local Booking Network

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="78576" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]One major advantage of working with an established property management company is that your villa doesn't have to rely entirely on third-party booking platforms. The Lembongan Traveller has been part of the Nusa Lembongan tourism industry for years, with an established website, traveller audience, local knowledge and network of island businesses. This gives your property another channel for generating direct enquiries and bookings, while also connecting it with travellers who are already planning a Nusa Lembongan holiday. As an owner, you profit more from direct booking as you don’t need to pay additional 15 – 20% commission from online booking platforms.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

You Can Enjoy Your Investment Without Running the Business

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="78575" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Perhaps the biggest benefit is simple: You don't have to become a hotelier just because you own a villa. Many villa owners purchase their property because they love Nusa Lembongan and want a home they can enjoy themselves — with the opportunity to generate income when they're away. Managing the property yourself can quickly turn that dream into another job. A professional property management company takes care of the operational side, allowing you to stay involved as much or as little as you want. And it's not just the physical running of the villa. Your PMC can also help coordinate the administrative side, including liaising with your tax consultant and providing the information needed for your property's financial and tax requirements. At the same time, your villa becomes part of the island's wider economy — supporting local employment and a chain of local suppliers, tradespeople and businesses. You can enjoy your villa when you're on the island, while having a local team looking after it when you're not.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

So, Is Property Management Worth It?

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="78573" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]For villa owners who live overseas, have limited time, don't have an established local team or simply don't want to manage the day-to-day running of a holiday rental, professional property management can be a smart investment. The right management company should do more than answer guest messages. They should help market your villa, generate bookings, protect your property, manage your guests, access local talent, coordinate suppliers and help navigate the practicalities of owning a villa on the island.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Why Choose The Lembongan Traveller?

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="78574" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Managing a villa in Nusa Lembongan requires more than generic Bali property management. You need people who actually understand the island, the guests, the market and the businesses around you. The Lembongan Traveller combines local island knowledge with holiday rental marketing, reservations, guest services and property management — giving villa owners one local team to manage the moving parts. You own the villa. We help you make it work. If you own a villa in Nusa Lembongan and are considering professional property management, get in touch with The Lembongan Traveller to discuss how we can help maximise your property's potential. Title: Meet Pak Junior: The Lembongan Local Behind Setia Fast Ferry
Content:
[vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

Meet Pak Junior: The Lembongan Local Behind Setia Fast Ferry

Gone are the days of long, uncomfortable journeys to Nusa Lembongan. What was once a two-hour sampan ride has evolved into a smooth 30-minute fast boat journey from Sanur’s modern harbour. Setia Fast Ferry was among the pioneers of a more premium way to cross the channel, introducing a fleet designed with marine-grade air conditioning, wider cabins and plush seating. In this interview, we speak with co-founder I Wayan Redita — affectionately known as Pak Junior — about his journey, the evolution of sea transport between Bali and Lembongan, and his commitment to elevating his hometown to a whole new level. [vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='32px' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type="row" use_row_as_full_screen_section="no" type="full_width" text_align="left" background_animation="none" padding_top="21" css_animation=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Can you tell us how Setia Fast Ferry began, and a little about your background before starting the company?

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="78824" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]Setia started with a desire to create a better travel experience between Bali and Nusa Lembongan. I was born and raised in Lembongan and have watched tourism on the island grow and travellers’ needs change over the years. The name Setia is also deeply personal. It was taken from my late father, I Nyoman Setia, a hardworking man who believed strongly in commitment and integrity. I still remember the small wooden boat he used to transport seaweed, which was also named Setia. Naming our fast ferry after him was a way to honour his spirit and the values he passed on to me. Before starting Setia, I had spent many years working in business and tourism. I saw an opportunity to create a fast ferry service focused not just on speed, but also on comfort, safety and service — making the journey to Lembongan part of the holiday experience itself.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_separator type="normal" border_style="solid" up="15" down="15" color="#6d6e70"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner row_type="row" type="full_width" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide="no" text_align="left" css_animation=""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text css=""]

Setia is known for its premium approach, from marine-grade air conditioning and wide-body boats to its strong focus on safety. What was the thinking behind this?

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_single_image image="79127" img_size="full" css="" qode_css_animation=""][vc_empty_space height="25px"][vc_column_text css=""]For me, when you're carrying people, safety and comfort come first. We knew travellers had high expectations, so from the beginning, we didn't want to simply build a fast boat. We wanted to create a journey that felt spacious, comfortable and safe. Many of the details may not always be visible to passengers, but they make a big difference to their experience.
